name: 64 CHAI BAR
review_texts:
I have been here multiple times and interacted with Shivam and Abhishek. The chai and the food - I’ve tasted bun Maska and sandwiches - are absolute delight.

I love the fact that even during rush hours, they are in no hurry to cook and serve fast and worry about table turns. They still maintain the service levels and the taste great. Chai is slow cooked and lovely!

Thank you Abhishek and Shivam! Best wishes! 🫶🙏🕉️

I ordered one coffee and one tea and waited for 20 minutes. When I followed up on the order, the staff member snapped at me and said, "Why can't you wait? I cannot give you half-boiled tea. Once the tea is ready, I'll make coffee."There is absolutely no need for this kind of unwanted attitude. Other customers in the shop were equally frustrated with the long waits and poor service. Avoid this place if you value your time and basic respect.

AMAZING TEA! SUPERB AMBIENCE! GREAT SERVICE!
Have visited this cafe for the first time and was extremely grateful for the tea with awesome taste and quality. For the first time visitors, this tea was free and this was cherry on the top. I would recommend this cafe to everyone and try out things. It has range of delicacies. The music is awesome and enhances the taste of the food. I am surely visiting this again. I celebrated my birthday here and the staff and owner were all very supportive and enthusiastic about it. They even played guitar for me. It was such a special experience. Thank you 64ChaiBar for such a lovely experience.

Good place to hangout with friends those who loves tea. They have variety of tea with flavoured combinations. Also they serves yummy tasted burgers. They have shakes which I ordered but I didn’t like that much because they used fruit syrup and lots of sweetness.

Best place for Chai and snacks. Everyone at the cafe was so humble. We got our order on time. Ambiance was great. The food was delicious. Also, first tea is free!! Add this place in your bucket list as a must visit! 💙

name: Secret Spot Cafe
review_texts:
Location : the cafe is located in Jayanagar main road above Kanthi sweets and  next to GIVA and other branded store. The near by metro is Jayanagar metro station.

Place : The place is such a beautiful vibe trust me you will love the spot as much as I did . It’s a 4 story building where this is in 2nd floor. Elevator and stares both are available. as soon as you open the door the the whole floor is filled with beautiful pink Bougainville followers with white and blue theme. Luckily when i had gone it was empty and i was so happy as i git best shots of the place. The place can occupy 15-20 people in one go and best for birthday parties , functions and other gatherings. Pre-book in advance for any such gathering for safer side.

Service was good , food was 3.5/5. They had both veg and non-veg consisting starters , burger, pizza ,mocktail,cocktail , main course ,desserts.
I took veg manchow Soup -4.5/5
Veg dumpling -3.5/5
Guava marry - 5/5
Cosmo classic -3.5/5
egg chilli -4/5
Veg dum biryani - 3.7/5

Overall the would give 3.7/5 for food and average costs 500-1000 per person.

Finding parking is big task for 4 wheelers are it’s main road and busy street, pets may not be allowed contact cafe, washroom can be used at sault pub which is just right to of this and they both are connected.

Overall i can say it’s must visit place for Pinteresty vibe and best pictures.

We ordered the chicken burger, but it was quite subpar. The pasta, however, was really delicious and definitely the highlight of the meal. The KitKat shake was average as well. On the positive side, the place itself looked really nice and had a good ambience.

Such a cozy and aesthetic café! Loved the vibe—warm lighting, teal seating, and perfect for a chill hangout or a casual meal. Great food, beautiful interiors, and good service too!
The staff is super friendly and always ready with a smile, making the whole experience even better. And the food?Absolutely delicious! Every dish is made with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor. Definitely a must-visit spot!
Definitely one of those spots you’ll keep coming back to. #SecretSpotBangalore

Atmosphere location sitting place everything was amazing, great service with and happy to take external requests... Food was amazing and worth price paying. I loved it specially to plan a date on timmings when there's a less traffic sound... Will go again in short.!!

Every dish here bursts with flavor and freshness. From comforting continental plates to vibrant fusion bites, the menu is a mix of creativity and comfort. Their signature desserts and handcrafted beverages are a must-try — perfect for indulging or catching up with friends.
The setting is chic yet relaxed — soft lighting, tasteful décor, and a calm vibe that instantly makes you feel at home. Whether you’re here for a quiet brunch, a romantic dinner, or an evening with friends, the mood fits just right.
The staff are friendly, attentive, and always ready with a smile. They ensure you’re well taken care of without ever being intrusive — making the experience seamless from start to finish.
Secret Spot is where good taste meets good vibes — a perfect escape within the city for food lovers and ambience seekers alike.

name: Katte Kulture
review_texts:
a genuinely charming café that gets a lot right, especially when it comes to ambience and overall experience. The place is beautifully maintained and has the feel of an old bungalow thoughtfully converted into a café, which gives it a warm and relaxed character.

One of the best parts is the mix of indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor space in the evening is especially lovely, with the roadside setting, the large tree, and the overall calm vibe making it a really pleasant place to spend time.

The service is also really good, which adds a lot to the experience and makes the place feel welcoming rather than pretentious.

Coming to the food and drinks

* The coffee is genuinely good, even if it’s not something extraordinarily memorable.
* The matcha range is also good
* The cheesecake was also nice, and overall the menu felt well done without major complaints.

Pricing is definitely on the slightly pricey side, but considering the ambience, maintenance, and service, it still feels worth visiting especially if you enjoy spending time at cafés rather than just grabbing coffee and leaving.

This café has a cozy, welcoming atmosphere and is set in a charming house that has been thoughtfully converted into a café. It’s also pet-friendly, which is a nice bonus.

We visited for lunch and enjoyed everything we ordered. The coffee was good, and the salad was fresh and flavorful. Overall, the food quality was impressive. The menu, however, felt a bit limited in terms of options.

Prices were slightly on the higher side, but not unreasonable considering the ambiance and quality of the food. The chairs could have been more comfortable, especially for a longer visit, but the pleasant vibe and good crowd made up for it.

Overall, it was a lovely experience, and I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a cozy café with good food, good coffee, and a relaxed atmosphere.

Katte Culture was recommended to me by a friend who had visited recently, and since we love exploring cafés across Bengaluru, it immediately made its way onto our list.

The café is tucked away in the quiet lanes of JP Nagar. It's a little far from where I stay, but the pleasant weather and surprisingly light Sunday traffic helped us get there in about 45 minutes. The moment we arrived, I liked the vibe. It felt like an old bungalow that had been thoughtfully converted into a café. There is a charming outdoor seating area surrounded by greenery, along with cosy indoor seating and a compact café space that houses the kitchen and counter.

What I appreciated right away was the simplicity of the menu. There aren't hundreds of options competing for your attention, which makes ordering a lot easier.

We started with the balsamic mushroom rosemary toast, and that was easily one of the highlights of the meal. It was packed with flavour, beautifully seasoned, and something I would happily order again. We also tried the cafreal chicken poi, which was equally enjoyable. The chicken ghee roast sandwich was another winner. Along with the food, we had coffee and finished with a slice of carrot cake. Honestly, everything we ordered was good.

What stood out most was the quality of the food. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, properly seasoned, and full of flavour. I had gone in with fairly high expectations because of all the recommendations, and I'm happy to say the food absolutely delivered. A perfect 10 on 10 for the food.

The service was prompt, the café was clean, and the atmosphere was exactly what I look for in a café. It was calm, quiet, and easy to have a conversation without competing with loud music. There was also a slight drizzle outside while we were there, which made the whole experience even more pleasant. If you're someone who likes working from cafés, this would be a great place to spend a few hours as well.

If I had to point out one area for improvement, it would be the pricing. The food is excellent, no doubt about that, but I felt the prices were slightly on the higher side. We spent close to ₹1,800–₹2,000 for what we ordered. While the quality justified part of the cost, I do think slightly more accessible pricing would make the experience even better.

Overall, Katte Culture is a café I genuinely enjoyed visiting. Great food, peaceful ambience, good service, and a setting that makes you want to slow down and enjoy the moment.

Will I visit again? Absolutely.

Honest review...Another house turned into a cafe... What I experienced  was the Very uncomfortable seating with small chairs made of wooden and steel or whatever  .. saw many struggling to sit comfortably. Ordered avocado Toast Nothing great for rs 380/-.. me and my friend just wanted to finish it off fast and leave! cause of the seating ..service was ok.

More and more houses are being turned into cafes, and this one in Jayanagar is another one. It has plenty of outdoor seating and a few indoor. The menu has lots of beverages like coffee, shakes, and frappes, along with some quick bites. However, the dessert choices were a bit disappointing — only 4 options on the display.

We went with a basque cheesecake and a frappe, and both tasted good. The service is simple — you order and pay at the counter, and the food is brought to your table.

One thing to keep in mind: there's no dedicated parking, so you'll have to rely on street parking, which can be tricky.

name: Iris Cafe and Kitchen - Jayanagar
review_texts:
Had a great time at Iris Café today. The ambience was calm, cozy, and surrounded by greenery — definitely a nice spot to relax over coffee and food.
The highlight for me was the Rosemary Chicken. The chicken was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked with a rich, creamy sauce that paired really well with the mashed potatoes and veggies. The coffee was also smooth and refreshing.
Overall, good food, peaceful vibes, and a place worth visiting if you want a chill café experience.

Iris Cafe and Kitchen at Jayanagar is a quaint and quiet cafe.   It has been designed to give it a heritage look with windows, doors and arches from the previous century.

The food was excellent, but the service left much to be desired.  Maybe they have a shortage of waiters.   After we were seated we had to wait for long and call one of them to get a menu.   It took another 10 minutes to ask for water to be served.   15 minutes after placing an order, we were told that Pina Colada was not available.    Another 20 minutes later they came back and said that one of the main courses - Ravioli that we ordered was not available.    In all it took over 45 minutes or more to get all the dishes that we subsequently ordered.

But whatever was served, was quite good and presented beautifully.

Crispy Lotus Stems Honey Chilli - These were good but too spicy for my liking.

Mushroom Chicken Steak - Grilled Chicken Breast with Mushroom Sauce, Veggies and Mashed Potatoes.    We loved this.   It was quite good and the quantity was substantial.

Paneer Fillet - Seared Paneer served with Pesto Sauce, Veggies and Herbed Rice.   This was also a tasty option for vegetarians.

Stuffed Mushrooms Au Gratin - Mushrooms stuffed, deep fried and Baked with Cheese on Top.  These were quite tasty too, but the need to deep fry could have been avoided.

Fruit Punch - This was a fruity ice cream shake with scoops of melon and quite refreshing.

They do have a lot of options and will definitely keep visiting.   Prices seem reasonable compared to a lot of new cafes in and around Jayanagar.

Food: Absolutely delightful! Every dish feels fresh, well-plated, and full of flavour. From comfort bites to hearty mains, the quality truly stands out.
Service: Warm, polite, and attentive. The staff makes you feel welcome and ensures a smooth dining experience without long waits.
Atmosphere: Cozy, aesthetic, and peaceful. Perfect lighting, comfortable seating, and a vibe that works for brunch dates, work meetings, or solo coffee time.

Overall, Café Iris is a place you’ll want to revisit for both the taste and the vibe 💛

Good options, menu items are different and gives that cafe feel. But many items are unavailable and you end up having limited options.

Seating area and ambience is great, taste was also good. Clean and neet.

They do serve fast but expect some delay as everything prepared fresh.

Lovely café with a rustic, vintage vibe and genuinely amazing service. They have another branch in JP Nagar—I’ve visited that too, and the pasta tastes better there compared to this outlet (Pink sauce pasta there is my absolute favorite, but here it was bland and was undercooked, wouldn't suggest). The paneer was good, and the drink (Deep blue ocean) was refreshing as well. We wanted to try spring roll, but it wasn’t available. Overall, a great place to hang out—solid 4 star experience.

name: Café Coffee Day
review_texts: Best coffee I’ve had from this brand, hands down. Better prepared than other outlets and stronger than most competitors nearby. The staff are fantastic—friendly, efficient, and clearly committed to quality. Highly recommended.
Great place to have a long convertion with loved one... good food... we tried hazelnut coffee... that tasts too good
Same like every CCDs, the coffees are good. But seems old building and seatings. Washroom was not that good too. Just manageable

It has indoor(non-smoking) & outdoor(smoking zone) seating, not much crowded and have good public parking space . Just that all the glasswares & cutleries they use has become too old, time to change them CCD Management.
Common washroom available.

On the occasion of International Women's Day, Café Coffee Day (CCD) at Banashankari has something special in store for all the incredible women out there. In celebration of womanhood, they are offering a free frappe to every woman who walks in on Women's Day. This thoughtful gesture is aimed at appreciating and recognizing the strength, grace, and resilience of women in all walks of life.

Whether you're a working professional, a student, a homemaker, or someone balancing multiple roles, this is a great opportunity to treat yourself or catch up with friends over a refreshing drink. CCD Banashankari is known for its cozy atmosphere, making it the perfect spot to unwind and celebrate this special day.

To avail the offer, you simply need to walk in, mention the Women's Day promotion, and enjoy your free frappe. It’s CCD's way of saying “thank you” for all that women do. So, take a break from your busy schedule, and head to CCD Banashankari to enjoy a delightful frappe on the house!

Terms and conditions may apply, so it's always a good idea to confirm with the café directly. Happy Women's Day!

name: The Bangalore Cafe
review_texts: Absolutely delightful place for a family meal! The restaurant has a fantastic ambience, with a light breeze, open air, and overall great cleanliness. The taste and quality of the food is just amazing - every dish is carefully prepared and the ingredients are fresh. There is a wide range of cuisines to choose from and each dish is simply delectable! A special thanks goes to our server, Umesh, who took extra efforts to ensure that each dish was delivered in time, and that all dietary restrictions were taken care of. The staff was overall courteous and extremely efficient. Overall a great experience! Would highly recommend!

Has a variety of fusion dishes, and enjoyed all the ones we ordered.
1. Mojo bites (Pesto Mushroom)
2. Shukla ki Potli (Fried Dimsums sort of)
3. Vada Pav (decent, but can be skipped, it's just Aloo sandwich really)
4. Hakka Noodles
5. Cocktail Samosa

For main course, tried their Peshawari Kofta, Chur Chur Naan - each and every item was true to its name in terms of taste.
Very decent prices given the ambience, quality, and location.
Highly recommended!

Had lunch at The Bengaluru Cafe, and it was a pleasant experience. The café has a simple yet elegant ambience with a calm and welcoming atmosphere, making it a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal.
The food was delicious, fresh, and well prepared, and the service was prompt and courteous. The prices are a little on the higher side, but the quality of the food, ambience, and overall experience make it worth it.
Would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone looking for a good lunch spot in Bengaluru.

Good ambience and delicious food. We had Litti ka Chokha, Hariyali Paneer, Malai Naan, Butter Roti. Paneer Lajawab was too good. For desserts, Rishta pakka came with icecream on top of small gulab jamuns. Had a great time.

One of my favorite vegetarian restaurants in Bengaluru! I’ve visited multiple times, and the food has always been excellent. The Paneer Kariyapak is a must-try, and the Orange Blossom mocktail is super refreshing. Great ambience, good service, and consistently delicious food. Highly recommended! Gagan did an excellent job while serving the food.

name: Truffles - Indiranagar
review_texts:
We had a really good experience overall. Since we had to stick to vegetarian food that day, we tried the Peri Peri Paneer, and it was packed with flavors—absolutely delicious. The All American Burger was crunchy and satisfying, and both the cheese quality and the bread really elevated the burger. I had heard a lot about this place, and I’d say it’s definitely worth trying.

I’m sure the non-vegetarian options would be even better, so that’s something I’d love to try next time.

The only downside was that the service was a bit delayed. However, the food definitely made up for the wait. Overall, it was a satisfying experience.

Truffles, Indiranagar is a great spot for burgers, desserts, and comfort food. The place has a lively vibe and is usually buzzing with people, especially in the evenings. I tried their burgers and shakes, and the taste was really good with generous portions. The menu has a wide variety of options including veg and non-veg dishes, pastas, pizzas, and desserts. Service is fairly quick despite the crowd, and the staff is friendly. Prices are reasonable for the quantity and quality. Overall, a nice place to hang out with friends and enjoy good food in Indiranagar

I went to Truffles Indiranagar on new year 2026. 1st January 2026. With my friends to celebrate the new year. The place is at a very good location and is near to the indiranagar metro station.

People had to queue up and wait for tables to get clear. The food was amazing right from the starter to the main course and the dessert.

The place had amazing vibes to it. This is a must visit place along with friends for superb burgers, pastas, desserts and main course. Non veg was excellent.

Truffles is a great spot for an affordable and satisfying meal. We ordered the Double Cheese Mushroom Burger, All American Veg Burger, Irish Coffee Shake, and a Green Apple Granita for two, and the total came to around ₹830, which felt very reasonable for the quantity and quality.

The All American Veg Burger with the double patty was definitely the showstopper loaded with cheese and perfect for cheese lovers. The Double Cheese Mushroom Burger was equally filling, and both burgers were served with chips and sauces on the side. The shakes and drinks were refreshing too.

Dessert wise, their apple pie is a must-try. However, I’m personally not a big fan of their lasagna.

The location is easy to reach from the metro, service is good, and the staff is polite. It does get quite crowded on weekends, with a wait time of around 15–20 minutes depending on the rush.

Overall, a perfect place for brunch or a casual meal with friends.

I visted on weekend with friends, there is always waiting over here. It took us 30 mins to enter. Service was very slow thanks to crowd. Burger and salad were fulfilling but drinks can be improved a lot. We orderes chocolate cheescake and honestly it wasn't upto the mark.

name: Glens Bakehouse
review_texts:
Glen’s Bakehouse is one of the most popular pastry shops in Bangalore, and we visited the place for dinner. Since it was a Saturday, the café was fully crowded, which shows how loved it is.

We ordered pancakes, pizza, and their super-cute little cupcakes, and everything tasted delicious. I personally enjoyed the fluffy pancakes with blueberry dip and the red velvet cupcake the most 😋😋

It truly lived up to the hype and was totally worth it! 🌟

This is one of favourite places in Banglore, loved the vibe the people and especially the desserts..
Great ambiance, friendly staff
The cozy, homely vibe with fresh baking aromas hits you right away.

Desserts to die for: Their cheesecakes and red velvet cupcakes are insanely creamy and flavorful – best I've had in the city!
Fresh bakes & savory bites: Grabbed croissants, mutton puffs, and a sourdough pizza; everything was buttery, flaky, and perfectly seasoned.

Great coffee & service: Signature coffee paired perfectly, and the staff is super friendly and quick, even on a busy day.
Veg-friendly options: Loved the hummus samosa and broccoli soup – plenty for vegetarians like me.

Value spot: Affordable prices for such quality; ideal for brunch or quick grabs.

If you're in Bangalore, skip the chains and head to Glen's – you'll be hooked! Highly recommend

Glen's Bakehouse definitely has a lovely, rustic, and cozy ambiance—it’s a great spot if you just want to sit, relax, and catch up with friends. However, the food itself was pretty average and didn't quite live up to the hype.
We tried a few of their baked goods and savory items. While their signature mini red velvet cupcakes are decent, some of the other pastries felt a bit dry and lacking in freshness. The savory dishes (like the sandwiches/pizzas) were standard cafe fare—not terrible, but definitely not exceptional for the price you pay.
The service was alright, though slightly slow since the place tends to get quite crowded.
Overall, it's a nice place for the aesthetics and a basic cup of coffee, but if you are going purely for top-tier bakery items or a memorable meal, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

Visited Glen’s Bakehouse and had a very satisfying meal. The Barley Chicken Salad was fresh and well balanced, the Chicken Lasagna was rich, flavorful, and perfectly baked, and the Chicken American Corn Quiche had a nice creamy texture with a good blend of chicken and sweet corn. We also tried the Blueberry Cheesecake, which was smooth and delicious with just the right sweetness.

Overall, the food quality was excellent and the service was quick. A great place for a relaxed meal and desserts. Would definitely visit again.
Good to hangout or catch up with friends. Not ideal for focused work or large gatherings. Crowded around the weekends. No music ambience. Food is good. Depends on what you order. Coffee was nice.

name: Nanav Cafe
review_texts: Loved the cozy vibe and the beautifully done aesthetics. The service was great, and the coffee hit the spot. I had their English breakfast and waffles—both were delicious. No wait time either, which was a bonus. Would definitely visit again!

The service here in the cafe was top notch. The staff were very friendly. One thing what I liked about the service was, one of the waiter actually cared to tell us that the hazelnut coffee could be too sweet for our liking( it was something which I felt lacked in few other cafés). The atmosphere was really comforting too. It’s a really nice place to hang out with your friends. Coming to the food, everything we ordered was good , definitely recommend their shakshouka. I felt the waffles could have been a bit better( felt a bit dry). Overall a good experience, definitely a place to try out once 👌.

I had contacted them to book a table for a group I wanted to host. Firstly, they mentioned a ₹500 cover charge per person. When I probed further, they clarified that we didn’t need to pay in advance, but that there was a minimum order value of ₹500 per person. I was completely okay with that because a meal and coffee would easily cost that much.

When we arrived, the owner screamed at me because the number of people wasn’t exactly the same as what I had initially mentioned. His reason was that he had cancelled some bookings for us. There was literally zero crowd or waiting at the cafe, it was empty.

Secondly, we started by ordering drinks, and they were terrible. Even a simple Americano was not worth it. When we told them that we didn’t enjoy the drinks and therefore didn’t want to order food, he literally screamed at us and started fighting with us. Also, asked us to walk out of the cafe

Worst cafe experience in Bangalore.

Chill place to have a nice brunch! The staff were very kind, service was good. Food was great too! Atmosphere was nice and quiet too. The waffles were decent. English breakfast was very good and the coffee was top notch!
The brunch was amazing, the place had calming vibes and ambience. The food was delicious but the service time is long. The portion size was  also good.

name: Cafe Muziris
review_texts:
I had heard a lot of great things about Cafe Muziris, so I finally decided to drop by this afternoon, and it absolutely lived up to the hype!
The ambience and vibe were amazing, creating a super cozy and welcoming atmosphere the moment we walked in.
The staff was incredibly friendly and gave us some food recommendations that were honestly it was great.
We tried their Alfredo Pasta, which had a wonderfully distinct and rich taste, and the Cottage Cheese and Chips, a really unique dish where the paneer was perfectly stuffed and served alongside crispy fries.
To top it all off, the Kaapi Affogato was absolutely wonderful—unlike most cafes where the coffee is just average, the brew here was exceptional.
I highly recommend this place for fantastic food, stellar coffee, and a great environment, and I will definitely be back!

I was checking for best coffee spot near Indiranagar and got their suggestions on Gmap. Every reviews were hyping their signature drinks. So I thought of giving it a try and it was really matching the hype !

The ambience was good enough to spend few hours working there. They have some good collection of novels for book lovers.

They have outdoor seating as well but it's not a semi-covered so you get some amount sunlight over there I would recommend people who enjoy extra strong Vitamin D3 !

We came here for the specialty coffee that they claim to serve but they absolutely do not serve any specialty coffee, cold brew, or pour over whatsoever.

When I requested the specialty coffee they gave me a weak, filtered coffee, and they have the arrogance to think I can’t tell the difference. When I challenged them on this, they said it was a pour over that they did at the counter, I couldn’t see it as we were seated outside. When they offered to change it, they came back with another filtered coffee, insisting it was a pour over. When I went inside to pay the bill, there was no sign of a V60 or pour over equipment.

Not only this, the cappuccino that my wife ordered wasn’t professionally made as the milk and foam was thin, indicating they may not have trained baristas. Plus, the food was poor. The scrambled eggs was the worst I’ve had in Bangalore, and the sausages were the cheap, hot dog type you get in a tin, which are highly carcinogenic. My wife ordered a shakshuka which was served to her straight from a microwave - the bowl was hot and the shakshuka was dry and sticking to the bowl. It was also a very small portion (see the photo).

Overall a disappointing experience. We felt that the staff are pretending to offer specialty coffee while serving up watered-down filter coffee from a press, and charging high prices for them. This is unprofessional and needs to be called out.

Food is good, cute cafe with great ambiance. However when we came for breakfast, there was noise from dragging tables and chairs for an event arrangement. Post that group of people who were organising or related to the event started talking so loud. This spoiled the whole vibe. Please consider that customers prefer calm environment and not loud noises when having food in a cafe

A cute little cafe tucked in the lanes, hidden from the busy roads of indiranagar.  Cafe muziris is a one of my favourite places to visit again and again for its good food and chill vibes. It's my go to place to have a conversation over some hot chocolate and coffee. Whatever I have eaten there be it - veg pasta, chicken pesto or even peri peri fries, everything tastes clean, the portions are really good and its always served with a smile. Being located in the inner lanes, you should be able to get roadside parking along the road. The only reason I give food a 4 is cos their menu is limited, but whatever they have is really really well cooked. For example the mashed potatoes I had on the side of my chicken pesto was perhaps the finest I had, they really put in a lot of effort to get that smooth texture and the little pieces of garlic to add a taste note. Chefs kiss.

name: Paper & Pie
review_texts:
If you are looking for the ultimate Sunday breakfast spot, this is it. I visited with a group of friends, and it was the highlight of our weekend.

The food is absolutely fantastic. We ordered a variety of dishes to share, including a classic English breakfast and some incredible pancakes and French toast that were the perfect level of sweet. The standout for me, however, was the avocado and confit beetroot toast—the flavors were unique, fresh, and beautifully presented.

Beyond the plate, the ambience was wonderful—vibrant yet relaxed enough for a long catch-up. The service was also top-notch; the staff was attentive and friendly without being intrusive.
Highly recommended for anyone wanting a high-quality meal in a great atmosphere!

Paper & Pie in Indiranagar is such a charming place — cozy, welcoming, and perfect for a relaxed catch-up or a quiet coffee break. The desserts are the real stars here: fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious. The pies and cakes taste homemade, not overly sweet, and clearly made with quality ingredients.

Their coffee pairs really well with the desserts, and the overall vibe of the café makes you want to linger a little longer. The staff is friendly and attentive, which adds to the pleasant experience.

Definitely a go-to spot in Indiranagar if you’re craving good desserts, coffee, and a calm café atmosphere. Will be coming back for sure!

Tried out Paper & Pie and here’s the honest take—

The vibe is clean and nice—one of those places that makes you feel slightly more productive just by sitting there.

Coffee? Solid. Egg options? Actually pretty great. Sandwiches? Let’s just say they won’t be solving world hunger anytime soon. 😄
Cold coffee was a win though, and the pudding felt like it was trying to be healthy… and mostly succeeding.

Is this some mind-blowing, life-changing café? Nah. But that’s kind of the charm.

It’s a really good spot to sit down, get some work done, have a proper conversation with a friend, or even sneak in a meeting without it feeling like a corporate box.

Overall—good food, good coffee, clean vibe, zero drama. Not extraordinary, but reliably nice… and honestly, that’s sometimes exactly what you need.

I had salmon egg benedict and custard apple chia seed pudding. The egg benedict tasted good. The quantity as very less though and the cost was really high. The chia seed pudding had only chia seeds I felt. It was healthy for sure but taste was very average even with all fruits and nuts. Overall I felt the taste and quality of foods to be average but for this cost I definitely wouldn’t recommend this place. The ambience was really good with really spacious seating. The service was also good. Overall for this price I wouldn’t recommend this place unless you’re planning to work from cafe!

Visited Paper & Pie and had a really pleasant experience. We tried a mix of hot and cold beverages, along with their croissant and a couple of pastas

The croissant was the highlight for me perfectly flaky, buttery, and freshly baked. I also loved the hot chocolate which was rich and comforting. The beverages overall were well done.

The pastas were okay decent in taste, but not something I’d go back specifically for.

The ambience is cozy and relaxed, making it a nice place to sit and unwind. Overall, a great cafe for drinks and baked goods, with a calm vibe.

name: The Cafe- Lot Like Crepes
review_texts:
Atmosphere is very calm. You will feel like you are not in the city.
The food was great.
I ordered crepes all Indian English breakfast.
Mango berry strawberry loaded Nutella pancake was amazing.
Service is sometimes little slow depending upon staffs availability.  I have been to this place twice abd definitely will visit again for crepes

The cafe has a calm and soothing atmosphere that instantly makes you feel relaxed.
It's a wonderful place to spend the evening with both open-air and shaded seating options. I really loved their mango curd… I ended up ordering it twice! If you like mango, you should definitely try it

Great ambiance quite peaceful perfect for breakfast. Had english breakfast and Pancakes. English Brekfast was good a little salty but that's how it's supposed to be. Pancakes were not worth it neither the taste nor the price.

Good place to try. But won't repeat again 540/- for once person breakfast is too much for me.

But yeah Great place to try out.

Ambiance: 10/10
Food: 8/10
Price: $$$

Excellent service by the owner/manager of this cafe! Thank you Mr Papan for the service and hospitality. We ordered Sausage crepe and the kids found it too spicy and he was kind enough to make us a new batch of non spicy sausage crepe! The boys also had the opportunity to feed the rabbits!

The crepe both savoury and sweet was a great start to our brunch! We will be back!

Fantastic place to spend some good peaceful time with good food in nature. It is all covered with plants and feels so fresh. Staff is polite and we got fast service as well.
Cold coffee was made perfect and just on the point (not too sugary and strong) as instructed and even garlic bread felt so lignt and tasty. Banana Nutella crepe was decent too.
There are cute little rabbits as well who make the place more beautiful. Since the place is not a typical city AC cafe, mosquitoes do come in evenings and after but staff makes sure to provide you with a repellent coil. They can’t do anything more about it as it’s a natural place and so, plants and animals will be a part of it.

We had a good time there and will recommend the place if you are looking for a calm and nature friendly place.

name: Paper & Pie
review_texts:
**Food: 3/5 | Service: 2/5**

Ordered the avocado toast, hazelnut iced coffee, chicken crepe, orange cinnamon brew, and chicken bagel.

The avocado toast is apparently their best seller, but the bread was way too hard — difficult to cut and even harder to bite into. The hazelnut iced coffee was decent, nothing special. The chicken crepe was actually good. The orange cinnamon brew was disappointing — tasted mostly of cinnamon with barely any coffee flavor and no sweetness. After asking them to add more coffee and some sugar syrup, it got better, but still not great. The chicken bagel was below average — very little chicken filling for what it costs.

The biggest issue here is the service. We sat at our table for 10 minutes and no one came to give us a menu. Had to ask for it ourselves. Then we asked a waiter for recommendations — he said he'd send someone else and just disappeared. Waited another 5 minutes. We kept having to turn around and wave at staff who were all just standing at the reception. No one actually walks around to check on tables.

At one point I noticed a table waiting for cutlery after their food had already been served. That says it all.

The prices feel high for what you get, both in terms of food quality and experience. If you're not in a rush and don't mind chasing the staff, it's manageable. But it really shouldn't be like that.

Visited Paper & Pie in Whitefield recently and had a really nice experience. The café has a very calm and aesthetic vibe, perfect if you want to relax or have a long conversation over coffee. The interiors are bright and cozy, making it a lovely spot to spend some quiet time.

We ordered the hazelnut cold coffee and the banoffee coffee, and both were absolutely delicious. The hazelnut cold coffee had a rich, nutty flavor and was perfectly chilled, while the banoffee coffee had a smooth blend of banana and toffee notes that made it unique and indulgent.

The ambience is definitely one of the highlights of this place—comfortable seating, good lighting, and a peaceful atmosphere. It’s a great café for coffee lovers or anyone looking for a laid-back hangout in Whitefield.

Overall, a great spot for good coffee and good vibes. Would definitely visit again!

This Paper & Pie is my regular coffee shop to read/work from. It’s spacious, food and drinks are great, it’s got outside seating, as well as a great space for walking in between meetings or book chapters right outside the cafe.

I love coming here and getting a great coffee/matcha, tuning out the world and focusing on what’s in front of me.

The coffee here is excellent and is the main reason I keep coming back. Both the hot and cold coffee options are consistently delicious. I especially love pairing my coffee with the almond croissant or butter croissant—they’re always fresh, crispy, and perfectly baked.

However, the vegetarian food options are quite limited, and the taste could definitely be improved. We tried the avocado toast, but unfortunately, it wasn’t good at all. The taste was so disappointing that we couldn’t even finish it.

The only downside is the pricing. It’s quite expensive—for example, a hazelnut mocha cold coffee and an almond croissant cost around ₹650. Despite that, I’d still recommend this place for its amazing coffee and freshly baked croissants.

I have visited this place multiple times and absolutely love the ambience and calm vibe. It’s a great spot to sit and work, and I’ve spent a few days working from here comfortably. There’s ample parking available, which is a big plus.
I have tried various dishes, and the Alfredo penne and the bowls really stood out for me. Their mocha is one of my favorites, and almost all the desserts I’ve tried have been excellent. Overall, it’s a great place to visit—whether you want to work peacefully or just hang out with friends.

name: Hot Coffee
review_texts: This place is near mahalakshmi metro. It was a small darshini then but now it is a medium sized hotel. Multiple menu options, all karnataka veg cousine. This place is on service road, so finding parking is bit tricky. Go here any day and you will enjoy the food. There is a place to sit and eat as well. But no action rooms. Avalakki bath, Shaving bath are must try. Dosa, idli and usual anyway. Place is maintained clean and tidy. Recommended.

Spacious and well maintained fast food restaurant with seating facility. Tried  chow chow bath combination, tasty and satisfying. Vada was not crispy, tasted average and sambar had the typical darshini style taste. Overall the experience was good.
Parking for two wheelers can be managed with a little effort, but four-wheeler parking is not really feasible.

Hot Coffee turned out to be a true small-cap multibagger! The idly was smooth, the vada perfectly crispy, and the coffee was pure mood-lifter. Avalakki bath paired with chutney delivered solid returns. Quality is high, prices are reasonable, and overall experience is absolute paisa-vasool. With a 4.5-star rating, this place has strong fundamentals and long-term growth potential definitely a buy recommendation!🫡
Served delicious food. Must try is Masala Dosa, Shavige bath, Idli Vada. I jus love the coffee at Hot coffee

Food  very good , Upma , dosa , vada and coffee. The best tried . Standing and eating , in sides stone benches available. But rainy season not able to sit and eat . If they convert standing into sitting and eating, that will be a class . Happy to hit food served with smiles . Other items I am tried so comments on that .

name: MAGGI ADDA
review_texts: Maggi's taste may be simple, but the feeling remains irreplaceable," "A plate of Maggi isn't just about hunger. It's about nostalgia, comfort, and belonging," and "When life gives you chance, must visit Maggi adda😍.

Taste is good.
Menu is very very confusing.
No description also provided.

Nacho chips was sweet.
Butter Tadka Maggi was not buttery.
There was not Tadka also. The Chutney was highly spicy and gave heartburn.

Cheese chilly Grill was sweet on inside and on top Mayo made it sweet.
Schezwan Maggi is not spicy at all.

Veg Paneer Maggi was hot and nice.
Jalapeños in Chilly Maggi was not spicy at all.

Green Apple Mojito had lime and Tulsi seeds and ruined the Mojito flavour.
Oreo shake was very good. But there was some Colored hard sugar balls which was making it difficult to drink it.

Please make your menu for Maggi more understandable. Add some descriptions.
The chilly and fiery options are very confusing. It will help us choose what to order.

Portion size for each plate is large.
One plate has almost 1 and 1/2 Maggi noodle packet quantity which is difficult to finish with other things.
Hope they reduce portions to so we can eat other things too.

Pro’s
- Serving good taste of food.
- Presentation of food is very impressive.
- People who are taking order will always carry smile on there face.
- They suggest good and best in the menu they have.
- Always playing good sound track.

You need to try veg cheese burger it was better then rest of the top selling restaurants.

So far no con’s, in future if I found sure will update.

Loved this place. And guys after I reviewed this place I bought Chocolate Shake I can't believe I Never tried that kinda Chocolate Shake it's was marvolus and unbelievable. I'm a chocolate lover so ya I enjoyed it totally any other chocolate lovers who see this review don't forget to visit this place for the Shake and others don't miss this you'll fall in love with it. I'm sure that you'll love it. I hope this review was helpful :) :)

Everything I tried was just wow and lip smacking taste, wide range of Maggie, mock tails , sandwiches and a lot more and everything is unique and taste was beyond.
Peri peri Maggie : 5/5
Peri peri French fries :5/5
Litchi mock tail :  5/5
Corn cheese sandwiches: 5/5

name: Third Wave Coffee
review_texts:
It was a fine experience at Third Wave Coffee. I enjoyed the Sea Salt Mocha Coffee, which was a new experience. We liked the Chicken Pizza in food.

Staff was friendly and quick on processing the order. Cafe has a good number of tables. During day time it was not too crowded.

A free wifi for customer is available if required, however it will require registration using mobile number.

Tried their new desserts at Third Wave, and they were absolutely delicious! The coffee was excellent, the staff were friendly and welcoming, and the overall vibe was amazing. Definitely looking forward to coming back—this is going to be my regular spot from now on! ☕🍰

The ambience and service were lovely! We thoroughly enjoyed the blueberry cheesecake, OG chocolate cake, and Japanese matcha 🍵. The cakes could have been a bit more flavorful and slightly less sweet, but they were still very enjoyable as they were ❤️.

We ordered a hot tiramisu latte, an iced latte, and the peri peri fries. The fries were delicious, and the iced latte was really good. The tiramisu latte was ok. Definitely recommend this place in Koramangala. The cafe is spacious, with lots of seating indoors, and limited outdoor seating as well. The service was exceptional - special shoutout to Jason.

Have been coming here since the cafe started. However, became more regular after I moved to Koramangala and started working in a hybrid setup. The cafe has great vibe for work, meeting, or just catching up with friends. Staff if friendly and courteous. And the coffee is always great.
They have revamped the interiors recently and its a good refresh. However, would have preferred more individual sitting areas keeping the customer profile in mind.
Always my preferred place to walk into.

name: Dialogues Cafe Koramangala
review_texts: Really loved spending time at Dialogue Cafe. The place has such a cozy and peaceful vibe, perfect for chilling with friends or getting some work done. Their co-working space is comfortable and thoughtfully designed, which made working there really easy. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the food and coffee were genuinely good. I especially enjoyed the desserts and the calm atmosphere. It’s one of those places where you can easily spend hours without noticing the time.

Had a great experience at Dialogues Cafe. The ambiance is warm and cozy, and the food is really good.

What really stands out is how versatile the place is.. you can hang out with friends, celebrate special moments, read a book, or play games. On weekdays, it’s also perfect for getting some quiet work done.

They also host a lot of community events, which adds a really nice vibe and makes the space feel even more lively and inclusive.

Overall, it feels like a place where you can do a bit of everything. Definitely recommend visiting!

Honestly, one of the best work cafés I've been to. The moment you walk in, someone — either the owner or the manager — greets you, and that warmth just sets the tone for the whole experience. I ended up staying for almost 5–6 hours without even realising it. Never happens to me at a café.
The vibe is incredibly cozy and vibrant. There are books everywhere — inside and on the rooftop — and the space has little activity corners where you can draw, paint, or just play board games. That day there was something happening on the rooftop too. Best part? They never ask you to leave. You just... exist there, and it feels good.
Food-wise, I ordered five dishes and spent only ₹1,600, which is great value. The chicken quesadilla and the café mocha were absolute standouts. The hazelnut coffee mocha was really good too. The hummus pita platter was a bit bland for my taste, and the bread was stiff initially — but when I flagged it, they replaced it with softer bread without any fuss, which I appreciated. The watermelon cooler was okay, not the most impressive.
Overall, a place that genuinely makes you feel welcome and comfortable. Will definitely be back — laptop in tow. 🌿

Visited Dialogues Cafe today and had a cappuccino and watermelon juice. Both were decent in taste and the quality vs price felt fair. Nothing over the top and satisfactory overall.
The place is quiet and calm and perfect if you want to sit peacefully. The ambience is simple and minimal not fancy but comfortable.

What really stood out was the hospitality. The staff were polite well behaved and helpful throughout our visit.
This is a great spot for conversations small office work and meetings especially since they also have separate meeting and office rooms which is a big plus.

✔️ Calm and quiet
✔️ Good service
✔️ Work friendly
✔️ Decent food and pricing

Overall a nice place to relax work or catch up without noise.

This is such a beautiful cafe with great food and drinks. I met my friend here for lunch.

The ambience was peaceful. The decor is very vibrant.

I ordered a herbed rice with paneer and veggies bowl and a mausambi tonic. I was told I am the first customer to order a mausambi tonic.The bowl was really delicious and the drink was refreshing.

My friend ordered something like paratha and paneer keema and a cafe latte. She said that the coffee was not too sweet (thats a good thing!) and the taste reminded her of Blue Tokai coffee.

This cafe had great vegetarian options.

The staff were very friendly and attentive as well.

name: Story Coffee House
review_texts:
Visited Story Coffee House in Koramangala and really liked the overall vibe of the place. It’s a cozy, pet-friendly café with bookshelves, board games, and a very relaxed atmosphere, perfect for hanging out with friends or even spending some time alone. They also host events and the place is suitable for corporate meetups, birthday parties, and small gatherings.

I tried their hot chocolate, pesto rice, shrimp arrabbiata, and berry smoothie. The pesto rice was my favourite, it was very flavourful and filling. The berry smoothie was also refreshing, and the hot chocolate was nice and comforting.

They also have a great lunch combo offer for ₹299 which includes one main course, one beverage, and one dessert, which makes it a good budget-friendly option in Koramangala.

Overall, a nice café with good food, calm ambience, and a different concept with books and games. Would definitely recommend visiting.

This is best cafe in Koramangala which is based on retro vibes, each corner reminds you 80-90s vibes. The food was really very tasty. And the best part of this place you can host events, workshops, open mic and meet-up.

If cafe and books is your thing, then this place delivers it!

There's a huge collection of books, and a lot of nice places to sit, including bean bags.
The coffee was bad though, really bitter 3/5.
Would NOT recommend the coffee here.

Mango basil drink was wonderful 5/5.

BLT sandwich was very basic.
French toast was good, again nothing spectacular. The bread wasn't fresh.

Overall it's one of those places you visit for the ambience, and not the food.
I'll not be visiting again.

Very chill place with quick service. I ordered bhurji pav with iced latte. Both were very tasty and great value for money.
Strongly recommend this place if you are looking to just enjoy some coffee in peace on some bean bags

Good retro vibe and I had tasty hot chocolate ☕️

Game activities and other art related events happen over weekends and for social gatherings very much recommended

name: Marcopolo Cafe Koramangala
review_texts:
MarcoPolo Café, Koramangala – Where Food Meets the Mic 🎤☕
If you love food and secretly believe you deserve a recording contract, then MarcoPolo Café in Koramangala is your place! This lively karaoke café is where people come to eat well, sing loudly, and forget they ever had stage fear.
🎤 The Vibe
MarcoPolo isn’t just a café — it’s a mini concert arena. The ambience is fun, energetic, and full of good vibes. You’ll see people cheering, clapping, and sometimes dramatically performing like they’re on a reality show finale. Whether you’re a bathroom singer or a hidden Arijit Singh, this place lets you unleash your talent without judgment.
🍜 Food Review (Because Singing Needs Fuel!)
Now let’s talk about the real co-stars — the food.
Mushroom Manchurian – Perfectly cooked, flavorful, and just the right amount of spice. A solid snack to munch on between songs.
Veg Soup – Warm, comforting, and light. Great to soothe your throat before hitting those high notes.
Chocolate Brownie with Nuts & Ice Cream – Absolute winner! Rich, gooey brownie topped with crunchy nuts and melting ice cream. Honestly, it deserved a standing ovation of its own.
The food here isn’t just an add-on — it’s genuinely very good and thoughtfully prepared.
👏 Service & Management
The service is very good, quick, and friendly. The staff keeps the energy going and ensures everyone is comfortable. A special mention to the manager, who is not only humble and approachable but also a surprisingly good singer! It’s always fun when the management joins the musical fun.
⭐ Final Verdict
MarcoPolo Café is a perfect combination of good food, great service, and pure entertainment. Whether you’re going with friends, planning a fun evening, or just want to sing your heart out, this place won’t disappoint.
Come for the food, stay for the karaoke, and leave feeling like a star. 🌟
Highly recommended for anyone who loves music, laughter, and lively vibes!

We went on a Saturday afternoon for a quick lunch. The proces are reasonable, compared to other premium restaurants in the same area.
We had burnt garlic chicken fried rice, chocolate shake and veg burger.
The fried rice quantity was enough for one person, the taste was good, though it was a bit dry.
The Veg burger was smaller in size (it was similar to McChicken of McDonalds by size), and was supported with fries and salad.
The chocolate shake was good and delicious.

They have smoking and non smoking areas. They have karaoke nights as well, however we went in the afternoon so it was quiet.

The restaurant is on the first floor, with no parking facility available.

Overall a good budget restaurant with nice food and drink options.

Trust me guys this place is soo good and the food prices are very reasonable and damn tasty 😋....
But make sure you go with a good friend troups...
Cause my friends r too boring 😵‍💫....
They r only fun while they r eating ... because the food is too good that's why ...

The ambience is decent. Only entry is in the ground floor and the restaurant itself is in the first floor. There is no space for parking so better to find parking elsewhere and walk. Service is decent. Food was not so good and bland.
Brocolli soup- bland in taste and had a big dallop of cream which kind of altered the taste of soup after mixing. A bit of additional salt added made the flavour decent.
Burnt garlic fried rice (veg) - bland and flavourless. They gave vinegar, tomato ketchup and soya sauce for the table, additional drop of soya sauce, vinegar and pich of salt was helpful to eat the fried rice.

The price were economical compared to other cafes.

I visited this place with my friends for dinner. It’s situated in middle of so many clubs but this place is really great space to spent quality time with your friends. We have ordered multiple items and all were really yummy. They also have karaoke system so you can sing with your friends. Also the staff is friendly and the food pricing is very reasonable. I will recommend this place.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters | Koramangala
review_texts: I’ve visited Blue Tokai multiple times and have loved almost everything on their menu. The almond croissant and Japanese iced coffee are especially amazing. They also serve really good sandwiches and pesto pasta. The ambience is calm and perfect if you want to work, read, or just relax with a good coffee. Definitely one of my favorite café spots!

Visited Blue Tokai for breakfast and really loved the vibe. The setting was very aesthetic and peaceful, perfect for a relaxed morning.
The Spanish latte was perfect to start the day, and the affogato was also very good. The morning bun is a must-try for cinnamon lovers. We also tried a veggie sandwich, which was good. The spaghetti in mushroom florentine was okayish.
Overall, a great spot for coffee and a calm breakfast experience.

One of the best ambience for a cafe. Really nice work place as well. Just for people trying to spend more than a few hours, there are no fixed sofa/chairs, so it’ll be a kind of uncomfortable chair after a few hours. I just went to an hour and it was a beautiful cafe. The washrooms are really clean and inside was a very cool place.

The pictures and comments are not representative of this place. The coffee is average at best and seems to be made by someone without much barista experience — the taste was noticeably burnt. Prices are relatively high for the quality offered (cortado 230). The place itself feels quite old and isn’t particularly appealing or welcoming for non-local tourists. Overall, it didn’t meet expectations.

I’ve been working out of Blue Tokai almost every day, and it has become one of my favourite places in the city. It’s much more than just a coffee shop, it’s a comfortable, welcoming space where I can focus on work, meet clients, catch up with friends, and meetings. The staff are genuinely wonderful. They’re warm, attentive, and always make the experience feel personal. Over time, they’ve created a strong sense of community, and one of the best parts about spending so much time here is meeting new and interesting people. There’s always a great mix of freelancers, entrepreneurs, students, and coffee lovers, which gives the place a vibrant yet relaxed energy. Of course, the coffee is consistently excellent. Whether it’s a pour-over, cappuccino or cold brew, the quality is always top-notch. The food options are also very good, with enough variety to keep things interesting if you’re spending several hours here. It’s also pet friendly, which adds to the warm and inclusive atmosphere. What I appreciate most is how versatile the space is. It works equally well for deep work sessions, casual coffee breaks, brainstorming meetings, or simply unwinding with friends.
They’re currently renovating the space, and even though the upgrades are still underway, it’s clear they’re building something really exciting. I’m genuinely looking forward to seeing the final result because if the current experience is already this good, the new version is going to be outstanding.
Blue Tokai has become a part of my daily routine and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for great coffee, friendly staff, a strong community vibe and a space that adapts to whatever your day requires.

name: The White Room Coffee & Kitchen
review_texts:
I absolutely loved the ambience and overall vibe of this place—it’s warm, inviting, and perfect for a relaxing outing. The service was truly exceptional, with staff who were not only courteous but also incredibly attentive and helpful, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.
Situated in the prime Church Street area, it’s a great spot to visit while exploring the lively surroundings. All in all, it’s a wonderful destination to unwind and spend quality time with friends and family over the weekend. Highly recommended! 😊

Pleasant ambience, they have both indoor and outdoor sitting, we'll maintained dine in area. Quick service,
Ordered pink suace penne pasta and smoothie bowl which was good, friendly staff.
Washroom hygiene needs to improve. Something not matching with the ambience standards

A gem, hidden away on busy Church Street.
Top class ambiance, excellent food and drink, attentive service. Indoor and outdoor seating.
Quiet, suitable for personal and business meetings.
Mushroom soup, chicken BBQ, tea options were too good.

I had reached church street early in the morning. Found The White Room as one of the few places open for breakfast. Went there to have a quick coffee and a small meal.

The place was empty. The decor was nice and the setting cosy. I asked for a chillincheese toast but the server said it would take time. So I ordered a mushroom cheese omelette and a cappuccino. The food came fairly quickly. The cappuccino only came when I was almost done with the omelette. The omelette was okay, not bad, not amazing. The cappuccino was fine, again, nothing special.

Overall, the food was okay, the atmosphere great and the service just okay.

The place was totally empty when we went there on Sunday morning. They are located right at church street and have a dedicated parking. The ambience was quite European and the prices too! No complaints from the food overall but it wasn't brilliant too. We had mushroom cheese omelet, classic french toast and coffee. We wanted multigrain bread as mentioned in the menu but they didn't have it. We had a good experience but not sure if we'll visit again.

name: Marzipan Cafe and Bakery
review_texts: I had an absolutely great experience! Quick and friendly staff, and food (drinks, meals, and desserts) were all 10/10. As a foreigner eating here on my first day in India, I was really concerned about food safety. Turns out the cafe is really careful! They use filtered water to serve their meals/drinks. I was able to have their water, drink their tea, and even salad with no problems. I'll definitely return!

How did I miss this place? I have been around this area multiple times but i totally missed it until today!
One of my friends suggested me to meet him here and this cute cozy corner offered wonderful coffee and we also tried their cakes which were too good! The affogato I had was just amazing!
The service was quick and I will go here again to try other dishes in their menu and I highly recommend this cafe for a warm experience.

The kind of place where you can linger in peace and enjoy good food. Beware that not all of the dishes looked fresh at the end of the day, but we ordered à la carte and enjoyed a wonderful mango salad and lamb something or the other. The plain pasta aglio olio was not as good.

Love the vibe of this place. It has a great ambience nothing over the top. They haven't cramped the place they had with tables everywhere, usually what most of the cafes resort to. It has an open feel + the restroom is massive. A very rare thing. They take time to get your order ready & that just goes out to show that they are serving you fresh food. Love their feta cheese. Just hope they increase the portion sizes.

The cafe has a good, decent ambience and ideal for a cup of coffee or pastries. They have a good seating options with chairs or even sofas. Swings are another option along with the sofa giving you a comfortable feel.
The service was alright but the choice of pastries were very less and was a bit dissapointed. It's not too expensive and is on par.
The cheesecake was good so was the chocolate decadence. The scrambled egg pocket was good too and the cold coffee could have been better.

name: Indian Coffee House
review_texts:
Indian Coffee House on Church Street is one of Bangalore’s old-world gems, known for its nostalgic charm, simple comfort food, and classic filter coffee. The place still carries a vintage café vibe that reminds you of the city’s older culture and slower pace.

Popular for its omelettes, sandwiches, cutlets, and coffee, this café continues to attract students, office-goers, and longtime Bangalore lovers. I tried the bread toast with jam, veg cutlet, and coffee. The toast was simple and comforting, the veg cutlet was crisp and flavourful, and the coffee was fresh and satisfying — the perfect combination for an evening snack.

What makes this place special is not just the food, but the atmosphere. It feels authentic, unpretentious, and timeless. If you enjoy old Bangalore cafés with affordable food and nostalgic vibes, this place is definitely worth visiting.

They still continue selling their own pure coffee powder without chicory, so we picked up a 500 gm pack too.

Very disappointing experience at Indian Coffee House. I ordered the mutton cutlet and veg cutlet, but both were deep-fried in very dark, old-looking oil and tasted bad. The coffee was also really poor and did not live up to expectations at all.
Overall, this was a pathetic experience and definitely not worth the visit. The food quality needs serious improvement, especially for a place with such a well-known name.

121 Years of Bangalore’s Soul – A Morning at ICH

Most people come to the Indian Coffee House for the nostalgia; I came to witness the legends. As a local historian, I spent 3.5 hours here today, and it was a revelation.

If you visit, look for Peter. He has been serving here for 41 years. Think about that—he is the living memory of Church Street. I also sat near two brothers who have shared a table here every single day for 40 years.

Arrive at 08:15 AM. The "Golden Window" light hitting the red brick walls and the steam from the coffee is a photographer’s miracle.

You don’t come here for gourmet trends; you come for the consistency of the bread-butter, the starched white turbans, and the silence of a city that usually moves too fast. This isn't just a cafe; it’s Bangalore’s heartbeat.

A must-visit pilgrimage for anyone who wants to see the real heritage of our city. ☕🏛️✨
#BangaloreHeritage #LocalGuide #ICH #ChurchStreet #HistoryOnAPlate

India Coffee House is truly one of Bengaluru’s most iconic and nostalgic cafés, and visiting it feels like stepping back into a simpler, old-world era. Earlier known for its presence around the heart of the city near MG Road, this place continues to carry that same legacy and charm even today at its Church Street location, just off Brigade Road.
The food is genuinely satisfying and full of comfort. Their South Indian breakfast options are delicious and feel authentic, and the café is also well known for its classic sandwiches, which are simple yet packed with flavour. If you enjoy egg-based items, their omelette and egg preparations are definitely worth trying as well. The menu may not feel “modern” or fancy, but that’s exactly the beauty of it — it delivers a taste that feels familiar, reliable, and timeless.

What makes India Coffee House stand out is not just the food, but the retro ambience and traditional service style. Even though Bengaluru has changed a lot over the years, this café has managed to retain its old-school look and feel, including the traditional uniform and attire of the servers, which adds to the authenticity of the experience. It has a unique character that you don’t find in most cafés today.
Another special part of the experience is the crowd — you can still see regular customers who seem deeply connected to the place, almost like it’s part of their routine and memories. That kind of loyalty and emotional attachment speaks volumes about what this café means to the city.

That said, with the changing times and increasing competition, some renovation and better maintenance (without disturbing the original look and identity) would definitely help this iconic café stay relevant for the long run. A little more visibility, better branding, and careful upgrades can help India Coffee House continue to thrive while keeping its heritage intact.

Overall, India Coffee House is a must-visit for anyone who loves Bengaluru’s old charm, authentic food, and a café experience that feels rich with history.

Yes, I am a beverage fan and without guilt! A foamy coffee with thick milk gives me a kick. At the same time, I love to be rooted to the culture that each place holds.

In this context, a few eateries in Bengaluru hold a significant heritage tag. One such place is the Indian Coffee House. The Indian Coffee House Co-Operative was established in August 19, 1957, with more than 400 cafés across the country. The outlets under the brand name Indian Coffee House were not just cafes for the earlier generations, but hubs for common people, students and intellectuals to socialize.

With competing cafés in many cities, only a handful of Indian Coffee Houses are left.

I have had pleasant experiences at multiple outlets of the cafe. I visited the Bengaluru outlet during the week of Kannada Rajyoutsav. We ordered coffee and cutlet. The beverage was light and the snacks were decent in taste. But one thing to notice was the attire of the waiters, which is common across Kolkata, Gwalior, and Bengaluru outlets - the ones that I have visited until now.

The Bengaluru Coffee House is housed at the Church Street junction behind Mahatma Gandhi (MG) Road.  Going by information available on the Internet, the original outlet was housed at the MG Road.

name: T'ART Cafe
review_texts:
Looking for a spot that perfectly balances a calm vibe with a pleasant, chill atmosphere? ☕️✨ I recently spent some time at T’art in Forum Rex Walk, and it is such a great cafe for anyone who appreciates a simple and calm aesthetic.

Whether you’re looking for a quiet place for a professional in person meeting or a relaxed corner to catch up with friends, the ambience here is just right. It’s simple, uncluttered, and feels very peaceful even in the middle of the city.

The menu has some really lovely options! Their coffee and green tea are great, but I also loved that they have fresh juices available. For munchies, you have to try their cookies or the potato wedges, they are perfect for snacking. If you’re a bit hungrier, their sandwiches are super fresh and pair beautifully with whatever drink you choose.

A huge plus is the staff, they are incredibly polite and make the whole experience even better. If you’re near Forum Rex Walk, this is definitely a spot to check out! 📍✨

[T’art Forum Rex Walk, best cafes in Brigade Road Bangalore, quiet cafes for meetings Bengaluru, T’art Bangalore menu, fresh juices and coffee Bangalore, best cookies in Bengaluru, Forum Rex Walk food spots, chill cafes Central Bangalore, workspaces in Bangalore cafes, sandwiches and coffee Bengaluru, aesthetic cafes near MG Road, Bangalore food guide, professional meeting spots Bangalore, afternoon tea Bengaluru.]

#tart #forumrexwalk #bangalorecafes #centralbangalore #cafeworking

TRY THE CHICKEN PARMESAN AND THE BURGERS!!!! Love this place so much XO

Of course the tart and cappuccino combo is amazing.

I highly recommend this place. It is amazing. The quality is impeccable. I have come here for breakfast as well as for lunch, and I loved it both times. The menu is diverse, and the quality is amazing. I didn’t know that this place was so good, and now this has become my regular spot when I visit the Forum Rex Mall in Church Street.

T'Art Cafe is a charming little dessert spot with a great selection of baked treats and gift boxes.

We tried the pistachio lemon tart, which was nicely made but leaned more towards the lemon side than I personally preferred, though I can see it being an acquired taste for those who enjoy tangy desserts. We also picked up a macaron and brownie gift box. The macarons were delicious, light, flavourful, and well done, definitely the highlight for us. The brownies, however, were a bit underwhelming and didn’t quite match up to the rest.

The presentation is beautiful, especially if you’re looking for something to gift, and the café has a neat, aesthetic vibe. Overall, a good place for desserts, particularly for macarons, with a few items that could be improved.

This is a go to place if you want dessert. They have a wide variety of desserts. We got a bunt cake and it tasted really good. Service is good but the music is too loud. The outdoor seating is better if you want to sit and talk , but its also hot their in summar.

Both the coffee and the cakes were top-notch. The decor is beautiful as well
If I lived nearby, this would definitely be a place I’d come to often.

분위기도 좋고 커피, 케익 다 맛있어요🤗

name: Cafe Azzure
review_texts: I have a long list of places to visit, and Cafe Azzure has been slipping from me visiting them for a very long time.  Until recently, I paired up with my daughter and ended up here on a beautiful overcast afternoon and immediately fell in love with the bright azure blue and white interiors, transporting you to a slice of Greek Islands, in an instant.  The cafe being located on the rooftop, overlooking the busy MG Road was an added plus.  We ordered some peri peri fries to go with a cold frappe, as we ordered a main to share.  The alfredo spaghetti was a bit too creamy and saucy, but was a delicious one with the garlic bread, a little bit al dente would have been nicer, but this version was superb from taste, not so from texture.  We loved their coffee game and loved the overall meal and the experience, and promise to return soon as a family for a complete meal, more on that in an upcoming post in the future.

Great place to work, meet, and enjoy food!
I had twisted pizza here and it was really good. This is a nice place where you can comfortably do meetings or work, and also enjoy food at the same time. The staff is very supportive and friendly. The atmosphere is perfect for working as well as spending quality time with friends. Overall, a great place to relax, work, and have a good time with friends.

Cool peaceful place, Good place to work away from office.. amazing food, Good service. Good light music.. indoor and outdoor - both ambience is good in its own way. Great view of metro rail pass. Great place for celebrating an occasion. Seating spread is very good, not conjested. Sofa and wooden seating.. Great italian style

The place is well maintained and clean. The colour theme of the place gives the vibes of a good cafe, as expected. It's a good place to relax and spend time. The food was good, and priced to match the ambience. However the portions could've been larger for the price it is offered. The service was good and the staff were kind enough to explain about the dishes and servings. I hope to see them increase the quantity of food served in the future.
Few might find it challenging to find the cafe, due to the absence of sign boards on the road. It is located on the same floor as the "sky deck".

We had an amazing time at Cafe Azzure. The ambiance is awesome, and it easily offers the best view of the city and the metro rail, making the whole dining experience feel special.
​The food was the absolute highlight:
​French Fries (Peri Peri): Really good with a great kick!
​Thai Basil Pesto: The flavoring in the pesto paste was AWESOME.
​Truffle Oil Mushroom Pizza: Really amazing, perfectly baked, and packed with flavor.
​Enchanted By The Sakura Mist: A beautiful and unique drink. It was really nice, and I’ve honestly never had anything like it anywhere else.
​We also tried the Broccoli Cheddar Soup and the Bombay Masala Sandwich, and everything tasted fresh and delicious. Definitely worth every single penny. Highly recommended for great food, stunning views, and excellent value for money!

name: Cafe Noir Indiranagar
review_texts:
Cafe Noir is perfectly located right next to Pizza 4P’s, tucked into the lively vibe of Indiranagar. We visited on a Saturday for dinner—while the indoor seating was quite full, the outdoor area was pleasantly calm (minus a few insects 🙃). The ambience overall is really inviting.

We tried their mocha frappe, which was pure bliss! Alongside that, the OG smash burger was absolutely delicious, and the prawn ravioli—wow! Easily one of the best I’ve had so far.

They also have a good selection of wine for those who enjoy it. Overall, it’s a great spot to check out if you’re in Indiranagar.

Went to Cafe Noir for lunch and it honestly exceeded expectations. Their pizzas are next level — perfectly thin crust with super fresh ingredients that you can actually taste in every bite.

We tried the burrata sun-dried tomato verde, and the cheese was chef’s kiss — so creamy and spreadable across the whole slice.

Also had the lamb ragu meatballs and prawn ravioli — both a solid 10/10.

For drinks, the crunchy Biscoff shake was so good, and ended with a blueberry croissant which is an absolute must-try ✨

This place is well known for its food, and food-wise everything was good. The taste and quality definitely stand out.

However, the ambience could use some improvement. Since it’s a café, adding a bit more aesthetic appeal would enhance the overall experience. The washroom also wasn’t very clean and needs better maintenance.

Service was okay, staff were doing their job, though not particularly warm or exceptional.

Overall, it’s a very good place if you’re going primarily for the food.

Café Noir in Indiranagar is a super chill spot. I loved the cozy interiors and laid-back vibe. Great place to catch up with friends or even sit with your laptop for a bit. I tried their croissant and hot chocolate — both were really good! The menu has a nice mix of French and continental dishes, and most of it looks tempting.

The service when I went was a bit slow, and we had to remind them about our order. Also, a couple of items felt a little overpriced for the portion. But overall, the experience was really lovely. Would definitely come back!

food and Coffee was great! Loved visiting. JOSHUA was super helpful and sweet. Food is definitely on the higher side but it's justified taste wise. Would love to visit again.

Only con is their outside seating which is beautiful but as soon as the sun sets there's dozens of mosquitoes. Literally enveloping you, which is very scary and dangerous. They should really do some type about that.

name: Anaia Cafe
review_texts:
Tried the Strawberry Vanilla Iced Tea and Aglio Olio. The iced tea was really good, quite different and yum. The rating is for that drink.
The pasta was decent. The place can get crowded on weekends, so don’t expect to sit there for long as the staff will ask you to leave as soon as you are done.

We ordered two cold coffees, loaded fries, and chicken.
The cold coffee tasted average—more like a Bonvita-based drink with less sugar.
The loaded fries were satisfying, with a generous portion size.
The chicken avengers was okay overall, but had a strong curry leaf flavor. Despite being described as spicy, it wasn’t spicy at all.
The ambience was pleasant and ideal for a long, relaxed conversation.
The staff were warm, attentive, and very courteous.

I don’t drink coffee, so this review is a mix of her coffee experience and my ambience-first perspective.

Starting with the coffee (purely based on my friend’s take):
She genuinely liked it. The coffee had a strong, distinct flavour and didn’t feel like the usual “generic café coffee.” You can tell they’ve actually worked on the brew, not just served something standard.

Coming to ambience and vibe—it’s good. Not crazy, not mind-blowing, but solid Indiranagar café energy. Clean, comfortable, well-located, and easy to chill at. If you’ve been around Indiranagar cafés a lot, this won’t shock you—but it also won’t disappoint.

Food & pricing:
Everything is on the pricier side, but honestly, that’s expected for an Indiranagar café. Nothing felt bad, just not something that makes you want to come back again and again.

Good ambience & lighting & mild music.
Courterous n helful staff.
Has hanwash.
Loved the taste.. Tried newest item on thirr menu & it was amazing.
(joked to my friend gobi manchurian that went abroad)

Had a mixed experience at Anaia Cafe.

The pesto pasta and alfredo pasta were amazing - rich, flavourful, and perfectly cooked. The fries and garlic bread were also good.

The ambience was really nice, and service was good as well, which made the overall experience pleasant.

The only disappointment was the hot chocolate. It tasted more like Bournvita than actual hot chocolate.

The highlight of our visit was the cheesy butter garlic broccoli - so good that we ended up ordering it three times! Definitely a must-try.

Price-wise, it’s not exactly expensive, but the portions are quite small, which makes it feel a bit pricey for the quantity.

Overall, great taste and atmosphere - just wish the portion sizes were better.

name: Copper + Cloves Indiranagar
review_texts:
