Copper + Cloves is a beautiful, plant-based oasis in Bangalore that is perfect for escaping the city's chaotic traffic. The vibe is incredibly serene, filled with lush greenery and a fantastic collection of books if you want to spend a quiet day out with clean food.

The Hits: The coconut matcha and seasonal matcha were absolutely great. The breakfast plate was amazing, and the toasties were another big hit at our table.

The Miss: The vegan khabuska was just not for us. Three of us couldn't even finish half of it, but unfortunately, we still had to pay full price for it.

Overall, it is a lovely spot for wholesome food and a peaceful atmosphere, just be mindful of what you order!

Copper + Cloves is my absolute favorite place to eat and chill! The food is so delicious and satisfying. The entire menu is completely healthy & plant-based, and the dishes that I have tasted have been so flavourful, filling and beautifully presented! The plating is impeccable, and you can tell that so much thought goes into every meal The Cafe also has such a warm and cozy atmosphere. The aesthetics look so effortless and lovely. Even the team is so approachable, kind and welcoming. Very efficient. My visits to Copper + Cloves have been wonderful, and I always leave feeling very well looked after!  A huge bonus is that Copper + Cloves is pet-friendly!!!!! (I think my pets get more excited than I do, whenever we're headed there haha!) I would 100% recommend Copper + Cloves to everyone actually💯♥️

Had a fantastic brunch today! The place was incredibly busy, so we waited around 20–25 minutes for a table, but it was absolutely worth it. The food took a little longer than expected, but the outstanding hospitality from the staff more than made up for it. Everyone was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, making us feel right at home. Great food, excellent service, and a wonderful overall experience. Highly recommend!

Loved the vibe here, honestly such a great place to unwind after a workout or for a cozy morning date. The ambiance is so nice with books all around you.
The food was easily the highlight of the day. Had a smoothie with granola, seasonal fruit, coconut milk, and protein that was incredible, plus the matcha coconut water smoothie was super refreshing. We also tried the Sri Lankan thali and the tangy brinjal in it was delicious. Don't skip the sourdough and hummus either, so good. Definitely worth checking out!

Copper Cloves Cafe goes straight into my Top 5 worldwide. No hesitation. No debate. Just straight up there.
Their motto says “Slow Down” and somehow the whole place actually listens. The atmosphere, inside and outside, is crafted with style and soul. Books everywhere. Flowers softening every corner. Shelves that invite you to browse. A cozy kids’ space. It feels curated, not decorated.
And the food… my oh my. An unbeatable all vegan menu, sourdough that deserves its own fan club, and flavors that are thoughtful, balanced and seriously delicious. Every dish tastes like someone cared deeply before it reached your table.
The staff? 100% service minded and genuinely kind. Professional, warm, smiling. The kind of team that makes you feel welcome without hovering.
And then the magic spreads. Right there you have Love Me Twice for thrift treasures, Champaca for books you suddenly cannot live without, and No Nasties + for conscious reuse finds. The café is nestled into this whole universe like the warm heart of it all.
People stay. They read. They work. They talk. Time stretches gently. It has that Hotel California feeling, you can check out but you never really leave.
Adorable. Inspiring. Delicious. I will absolutely be back.

name: The Kind Roastery and Brew Room Indiranagar
review_texts: Visited Kind for a late-night coffee after dinner, so we couldn't try anything from their food menu. We ordered a Flat White and an Affogato. The ambience was neat, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed coffee break. One thing that stood out was the service - it was super fast and the staff were attentive. As for the coffee - both Flat White and Affogato were decent but neither was particularly memorable. Considering the price, I felt they were a bit overrated and didn't quite justify the cost. Overall - it's a nice spot for date, but I expected better coffee for the price.

The place is spacious and looks inviting right from the outside. Once you walk in, you can choose between the upstairs and downstairs seating. We picked the upstairs section, which felt quite peaceful overall, although conversations from nearby tables were still very audible. Given the upscale pricing, I expected the tables to be spaced out a bit more.

The menu itself is quite interesting, with a lot of unique options. They also feature seasonal specials, including mango-based coffees, desserts, and baked items, and even jackfruit-inspired offerings.

Here’s what we ordered and what we thought:

Jackfruit Latte
It genuinely tastes like jackfruit because you can clearly tell they use real jackfruit purée. Unfortunately, the one we got leaned quite bitter and wasn’t particularly enjoyable for us. Maybe it would work better with added sugar, but we personally prefer our drinks without it.

Cold Coffee
This was really good. Nicely balanced and not overly sweet.

Korean Bun
Easily the highlight of our order. The bun tasted fresh, and the cream cheese filling was rich and enjoyable.

Piri Piri Fries
Pretty average overall. It didn’t really have the distinct piri piri flavour we expected.

Overall, the place has great vibes, an interesting menu, and enjoyable food.

We went to Kind on a Friday Night, it was a good place with calm vibe, we got an excellent secluded seating. The atmosphere was really great. Coming to the food, it was pretty much average. We ordered the two dimsums available in their menu, the truffle oil cream cheese dimsums was okayish, not upto the mark for me. I have had far far better ones, in Yuki, Daily Sushi and all. The other dimsum was based on thai flavours and was good, nothing awesome. Then we had ordered a Gnocchi creamy Pesto, which took them around 30 minutes to serve, don't know why. And the taste was also not upto the mark. Overall a very average experience food wise. We also ordered there walnut cake which was the best item of the day. It was really yum!!

So it's a pretty average place to be in with great vibes though. Can visit for a quick catchup with friends maybe, but definitely not for food. I have heard their coffee is good though maybe will try later someday if I like.

Sitting right in the hustle and bustle of Indiranagar, The Kind is a one-of-a-kind comfort place for me.
The ambience wraps you up in a comforting hug with lighting that is neither scanty nor too bright. It's a place to sit with a friend, sip matcha, and catch up on things from a year ago. The waiters are the kindest, tending to your needs and wants with the best dishes.
Although I love one of the "boring" dishes: the Belgian chocolate smoothie bowl with extra almond toppings.
It's a place to sit, read, catch up, and get to know your date. Whatever may be the purpose, The Kind is the kind of answer you are looking for. It has become my regular now.

This place turned out to be one of my favourite café experiences in Bengaluru. The ambience is cozy, modern, and perfect for spending a slow evening. The Korean garlic bun and Korean jalapeño bun were incredibly soft and flavourful, the Sicilian pizza was fresh and delicious, and the classic mac n cheese was pure comfort food. The truffled New York cream cheese dimsums with chilli oil were something very different and absolutely worth trying. Also, the iced Vietnamese brew was simply outstanding and was one the best i have ever had.

name: Conçu Indiranagar
review_texts: Came here on a Sunday to brunch with some friends. The food was really good. I had a cream cheese bagel and a "midnight sonnet" pastry. In fact everyone was happy with the food. However the problem was the service. I asked if I could get an iced matcha without milk and the waiter refused. I asked him to send the barista, but again he refused. I settled for something else then, but there is literally no reason that comes to my mind, why it shouldn't be possible to make one (I drink this at home every day). My friend had a chicken bowl with pesto cream cheese sauce and asked for some extra sauce. The waiter again refused without giving any reasonable explanation as to why. The atmosphere was ok, it was actually quite cold, little loud and they have only one ladies washroom, my friend had to wait for 15 minutes outside for her turn. I don't think this is adequate for a place of that size. Conclusion: I would definitely order some food / pastries for takeaway or delivery in future, but I would probably not come back to dine in.

This place was recommended to me by a friend so I was already looking forward to it.
As soon as I walked in I saw a lot of people which made me happy and when I walked to the country, I was greeted by a variety of delicious looking treats.
I ordered the Raspberry Trifle which looked stunning and the taste was even better, the soft exterior, the moist spongecake and the various berries elevated the dish really well. Next was the Gelato blended classic cold coffee which was strong but exactly to my liking and the cream cheese bagel with the salad was a nice balance to the dessert.
Had an amazing experience and would definitely recommend it to everyone.

So here I am back in Bangalore with a scratched thigh and face. so I decided to go and relax in a very calm well lit cafe!
suggested from a friend she told me to try the cinnamon roll... sadly they were out!
so I decided to ask what they would recommend. I was put into a conversation with Jagdish, who was the manager. I asked him what he would recommend for a person who visits their cafe for the first time. He quickly pointed out
mizo caramel cappuccino (5/5) -
Not a big fan of coffee yet wanting to try something new I said go ahead get me one of those. it was just perfect... I didn't know I would like a cup of cappuccino so much. just a perfect blessing to my palette after a long tiring day. Surely my injuries would be healing faster as i sipped through the cappuccino.

He also recommended a dessert Vanilla choux bun (4/5)
it was a nice snack with a lot of cream and a nutty texture with a hint of Chocolate. not too sweet and not too dry for the mouth a perfect blend. I liked the powdered sugar on top but I would say that I wouldn't like that as a recommendation over the other more famous desserts I have heard from that place.

We also had the signature Hot chocolate ( 4/5)- the hot chocolate was good... but I like my hot chocolate less sweet and a little bit more creamy.

to finish our evening and have our stomachs filled for a long walk we had a
cream cheese bagel (4/5)
I liked the bagel it felt fresh toasted and the cheese cream as well. I loved the salads but I felt the dish was a little incomplete. would love to see the cafe experiment more and try to add something that compliments this dish more.

This is mostly a place i would like to visit during office meetings or with a date a silent vibe with a well lit environment and quite friendly staff.

I loved the venue (5/5) as it was well lit and was spacious didn't feel cramped up.
I loved the hygiene (5/5) and simplicity yet unique vibe the place carried.
I loved the food (4/5), the easy to munch and have place for more deserts.

my recommendation for the place would just to find something to partner with or complete some of the dishes which I tried and i would love to visit here again soon!

Thank you Jagdish and all the servers who helped me find a new brew to keep my evenings jolly!

The main advantage of their space is that, it is well spread out. Which means that two tables are not placed very close to each other. Decent food menu for a coffee shop. The veggies pizza was good, in terms of taste and size.
Area of improvement : They are a multi-storey café, and the dessert tower is located on the ground floor only, which is fine. But they should atleast have a dessert menu available to everyone, irrespective of which floor they are sitting on. When I spoke to server, I understood that, they expect guests to climb down stairs each time they want to make a dessert selection. That is impractical. And even if we asked the server as to what all are available today, they wouldn't know anything, and would ask us to climb down stairs just to take a look at the dessert tower. And only then the dessert order would be taken.
Let's assume, the dessert menu chnages on regular basis, so they should have a backup plan of temporary/manual menus, just for dessert part. This is the least the team could do. Not everyone would know where what is placed in the first visit itself. And even if it is a repeat visit, one may not remember.
This experience was silly and a big shortcoming from the Conçu team's end.

Updating in June 2026: Was disappointing with the staff s attitude on our last visit. We found the matcha too milky and enquired about it. The staff replied coldly that the barista says it’s perfect. What?! On further asking he told us they have other milk options like oat and almond milk. At this point any respectable fine dine place would offer a replacement beverage with an apology. However the waiter casually walked off. Expect better from a place like Concu. Also found the black rice avocado dish rather underwhelming with overload of garlic flavor and flat notes throughout. I ll stick to the desserts here now on.

I have visited Concu a few times now and love most of the stuff here - from vanilla choux bun, strawberry choux bun, dark chocolate eclairs(the best), to wonderful tea selection. The tea menu is so good I haven’t got to try their coffee which also looks good. I have taken away many items like cake slices, medelines, florentine, shortbread, biscotti and everything is top notch. Yet to try the Tiramisu and few other indulgences here, but all that is in my wishlist (like the dessert globe!)
The service is nice considering the huge crowds they get, thanks for not turning down solo visitors.

name: Casa Fresco, Indiranagar: All-Day Dining & Café
review_texts:
A pet friendly place
It was an outdoor seating, the staff were very welcoming and the serving time was not long.
Food felt worth the price. They had a lot to choose from and it was confusing wat to choose.
My most fav was the cheesy popoye omellete .
We had wings, tandoori sandwich, meaty omellte, jacobs sausage, banana oats smoothie, bluberry boba, chamomille tea, turkish tea, masala chai, veitnamese coffee.
The turkish tea was something new and different.
Really enjoyed our time there and will definitely go back.

Casa Fresco in Indiranagar is a total gem! Nestled under a leafy canopy with a charming brick facade, it’s the perfect "All Day Dining" retreat. The vibe is 5/5—peaceful, aesthetic, and quintessential Bengaluru.
The vegetarian spread we had was impressive. The Honey Chilli Sesame Fries were a highlight, perfectly glazed and crunchy. For a richer bite, the Creamy Mushroom Bruschetta is a must-try. We also loved the Pink Sauce Pasta and the Fried Paneer Popcorn, which were fresh and flavorful. While we stuck to the veg menu this time, it's worth noting they have a wide range of non-veg options available that looked equally tempting.
From the crispy appetizers to the cozy breakfast omelettes, everything was spot on. A perfect spot for brunch or a quiet work afternoon!
Rating: 5/5

Had a wonderful experience at Casa Fresco, Indiranagar. The café has a beautiful, cozy ambience with a calm and aesthetic vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed. It’s the kind of place where you can comfortably spend quality time, whether you’re catching up with friends or just looking for a peaceful outing.

We tried the pasta and hazelnut chocolate shake, and both were genuinely impressive. The pasta was cooked perfectly with a rich, creamy sauce that had great flavor in every bite. It tasted fresh, well-balanced, and very satisfying. The hazelnut chocolate shake was one of the highlights — thick, smooth, rich, and indulgent without being too heavy. It had the perfect blend of chocolate and hazelnut, making it a treat on its own.

The service was also worth appreciating. The staff were warm, polite, and attentive, making sure everything was served on time and that we were comfortable throughout. The overall cleanliness, presentation, and peaceful atmosphere added to the experience.

Casa Fresco is definitely a great place in Indiranagar if you’re looking for delicious food, good service, and a cozy vibe. Would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone looking for a nice café experience.

Really liked this brunch place! the ambience is super nice—perfect for a relaxed outing also It’s pet-friendly. The food was good, especially the sandwiches. Tea was just okay. Service was a bit slow and it does get quite crowded on weekends, but overall it’s a great spot to spend long, chill hours with friends and enjoy a good brunch.

Loved the food. Ozzy Omelette.  They give mashed egg whites with cheese which i found very very tasty because I am not a fan of mashed potato. Their English breakfast is good; comes with complimentary juice.
I ordered blueberry French toast : which was amazinggggggg !!!! Hanoi iced coffee was very tasty . So was hazelnut iced coffee. Orderd mushroom sandwich which comes with chips as sides. Pan cakes were also very yummy. I would revisit this place multiple times to try everything on their menu.

The only con is : wait time is too much. Usually fhe orders take 20-30 mins to be served.  So if you are starving ; better be ready.
But honestly: worth the wait.

name: Lazy Suzy
review_texts: A nice cute cafe, preferably for tea totalers or maybe first dates. The food is really good, very tasty,  and the portion size is a lot. The first floor is a bit noise during traffic hours, but the ground floor is silent and really calm. The service of the staff is top quality, they welcome you with smiling face and are really friendly.

Lazy Suzy Café is a small and cozy place with a nice, relaxed vibe. They offer a good variety of food options to choose from.

The taste was decent and overall it was a pleasant visit. A good spot if you’re looking for a simple and cozy café experience.

The food here wasn’t really good. The fish fingers were quite bad—I think the fish was old, and it was very hard to bite. The chicken patty in the burger was also tough and not enjoyable. The chicken steak was just okay, nothing special. The only thing I really liked was the hot chocolate. Overall, the experience was quite disappointing.

Horrid experience. Just serving aesthetics in your cafe doesn’t work, You gotta treat the customer well too. Just straight up rude. The serving size for the coffee was Insanely tiny. Nachos were mid at best. I had high expectations and boy was I disappointed. Never again.

Edit to owner’s reply: If you can acknowledge the coffee sizes, you can own up to your owner’s rudeness and those pathetic nachos as well.
I’ve had macchiatos with better taste and portion size before. Learn how to take criticism, it’s just one Google search away. :)

Been there as the kid wanted to have pancakes. Went around lunch time. Walked in and there was just 1 table occupied. Was wondering if we made a mistake. Ordered a pancake and a goat cheese salad. The pancakes are fluffy. Salad was crunchy and tasty without being only about the lettuce. So I went ahead and Ordered the lamb burger and a pasta. Everything was perfect. Its a quaint laid back place with amazing food. Service is unhurried almost as if we were in old goa. Go there for a relaxed meal and you won't be disappointed. By the time we left the all the tables were occupied and an couple waiting outside to occupy the table we had previously occupied.

name: The Hole In The Wall
review_texts:
Absolutely loved this place! ❤️
Hole in the Wall is such a cozy little café with a warm, welcoming vibe and a really cute ambience. It's the kind of place where you can sit back, relax, and enjoy a slow brunch.
We tried 2–3 different egg dishes, and every single one was spot on. Everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and genuinely delicious. Even the complimentary bread was surprisingly good!

We visited the Hole in the Wall Cafe, Indiranagar branch, over the weekend and had a pleasant overall experience, though it didn't quite stand out enough to justify the long wait.

For food, we ordered the chicken sandwich, Farmer's Pie, and a couple of drinks. The chicken sandwich was well-made, with fresh ingredients and a good balance of flavors. It was simple, satisfying, and exactly what you'd expect from a café known for its comfort food.

The highlight of the meal was definitely the Farmer's Pie. It came with generous chunks of chicken that were tender and flavorful, paired with a substantial portion of creamy mashed potatoes. The mashed potatoes complemented the chicken really well, making it a hearty and comforting dish that felt worth ordering.

The drinks were refreshing and paired nicely with the meal, though they weren't particularly memorable compared to the food.

Service was decent despite the weekend rush. The staff were courteous and managed the crowd reasonably well. However, the waiting time was quite long, which affected the overall experience. While the food was enjoyable, it wasn't exceptional enough to make the wait feel worthwhile. In an area like Indiranagar, where there are numerous cafes and brunch spots offering equally good food with shorter waiting times, it's difficult to see this as the obvious choice.

Overall, it's a good café with comforting food, especially the Farmer's Pie, but if you're visiting during peak hours, be prepared for a wait. Worth trying once, but there are plenty of other strong options in the neighborhood that offer a similar experience.

been a fan of this restaurant but had always visited the Koramangala branch and first time here in Indiranagar. As usual, waited for 40 minutes to get in, ordering was quick, the same menu! Food was good, and the experience was the best, the seat I got was facing a banyan tree outside, sat, relaxed as food was late to table. it was crowded but the location saved me. I didnt like the cold coffee, it didnt take anything like what they serve in Koramangala, or may be it was that day! overall a good experience, good food, good view, its decent I wouldnt say anything exceptional about the overall experience. I think its a place you can visit once in a blue moon, definitely not a place to visit regularly..
btw, everything is hurry here, so if you are someone who likes tranquility and enjoy the calmness, stay away from here, otherwise good for all category.

The Hole In The Wall is one of those breakfast spots that lives up to the hype. Their English breakfast is genuinely satisfying—well-portioned, flavorful, and consistently good. From eggs and toast to sausages and sides, everything feels comforting and well done. The café has a warm old-world charm, with homely interiors that feel somewhere between a bookstore and a library, making it a lovely place to sit and slow down.

The only downside is the wait. There’s usually a long queue, and getting a table can mean waiting one to two hours since they don’t take prior reservations—you have to show up, take a token, and wait for your name to be called. Parking is another challenge, as there’s hardly space and vehicles often end up lined along the road outside.

That said, once seated, the food and atmosphere make up for the inconvenience. If you don’t mind the wait, it’s a solid breakfast experience in Indiranagar.

Good number of european breakfast options. Most small changes between the names, majorly mashed potato, beans, sausage are common. It a good change of palate from the regaular foods. Service is good and quick at times.

name: Cafe Grey by Dongle & Co
review_texts:
Absolutely loved this cafe. It's basically a co-working place with a full fledge cafe functioning within it. Located on the 3rd floor, they have a neat, tidy, bright and well spaced out interiors which makes the ambience extremely comfortable and relaxing.

The food here is scrumptious and the portions are generous. We ordered the pizza, burger, and chicken wings; every dish was perfectly prepared and delicious.

Service is top-notch where the staff is ever attentive and receptive towards your requirements.

A definite must visit of you're looking for a relaxing place to work or just to enjoy some delicious and yummy food.

First visit to this cafe for Sunday lunch, had a pretty good time overall.

Tried Shakshouka & Mushroom Sandwich, both of which were pretty good and filling! But the Bluberry Cheesecake felt nothing extraordinary to me as some older reviews pointed out, just ok.

The ambience is pretty good, with wifi for one of your device and AC in the middle, flanked by outside sitting on two sides. The washroom is big, and dry - maybe the perk of being on the third floor.

The food came in time, the waiter was bright & ever-smiling, seems a place where I can come back again.

I visited Cafe Grey in Indiranagar on Sunday. It's located very close to the metro station, making it easy to reach. The café has a great ambiance with soft background music, making it a perfect place to enjoy coffee and food.

You can visit with friends or family, and it's also pet-friendly. I ordered a salad, a starter,  a coffee and an ice tea . Everything was good, but the cappuccino was definitely the highlight. The latte art was absolutely beautiful, and the coffee had a smooth, creamy taste and ice tea was also excellent. I asked one of the waiters who had prepared the coffee, and he mentioned a name that sounded like Vishal or Bhushan. Either way, the coffee was excellent.

The food, service, and overall management were very good. The café is well-decorated, clean, and has well-maintained washrooms. Another great advantage is that they provide valet parking, so parking is completely hassle-free.

Overall, I had a fantastic experience and will definitely be visiting again. Highly recommended for coffee lovers and anyone looking for a comfortable place to relax and enjoy good food.

A lovely spot with a great atmosphere, and the best part is pets are allowed to sit inside with you, which is a huge plus! The pricing is very reasonable for the location.

Food: I highly recommend their starters—they are delicious and worth trying. The main courses were decent but average.

Verdict: Great place if you want a nice vibe for you and your pet without spending too much.

Went there on a Friday evening for a casual hangout with friends. Although the place was small, it wasn't crowded; I saw a lot of people working on their laptops and sipping coffee.
They had a separate smoking zone outside the AC area, overall a good place to hang out with friends.

name: ARAKU Coffee
review_texts:
If you want a cozy spot right on the main road, Araku Coffee in Indiranagar is a really nice find. It has a sweet, simple ambience that feels comforting the second you walk in. 🍵✨
We tried two different iced drinks, their classic iced matcha latte and the iced honey oat matcha latte. Both had the perfect amount of sweetness and tasted really good. Pairing them with the chocolate biscotti was a great combination.
The staff is welcoming, and since they only have a few seats, the space feels extra cozy. It’s a great little spot whether you want to get some work done or just catch up over coffee.

Definitely add this one to your Indiranagar list! 📍👇

[Araku Coffee Indiranagar, best iced matcha latte in Bangalore, honey oat matcha latte Bengaluru, cozy cafes in Indiranagar, quiet work cafes Bangalore, specialty coffee shops Indiranagar, aesthetic cafes in Bengaluru, chocolate biscotti coffee pairing, cute coffee shops Indiranagar main road, local Bangalore cafe recommendations]

#arakucoffee #indiranagar #bangalorecafes #icedmatcha #cozycafe

I had a wonderful experience at Araku Café. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and attentive. The ambience is calm, cozy, and perfect for relaxing. I tried the Iced Cold Coffee and the Panna Cotta dessert, and both were absolutely delicious and well-prepared. The quality and presentation were excellent. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, coffee, and a pleasant atmosphere.

Araku is a beautiful café with a lovely seating area and a warm, relaxing ambiance. It’s a great place to unwind over a good cup of coffee.

We tried their seasonal Mango Coffee, and it was absolutely amazing. The unique combination of mango and coffee worked surprisingly well and made it a must-try. Overall, a wonderful café with great coffee and a pleasant atmosphere.

The V60s hit all the correct spots. Loved it. Also kudos for serving coffee at the perfect temperature. Tried 2 varieties attached in photo.
Food was 3/5 at best. Shakshuka was underwhelming and the japanese omlette toast wasn’t very impressive either. Staff was a 10/10. Overall, recommend place for good medium roasts!

Staff is very attentive with great recommendation and service. Very nice cafe for coffee connoisseur. We went on weekend for having some light breakfast and some good coffee and it was a perfect spot. Note : Car parking needs to be done road side but again thats the casr with most cafes in indiranagar.

name: Vanamo Global Eats and Caffeinary
review_texts:
Right in the middle of 100 feet road so it's a tiny place but overall serves great vibes and  amazing food. We ordered the Mexican fajita burrito bowl and Sea Bass a la Bilbaína. Both came in generous amounts so we were quite full by the end of it and everything tasted so good. I also had v60 pour over Ethiopian coffee and which was good too.
Overall I'd come here again to try more items from the menu.

This is probably the prettiest café I’ve visited lately. The interiors are super artistic, elegant, and feel so premium. I went there for their breakfast spread but ended up getting distracted by their special mango menu too.

From the mango menu, you absolutely cannot skip the Blueberry Lemon Matcha Fizz easily one of the best drinks I’ve had recently. I also tried the Fusion Benedict Royale with butter chicken and WOW, such a unique combo and executed so well Paired everything with their iced Vietnamese coffee and it was the perfect breakfast scene.

From the breakfast menu, the Mixed Berry Smoothie Bowl was super refreshing, the Petit Morning Plate felt light yet hearty, and if you’re a toast lover, Atlas Chicken Toastie is a must-order. The harissa chicken on toast was impeccable.

Overall, the breakfast spread was genuinely impressive great food, beautiful ambiance, and such a calming vibe.

The hidden gem in Bangalore - Vanamo!
When craving for global eats, it is becoming my go-to place. Love the cozy ambience, delicious food, abundant variety to try out - not just food, but beverages too!
Love their chicken skewers, enchiladas!
Korean bowl is nice only if you like the flavor of the korean sauces.

Great experience overall! We really enjoyed the Patatas Bravas and Sea Bass a la Catalana, though the seasoning wasn't quite perfect. Their coffee and hot chocolate are excellent, and the valet parking is a huge plus for convenience.

Vanamo is hands-down one of the finest fine-dine cafés in Bangalore, tucked away in the vibrant streets of Indiranagar. From the moment we stepped in, we were welcomed into a space that strikes the perfect balance between elegance and comfort. The interiors are chic, the vibe is warm, and the attention to detail—in both décor and dishes—is clearly top-notch.

What sets Vanamo apart is its carefully curated global menu that leans into different Asian and European cuisines. Though the options may seem limited at first glance, each dish is crafted with intention, authenticity, and finesse. Presentation is beautiful, portions are satisfying, and the taste is refined—easily meeting European standards.

A huge shoutout to Nandhu, whose friendly demeanor and attentive service made our dining experience even more memorable. The staff overall was courteous and patient, adding to the feel-good experience.

What We Ordered:
- Patatas Bravas
A Spanish favourite—crispy double-cooked smashed potatoes laid on a vibrant, spicy bell pepper bravas sauce, chimichurri, and topped with sour cream. Crunchy, flavourful and beautifully plated.

- Mexican Fajita Burrito Bowl
A hearty, well-balanced bowl of chipotle-glazed cottage cheese, Mexican rice, refried beans, and sautéed bell peppers, paired with tortilla chips, guacamole, salsa and smoked sour cream. Comfort food at its best with an elevated twist.

- Hot Café Mocha
A warm hug in a cup—silky espresso with steamed milk and just the right amount of indulgent chocolate.

- Peach and Jalapeño Shock
A refreshing mocktail combining the sweetness of peach and orange juice with the gentle heat of jalapeño, finished with sparkling water. Unexpected, exciting and absolutely worth trying.

Vanamo may be on the premium side price-wise, but it delivers on every front—ambience, service, taste, and presentation. It's perfect for date nights, special occasions, or when you just want to treat yourself to a thoughtfully curated global menu in the heart of Bangalore.

name: HumbleBean Coffee & Pâtisserie
review_texts: Humblebēan Coffee in Indiranagar is a fantastic find for specialty coffee lovers! They offer an impressive variety of beans and custom brewing methods. Intrigued by the name, our small group tried a coffee brewed using the Siphon method. Watching the intricate, scientific process felt like a nostalgic trip right back to high school chemistry lab! The final brew was smooth, vibrant, and absolutely delicious. Between the welcoming atmosphere, passionate staff, and excellent coffee quality, this spot is a massive win. I will definitely be visiting again soon to try their other brewing styles!

I had a great impression of the proprietor, Somanna. The hospitality and overall experience were good. However, I would like to share a few recommendations for improvement:

1. The water glasses had a strong unpleasant odour, which was difficult to tolerate. This definitely needs attention.

2. Customer consent for the service charge should be obtained before adding it to the bill.

3. Regarding the Flat White, based on what I experienced, there seemed to be either slight over-extraction of the espresso, an issue with milk texturing, or an imbalance in the coffee-to-milk ratio. I couldn’t pinpoint the exact reason, but the usual mild sweetness and smoothness of a Flat White were missing, even after adding sugar.

4. After delivering the food and beverages, the service staff did not return to check on the table. A simple follow-up asking for feedback or whether everything was satisfactory would improve the dining experience and customer engagement.

These improvements could significantly enhance the overall customer experience.

Good place to grap a bite and coffee. Loved the atmosphere. The vibe feel is like any other good coffee shop. I walked in here for a cup of coffee with friends. We ordered the cold brew coffee and matcha latte both were really good. I just would have liked the service if we didn't have to wait so long for just two drinks.
But I would definitely come back for the cold matcha latte or that cold brew to cool down during Bangalore summers.
Desserts looked delicious although I didn't get to try it this time. Maybe I'd try that too on my next visit.

The coffee was apparently good (I don't drink coffee) but I got an iced raspberry oat matcha and it was dismal. Although it looked really good, it tasted very watery and didn't have a strong matcha flavour at all.

The ambience was good, people were mostly working here, even on a Saturday afternoon.

We bought some coffee beans but they'd been packaged 3 weeks prior so their packaged beans at least don't seem to be freshly roasted.

Humble Bean is such a cozy and welcoming spot! The coffee is rich, smooth, and freshly brewed, with a variety of options for every taste. The ambience is warm, relaxed, and perfect for unwinding or catching up with friends. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always ready with recommendations. Their snacks and desserts complement the coffee beautifully — the pastries were fresh and delicious. A perfect little escape from the hustle, whether you want to read, work, or simply enjoy a peaceful cup of coffee in a calm, charming setting. Definitely a must-visit for coffee lovers!

name: Nuage Pâtisserie & Cafe
review_texts: This charming cafe serves flawless coffee and exceptional pastries. The real standout is the cheesecake—truly elite, perfectly creamy, and unforgettable. A beautiful space for an elevated daily ritual.
Food was good. Loved the English breakfast set. Ambience was good. It was clean. Service was good. Might go again! Prices have slightly increased too.

A really nice café with a cozy, homely vibe. Loved that they have both indoor and outdoor seating.
The food was fresh and comforting, and the atmosphere made us want to stay longer than we planned. Would definitely come back

Have been going to Nuage for over 3 years.
Earlier their food was good but now very recently they changed their food menu and some of the new stuff are absolutely AMAZING!! We tried the Gochujang chicken sandwich, corn ribs, whipped ricotta and the lemon aglio linguine and all were something to go back for.

Also another thing they have improved is the coffee. Earlier it was average. Now it’s really really good. Kudos to the team for constantly trying to improve and keep with the times.

Highly recommend.

The pastries were strictly ok. They only looked pretty sitting in the display but they didn't taste good. Tried the Japanese souffle cheesecake and the cinnamon rolls. Worst cinnamon roll I've ever tried.
The pasta was too saucy and full of butter. It's not supposed to be swimming in the sauce. They were generous with the prawn and bacon in it, but that's the best I can say.
I was drawn to the place because it looked quaint, but there was a lack of warmth to the atmosphere when I actually spent time there. The seats were hard. The whole place felt like it was being run just because they had to.
It is pet friendly. So that's a plus. But the area for pets is in the back of the restaurant,  where you expect to see dustbins.
Not impressed by this place at all.

It is quiet. That's the only good thing.

name: tribal brew daily | Indiranagar
review_texts:
A small coffee outlet on the 100 feet road in Indira Nagar. Tried the cold coffee and it was good. Not the usual cold coffee flavour it was bit strong and dark but I like it
There is no seating available, it’s a take away place.

Tribal Coffee is a small, tucked-away spot right on the footpath in Indiranagar. If you’re tired of the usual big names like Third Wave or Starbucks and want to try something different, this little café is definitely worth a visit. The coffee is simple, well-made, and absolutely worth the price you pay. What stands out even more is the warmth of the people – the person running the place is sweet, and the staff always greets you with a smile, which is a rare and refreshing sight these days. It’s a humble yet charming stop for a good cup of coffee.

Not a pleasant experience overall. We didn’t like the coffee, and there was a noticeable sewage smell around the place, which was quite off-putting.

We ordered the Bahama Mama, which didn’t taste good at all. The Americano was also disappointing, while the cappuccino was just about decent.

Would not recommend this place. Also, please note that they do not provide order receipts. We were charged an extra ₹145 over what we actually ordered. Make sure to ask for the bill and double-check your charges before paying.
Variety of coffee and food options available. Not many cafe provide so many milk coffee options to choose from. Staff is knowledgeable and gives good suggestions.

Oh man! This place was a breathe of fresh air. We were tired of going to places like third wave coffee and Starbucks to get good coffee. We recently visited this place to be greeted with friendly staff who made great coffee. My friends loved it too. They have new variants of coffee that taste good and great food as well. I would say it’s a must try place if you are in Indiranagar.

name: Café Plume
review_texts:
This spot is something so refreshing to see in the indiranagar of today which only has cafes that get fake hype from influencers and lie on false promises of good food.

This place speaks for itself. It's the dependable nook you can retreat to on a hard day. The decor is simple and tastefully done & has a very homely vibe. It's a perfect place to kick it back with friends or have a quiet solo reading session. There's the perfect corner for everybody.

Oh my god I can write a thesis on how amazing their butter croissant is. It has the  perfectttt crispy:soft ratio and it's not overly salty from the butter or sweet from the sugar. It's a major loss for the people allergic to gluten. I'm telling you guys this croissant will change your life.

Their latte is perfect too. But PLEASE add an iced latte/cold coffee to the menu I beggg 🙏

It's my new favourite hideout in the area.

First time trying a croque Monsieur. Twas alright
The hot chocolate tasted decadent.
The strawberry puree in the matcha was top notch. Very refreshing.
The bluberry lemon cake was solid
One of the quietest cafes in indiranagar where you can have great food and enjoy it while reading books. Its a good cafe to work too. Had the croque monsieur and mango tart. Both were really good.

Had a chill time here, a very calm ambience. The Croque Monsieur was the highlight - perfect amount of cheese on top. Also the chocolate eclair was a great finisher.
Attached is the Latte (a classic).

My favourite cafe in Indiranagar. A small cafe with great desserts and a great collection of books.I first came here after they started the craft chocolate shelf. But time and time I come back here now just for the desserts or hot chocolate. One of the few places in the city or country to use craft chocolate in their desserts which make them unique.

name: TrueBrew Cafe & Restaurant
review_texts: We had a great breakfast here. The Eggs Benedict was one of the best I have had in recent times. The sourdough bread was perfectly toasted, the poached eggs were juicy and the hollandaise sauce was creamy and delicious. It tasted so good. The regular eggs breakfast with omelette, sausage, beans and veggies was scrumptious too. Their coffee deserves a special mention. We tried their Nicaragua pour over and it was definitely skillfully brewed. We could smell the aroma and taste the feel of a well brewed coffee. While the dishes are expensive, it is totally justified as they match international standards and unlike the common bar food here at Bangalore, is very much authentic. The staff were friendly and the ambience was typical of a cute cafe. They didn’t have an elevator though and finding parking on the street was a bit of a pain. Overall, we had an amazing breakfast and it made our day. Would love to visit back again.

I recently visited TrueBrew Café & Restaurant in Indiranagar and had a wonderful experience. The ambience is cozy and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for both casual dining and coffee catch-ups.

The highlight of my visit was the brewing expertise of Chang, who truly deserves appreciation for his excellence. With over 8+ years of experience in brewing, Chang has mastered the craft of creating perfectly balanced coffees. The cappuccino I tried was rich, aromatic, and brewed with precision—one of the best I’ve had in Bangalore.

The food was equally impressive. The Mazze Platter was well presented and flavorful, the Lemon Cake Slice was ok ok and the Cold Coffee was refreshing. Service was prompt and courteous, and the staff made sure we were comfortable throughout.

Overall, TrueBrew Café not only serves delicious food and beverages but also stands out because of passionate people like Chang who elevate the whole experience. Definitely worth visiting if you’re around Indiranagar!

Visited on a December morning in 2025. The amazing smell of coffee once you enter is so welcoming!!

We came here after some light breakfast. Ordered the Eggs Florentine on the Sourdough bread which was superb. The egg was just runny, the sourdough slice and some spinach was a lovely taste. It was a very well made Sandwich.

The Veg Croissant sandwich was good too. The cheese was cool and nice and sandwich was just flaky while still holding on to the goodies inside very well. Quite filling.

We ordered a Malabar brew Latte and a Kenyan brew latte. Both were good and distinct in taste.

As a cafe service can be laid back for the food, but the coffees do come pronto. Clean washroom and hand wash.  The price is on the above average / higher side but you do pay for the quality.

Parking on the street is tough , we had parked about a km away and taken a rickshaw. Am sure one can find parking in one of the back roads if you get in early. Place is quite popular and was filling up by about 12:30.

Highly recommend this cafe, had an amazing time.
Saurav took really good care of us.
Thank you! 🙏🏼 definitely visiting again soon!

Loved the atmosphere and wonderful service. The chocolate pancakes were soft and yumm! The litchi lemon cooker is a must try.
Would highly recommend this cafe!!

name: Mon Cheri Crafted Continental Dining
review_texts:
Some places serve great food, but a few serve a story with it - and Mon Chéri is one of them.
Learning that this restaurant was born from a mother's love, simply because her daughter loved Italian food, made the experience even more meaningful. It's beautiful to see how that love and passion have grown into a place where so many people can enjoy authentic, heartwarming Italian cuisine.

Every dish reflected care, freshness, and attention to detail. Beyond the food, the warm conversation with the owner ma'am and her daughter was the highlight of our visit. Their kindness, humility, and genuine passion made us feel less like customers and more like welcomed guests.

Thank you for sharing not just wonderful food, but a truly inspiring story. Wishing Mon Chéri many more years of success and countless happy diners. We'll definitely be back. ❤️

Visited around 2 PM, and the place had a peaceful yet vibrant atmosphere. The Italian Stuffed Mushroom was packed with flavor, the pizza was excellent, the Buffalo Wings had a perfect balance of sweet and spicy, and the creamy pasta was delicious. The hot chocolate was the perfect finish. Loved seeing the owner actively helping the chefs, it really reflects their passion. A great place for families, with plenty of vegetarian, non vegetarian, and eggitarian options. Definitely a must visit in Indiranagar ✨

Overall- 4/5
In dine service- 4.5/5

1. Mushroom basque soup- 5/5. This soup was damn delicious! The mushrooms with the earthy umami taste and a hint of pepper that lingers till the next dish arrives. The spice is not overpowering.

2. Pasta (spaghetti) - 3.5/5. It was okay. The thin spaghetti & the cremey cheese sauce with chicken was not anything out of the ordinary or over the moon.

3. Fish & chips- 4/5. It was good. The fish was fresh, and the batter was crispy. We were given 2 portions of fish. The wedges were fresh, crispy & to the point. The tartar sauce was a perfect compliment to the fish & chips.  Would be nice to have vinegar to top the fish with.

4. Tipsy tiramisu-5/5. It was light & airy, not too sweet, with a tinge of bitterness. I would definitely have this again.

Portions- good & value of money. Can be shared. We shared our order between 3 people.

No wheelchair accessibility. Only staircase.♿❌

✅Reserve the table beforehand!!

Mon Cheri Crafted Continental Dining – A Delightful Culinary Experience in Indiranagar

Our visit to Mon Cheri was a last-minute plan, and we were lucky enough to get a table within 10 minutes. That said, I would highly recommend making a reservation in advance, as there were quite a few people waiting for a long time. And honestly, that itself tells a story about the popularity of this place.

Located in the heart of Indiranagar, the restaurant has a warm and well-maintained ambience that makes for a pleasant dining experience. If you're driving, it's better to park on one of the parallel roads nearby, as parking can be a bit challenging around the restaurant.

Coming to the food—the highlight of the experience. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, with quality ingredients and great flavors. I don't quite remember the names of everything we ordered, but I've shared the photos, and they speak for themselves! The presentation was excellent, and each dish was delicious in its own way.

Overall, Mon Cheri offers a wonderful combination of good food, inviting ambience, and attentive service. A lovely place for a relaxed meal with friends or family, and definitely worth a visit if you're in Indiranagar.

Had a lovely experience at Mon Cheri Cafe. The food was absolutely delicious, very fresh, and beautifully presented, truly appealing to the eyes as well as the taste buds. The ambience is warm, cosy, and perfect for a relaxed meal. What makes it even better is that the food is offered at a very reasonable price point. It’s a charming little place with great vibes. Would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for good food and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Ainmane Cafe and Speciality Store
review_texts: Nice coffee shop in Indranagar. Always busy. Lots of regulars. Neighborhood / community vibe. They also sell chocolate and some snacks. This place opens earlier (7.30am) than most other places in the area (8am). And they accept international credit cards.

Had dropped in with a colleague. The store is well maintained with all kinds of different roasts and variety of coffee beans.My eyes caught on to the Civet cat coffee beans but then it was time for a snack so I started with the cold coffee  which was quite average and so was the quiche. I purchased a Jackfruit White chocolate bar.It had a minty taste with absolutely no taste of Jackfruit...Overall it has great potential but not sure how it fell short

A cute neighbourhood cafe, with decent coffee. I say decent because I had the Iced version, I personally feel Iced versions mute out many flavour notes of the coffee, so will wait to try the hot coffee to make up my mind. I really wish they offered served some alternative milk options, please consider the likes of oat milk. What really stood out to me was that this cafe had a truly neighbourhood cafe feel, at no point was it empty, people of all ages in and out, coming to talk and catch up over the coffee. It was a lovely experience. The guy behind the counter was kind and handled all the orders like a pro! There were a fair few flies inside the cafe maybe due to the rains, but please also consider revising the cafes pest control plans, the pesky flies did take away a bit from the experience.
Had speciality coffee. It was strong in flavour and effect. They sell products other than coffee as well.

This place is a hidden gem for every coffee lover. The place is very small with limited seating and it serves the best coffee. It has lots of variety of coffees. I tried the filter coffee and cold coffee. Both were amazing. Also the locality is also very cool and  cozy.  They also have lots of organic products like coffee, sugar spices etc

name: Matteo Coffea
review_texts:
Excellent experience. Good service, spacious seating, relaxed ambience and top-notch offerings.
The Cafe Latte was superb. It was obvious that good quality beans were used. My wife tried the Lemon Iced Tea which she greatly enjoyed. With the sugar syrup served separately she could adjust the sweetness. The Tiramisu we shared was fresh.
This place is for keeps ☕️👌

Matteo has become my favourite place for hot cocoa. The level of sweetness is just perfect. It is pure love in a cup. Retails for just Rs. 200 for a grande size. Please visit Matteo if you area genuine hot cocoa lover or you love coffee. The latte here is great too.

Matteo Coffea, Indiranagar – A Unique Coffee Experience ☕🥥
Matteo Coffea in Indiranagar is a great place for coffee lovers who enjoy trying something a little different. The café has a nice, relaxed ambience, making it a perfect spot to unwind, catch up with friends, or simply enjoy a good cup of coffee.

I tried their Haiwaan Coconut Coffee, and it was a very interesting and refreshing combination. The coconut flavor blended really well with the coffee, giving it a smooth, slightly tropical twist. It was not too strong or overpowering, and the balance of flavors made it quite enjoyable. Definitely something unique compared to regular coffee options.

The service was good, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The place has a comfortable vibe, and you can easily spend some relaxed time here.
Overall, Matteo Coffea is a nice café in Indiranagar for good coffee and a chill atmosphere. If you like experimenting with unique coffee flavors, the Haiwaan Coconut Coffee is definitely worth trying.

We went on a weekend and spent almost 4 hrs working from the cafe. The food was good - the taste is decent and the quantity is humongous.
We got lamb spaghetti bolognese, hazelnut cappuccino, and mocha shekerato. The prices are lower than average Bangalore cafe prices, so it’s good value for money.
Would strongly recommend working from this cafe.

I always had this feeling that Matteo is premium..while the products are premium the pricing is not. They have the best almond milk latte in the market. Really nutty and indulgent. I had the masala egg omlette. And had my egg white only customisation done perfectly. Loved the service. And the best thing is the number of plug points . Nice ambience. Pic is of the first floor

name: The Rameshwaram Cafe - Indiranagar
review_texts: I recently visited Rameshwaram Cafe and overall had a very good experience. The ghee pudi masala dosa was flavourful and generously loaded with ghee, and the potato filling was well spiced without being too oily. The dahi vada was fresh, with soft vadas and balanced curd, and the rasam vada had a nice tangy, comforting flavour. Service was quick despite the crowd, and the place was clean and well managed. I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 only because of the heavy rush and waiting time, but for the taste and value, it’s definitely a place I would come back to and recommend to others.

I recently visited Rameshwaram Cafe and the food quality is genuinely outstanding easily one of the best spots in Bangalore for authentic South Indian flavors. Every dish was fresh, well prepared, and lived up to the hype. The ambience is also very pleasant and adds to the overall experience.

However, the service needs serious attention. I understand the place gets crowded, but even during comparatively less busy periods, the staff were unresponsive and didn’t properly address basic queries. That creates a disconnect in an otherwise premium dining experience.

excellent food and ambience, but service standards need improvement to match the brand’s reputation.

Visited Rameshwaram Cafe in Indiranagar recently and had a good experience overall. The food was very tasty, and the quality definitely lived up to the expectations. The cafe is also well-maintained, clean, and hygienic, which made the dining experience pleasant.

One thing to keep in mind is that the waiting time after placing the food order is quite long, especially during busy hours. For ordering, you have the convenience of either using the self-ordering machine or placing your order manually at the counter.

Overall, it’s a great place for delicious food, and I’d definitely recommend it if you don’t mind waiting a little for your meal.

Rameshwaram Cafe is famous for its delicious, authentic, ghee-laden South Indian food (especially dosas & filter coffee), exceptional hygiene, fast service, strong social media buzz, and a unique "no refrigeration, no preservatives" policy, creating fresh, flavorful, and Instagrammable dishes that attract massive crowds and influencer attention, making it a modern South Indian food icon in Bangalore.
Key reasons for its fame:

Authentic & Fresh Flavors: Focuses on traditional recipes, quality ingredients, and serving food immediately without refrigeration or artificial additives, giving it a unique taste.

Signature Dishes: Famous for its rich, buttery ghee dosas (especially the Podi Masala Dosa) and aromatic filter coffee.

Hygiene & Quality: Strict hygiene standards and founder control over operations ensure consistent quality across outlets.
Social Media & Marketing: Masterful use of social media, creating visually appealing food and spaces that encourage user-generated content, turning customers into marketers.

Consistency: Delivers a reliable taste and experience, even with high volumes, building trust.

Fast Service Model: A quick-service format with high turnover, designed for busy city dwellers.

Entrepreneurial Success: Rapid growth from a small outlet to a major brand, attracting attention as a startup success story.

This place is very popular for South Indian-style breakfast, and it definitely lives up to the hype. The dosa, idli, vada, and rice items are all excellent. Their filter coffee is also very good.

They also offer a lot of mango specials during season. We tried the poori with aam ras and the mango malai, and both were really good.

The place is almost always crowded, with queues at both the billing counter and the food collection counter. Despite the rush, the service is quite fast and efficient.

name: Third Wave Coffee
review_texts:
Great place if you are someone looking to work ( although don't rely too much on your data internet jio or airtel doesn't comes inside cafe sometimes), or catch up with someone.
Food and beverages is also quite good.
I ordered vietnameese coffee and hazelnut cake both were good.
It costed us around 600.

I've been visiting this outlet for quite some time, and the experience has consistently been excellent. The entire team is warm, courteous, and genuinely welcoming, which makes every visit enjoyable.

A special mention to Deep, who always greets customers with a cheerful smile and positive energy. His friendly attitude and attentive service really stand out and add a personal touch to the overall experience.

As for the coffee, the Mocha and Cold Coffee are my go-to choices and never disappoint. The quality is consistently great, and the café maintains a comfortable and inviting atmosphere.

Kudos to the staff and management for creating such a pleasant place to relax, work, or catch up with friends. Looking forward to many more visits!

Excellent service and consistently great taste! Third Wave never disappoints — the ambience, the staff, and the overall vibe are always top-notch. I absolutely love this place.

One thing I truly appreciate is how pet-friendly they are. They even serve water and food for dogs, which is such a thoughtful touch. The service team is really good too — one staff member even advised me to use the free drinking water available in the store instead of buying bottled water. That level of honesty and customer care is rare these days.

Americano and Cappuccino were really good as always. The bun wasn’t exactly my type, but it was still decent. Peri Peri French fries were tasty and enjoyable.

Overall, a genuinely good spot for coffee lovers, with excellent service and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended!

I have been coming here for quite a while now. Really enjoy the place to sit and work or catch up with friends. The ambience is good enough even if you seriously want to get some work done. Though sometimes the wifi and the network can be down.

I would recommend getting the orange zest mocha or cold coffee.

The finest Third Wave coffee cafe in India is undoubtedly the one located in Indiranagar. Having explored numerous Third Wave establishments, I can confidently state that the Indiranagar branch offers a truly exceptional experience.

name: SMOOR Lounge - Indiranagar
review_texts: Had a wonderful dinner here! We went for the Button mushrooms, chilly cheese toast, veg Thai noodles which was very similar to the famous Malaysian dish Laksa and it was top notch! For dessert we had their mango cheesecake which was the only dish that was average. Their chocolates are too good, you can ask for a sample to try them out, but way too expensive. Valet parking is available.

recently visited Smoor Lounge, and it was truly a wonderful experience from start to finish. The place has such a peaceful, elegant, and cozy ambience, making it a perfect spot to relax and spend quality time with your partner. The calm atmosphere, comfortable seating, and soothing vibe make it ideal for meaningful conversations and unwinding from a busy day.
Coming to the food and desserts—absolutely amazing!
I tried a variety of items, and each one was delightful in its own way.
The Blueberry Cheesecake Pastry was rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced with just the right amount of sweetness. It felt fresh and indulgent, melting in the mouth with every bite.
The Pine Coco Craze Pastry was another highlight—unique, flavorful, and incredibly delicious. The combination of pineapple and coconut was refreshing and tropical, making it stand out from regular pastries.
For beverages, the Regal Rose was refreshing and soothing, while the Bubble Bubblegum drink was fun, vibrant, and surprisingly enjoyable—perfect if you like something playful and different.
The Cajun Spiced Fries were crispy, well-seasoned, and addictive. They were the perfect savory snack to balance out the sweetness of the desserts.
Overall, everything we ordered was fresh, well-presented, and full of flavor. The staff was polite and attentive, and the service was smooth and pleasant, which made the experience even better.
Smoor Lounge is truly a great place for dessert lovers and anyone looking for a calm, romantic, and classy environment. I would highly recommend it to couples, friends, or anyone who wants to enjoy premium desserts in a peaceful setting. I’ll definitely be visiting again! 🍰☕💖

Smoor in Indiranagar has a fantastic ambience, perfect for a treat with loved ones. We picked up a gift box of seven macarons, and they were divine! The Himalayan Salt flavor is an absolute standout and highly recommended. A premium experience that’s worth every bite. Truly delightful!

Truly, one of the best cafe restaurant in Indiranagar. I tasted the ice cream sundae here and it’s just the best delicious ice cream I’ve tasted in Bangalore. The hazelnut cupcakes are also nice here. A nice cozy and aesthetically beautiful place. Good choice for a date.

The best hot chocolate you can find anywhere in Bangalore, or rather in the whole of India!

They are mainly known for their chocolates. I had previously received Smoor chocolates as a gift from one of the companies I worked with, but I never had the opportunity to visit the place. I finally did, and I can definitely vouch for it.

You can visit anytime, as it’s usually not very crowded. It’s also a popular meeting spot where many people come to discuss business or just catch up.

It’s definitely on the expensive side, so you’ll often find a more upscale crowd here.

More than 5 stars from my side. Great ambience, both indoor and outdoor seating options, superb taste, and overall a very classy place.

name: Third Wave Coffee
review_texts:
I had a wonderful experience at Third Wave Coffee, CMH Road, and I feel compelled to share how impressed I was with the overall service and food quality. From the moment I walked in, the ambience was warm and welcoming. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, well-prepared, and full of great flavor. The coffee was perfectly brewed and truly lived up to the Third Wave standard.
What made the experience even more memorable was the outstanding customer service provided by Mr. Punith. He was extremely polite, attentive, and professional, ensuring that everything was taken care of with a smile. He patiently explained the menu, made excellent suggestions, and checked in to make sure we were comfortable and satisfied. His dedication and positive attitude really elevated the entire visit.
Overall, this outlet sets a high benchmark for service, taste, and hospitality. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back again!

My friend was craving a specific coffee and was genuinely disappointed that it wasn’t available on any of the delivery apps anymore. Since she really wanted it, I called Third Wave Coffee to check directly with the store.

They confirmed it was still available on their in-store menu. That’s when Mr. Ekan, the barista, truly went above and beyond. He helped me figure out the ordering process, coordinated with a delivery partner, ensured the timing matched perfectly so the drink was ready when the driver arrived, and packed everything extremely well and securely.

Despite the extra coordination, the whole process felt smooth and effortless, and it was done within minutes. Really appreciate Ekan’s patience and initiative. Exceptional service and great coffee.

Love the coffee, tiramisu and the ambiance.
Service was quick and staffs were amazing.
Had a great time. 🙂

Good place for a meetup ,office meetings, workshops and great ambience.Laptop work friendly cafe that I do see a lot of customers spending their time for office work, business meetings, foreign client meetups and the workshops done in one corner.Cafe is too full everytime post noon and food is yummy and the sandwich and hich tandoori is too full for a meal with a strawberry lemonade

This café used to be really good a couple of years ago, especially their “La’en Rose Coffee” and bagel with cream cheese — they were my absolute favourites. However, when I revisited recently, I felt the place has changed quite a bit. The customer service isn’t as warm as it used to be, probably because most people now come here to work. The overall coffee experience was exceptional before, but this time their filter coffee and cold coffee were just okay.

name: Yogisthaan
review_texts:
Tried Yogisthaan Cafe recently and honestly it was a disappointing experience.

The food was average at best and definitely overpriced for the quality they serve. I ordered a pasta and it felt like it was cooked in tons of tomato puree, completely overpowering the dish. It didn’t taste balanced at all.

The frappe with milk was another letdown. It literally tasted like the kind of milk you get from a milkman who mixes 70% water and 30% milk — extremely diluted and lacking any real flavor.

We also ordered sabudana khichdi, which was served with salted curd. When we asked if they could provide sweetened curd instead, they simply refused. Small requests like that shouldn’t be such a big deal for a cafe.

To make things even more confusing, the hash brown potato was served with curd. I mean… what? That combination just didn’t make sense.

On top of all this, there’s practically no parking space, which makes visiting the place quite inconvenient in a busy area.

Overall, it felt like a very average cafe that’s surviving mainly because it’s located in urban Bangalore, not because of the food quality or experience.

For the prices they charge, the food and overall experience were definitely disappointing.

Came to this self service cafe for the food. Could not figure out what veg food to eat, and put off by the silent vibe, we only tried the paneer palak paratha. It was surprisingly delicious and well balanced out by the curd dip.

Washroom needs an exhaust and the kitchen looks questionable, but might be worth a visit if looking for a quiet atmosphere to work.

Had such a great experience at Youngisthaan Cafe. The ambience is calm, aesthetic, and perfect for working for long hours without feeling distracted. The seating is comfortable, Wi-Fi is reliable, and the overall vibe makes it one of the best work-friendly cafés in Bangalore. The staff is polite and welcoming, and the food is healthy and genuinely good too. A perfect spot for productivity, meetings, or even just spending a peaceful afternoon with your laptop. Definitely coming back again!

My family used to be a regular customer - till today!

Had taken my sister and father who are visiting me and was super disappointed. 2 hours and no sign of food. Mismanagement, arrogance, poor service leading to deep disappointment!

Calmness? At Yogistan? Think again!

The owner - have no words for him. Better left unsaid.

Here you go — reIt was a peaceful and inviting place to visit. We enjoyed the food and the overall experience was great. I recommend it if you prefer a quieter spot with good, healthy food. The ingredients and oil used were of good quality and well balanced.

name: The Srirangam Cafe
review_texts:
Had such a wholesome experience here! The dosa was perfectly crisp on the outside and soft inside — absolutely delicious. The idlis were so fresh, soft, and fluffy that they literally melted in the mouth. But the real highlight for me was the sweet dosa, which was unbelievably tasty and something I’d definitely come back for again. And to end it all, the filter coffee was hands down one of the best I’ve had — strong, aromatic, and perfectly balanced.

Everything tasted authentic, fresh, and made with so much care. If you love South Indian food, this place is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended!

Everything…and I mean EVERYTHING at this this breakfast spot is “melt in your mouth” delicious 🤤
I personally never knew idli could taste this good!
So a new favorite of mine is their Ghee Podi Thatte Idli. Its 100% worth the hype!
My hubby , mama & I also really enjoyed the ghee masala dosa and jaggery filter coffee. The aloo & onions plus the masala was just the perfect combination. Honestly, the best masala I’ve had on a dosa before. The dosa also had a very nice crisp to it.

Another reason I love Srirangam Cafe is because of their hygiene. The tables are cleaned quickly and ready to serve the next customers and they even have a hand washing station to the left of the kitchen.

P.S. Just note there is no washroom available at the cafe, so all you need to do is head to a nearby coffee shop.

Srirangam has been one of my favourite breakfast spots in Indiranagar.

It’s quick, homely and hygienic. Very friendly staff and well maintained. Love the quality of food even on busy days.

They have some of the best dosas and podi idli. But their seasonal dishes and sweets that keep alternating are my favourite addition to the meal.

Holige, Aamras, Gulab Jamun, Dahi Vada, you name it! This is honestly the best spot to go to for breakfast or brunch!

Absolutely loved the food and the overall vibe of this place! The dosa was beautifully crispy and full of flavour, while the idlis were super soft, fluffy, and fresh. The sweet dosa completely stole the show for me — such a unique and delicious taste that I’m still thinking about it. And the filter coffee was just perfect, authentic South Indian style with the right balance of strength and taste.

You can genuinely feel the quality and freshness in every dish. Great service, comforting food, and a place I’d happily visit again and again. Highly recommend trying it out!

We visited Shri rangam Cafe today and had a wonderful experience. We tried the open butter masala dosa, ghee pudi masala dosa, ghee set dosa, ghee sambar button idly, and ghee rava dosa — every dish was fresh, flavourful, and perfectly cooked. We ended our meal with tea and their famous sweets: sweet pongal and kashi halwa, which were absolutely delicious.

The staff treated customers very well, and special mention to Santhosh — he is extremely friendly, and his happiness in serving customers is truly humble. Overall, a great place for authentic taste and warm hospitality. Highly recommended!

name: Chai Days
review_texts:
I came here alone and I enjoyed the small cosy place right across the corner.
I had normal tea (medium is more than enough for a tea loving person) , an almond croissant and a bun maska.
I absolutely loved it and I will recommend it to you all. 🤗

A nice and cozy place to grab a casual coffee or tea in Indiranagar. The ambiance is calm and relaxing, making it a good spot to catch up with friends or spend some quiet time. They offer a good selection of teas, beverages, and snacks, and the service is generally quick. Prices are reasonable, though the place can get crowded during peak hours. Overall, a pleasant café for a refreshing break.

I recently visited Chai Days and had a very disappointing experience.

I ordered a Vietnamese iced coffee, but what I received was a small glass filled almost entirely with ice. The actual coffee quantity was so little that it was finished in just 2 sips. It honestly felt like I was paying for ice, not coffee.

When I raised this with the staff, they casually mentioned that this is how the owner has instructed them to serve it — essentially prioritizing ice over the actual drink. That’s not just poor service, it feels misleading and unfair to customers.

This kind of practice comes across as cutting corners at the expense of customer experience. Definitely not worth the price, and I wouldn’t recommend ordering iced beverages here.

The best spot to get chai after a visit from Bobs bar across the road..

Just order the ginger lemon chai LARGE OR even the MASSALA CHAI- it’s just good tea around good young people of Bangalore .

Always visit here and defo will be back for divali….

see you soon

There was a time when I used to love coming here because of amazing quality of tea, and the crossiant used to melt in mouth that he has become pathetic and the crossroads have become rock. Solid. You can use it as an alternate to hit someone 😄

name: The Filter Coffee - Indiranagar
review_texts:
Chose this place for a breakfast, looking at the ambience. Dint disappoint me.

Good thing about this outlet is, they are giving the consumers a lot of combinations to choose from, even though the number of dishes are focussed on South Indian.

I chose one such - Idly 1 piece, Plain Dosa, Kesari - Small bowl and Mini Filter Coffee. This gives option to taste different varieties and at the same time sufficient quantity to fill the stomach.

Very good taste. Sambar was quite good. I loved the Kesari texture and taste.

On the sustainability front, they use reusable cutleries - Spoon, fork, Tumblers etc. For eating, it's served in Banana leaf and Donna. Initially they mentioned that Mini Filter Coffee will be served in disposable one. However I requested them to serve in Tumbler, which they accepted.

Overall a good dining experience and a  conversation over the breakfast.

Should try this out, if you are in this part of the city.

A True South Indian Delight at The Filter Coffee, Indiranagar! ✨☕

Recently visited The Filter Coffee and it turned out to be an absolutely wonderful experience.

From the moment I stepped in, the warm hospitality and charming South Indian ambiance created a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere. The place beautifully blends simplicity, tradition, and comfort.

The highlight, of course, was the authentic filter coffee—rich, aromatic, perfectly brewed, and served at the ideal temperature. Every sip carried the nostalgic taste of traditional homemade South Indian coffee: bold, smooth, and incredibly satisfying.

The food was equally exceptional. The dosas were crisp and golden, the Pattani Vada was perfectly crunchy, and the chutneys and sambar were fresh, flavorful, and comforting. I also tried:
🥥 Seasoned Steam Balls – soft, fluffy, and surprisingly addictive
🍜 Idiyappam with Coconut Milk & Kurma
🍛 Vegetable Biryani
🥣 Sambar Rice Combo with Raita

Every dish was thoughtfully prepared, hygienic, and packed with authentic flavors that celebrate South Indian cuisine.

If you’re a fan of traditional South Indian food and a perfect cup of filter coffee, this place deserves a spot on your must-visit list.

The place is a lovely little joint on 80 Feet Road in Bangalore. We visited the restaurant for breakfast, and I was genuinely amazed by both the service and the food quality. To begin with, they serve everything on fresh plantain leaves — such a simple touch, but it adds so much charm to the experience.

Once you decide on the menu, the staff take care of everything with ease and efficiency. We ordered Idli, Mini Idlis, Vada, Dosa, and topped it all off with a classic filter coffee. Every item was served hot, fresh, and truly delicious.

A special mention must go to the accompaniments — the White Chutney, Red Chutney, and Sambar were all wonderful. The White Chutney, especially, was absolutely mind-blowing! As a foodie, I’m yet to taste anything quite like it. The coffee too was piping hot and perfectly brewed.

They also have a small confectionery and sweet shop attached, which makes the place even more delightful.

visited The Filter Coffee today (26th April 2026) for breakfast and here’s a quick review of what I tried:

Plain Dosa – 5/5
Crispy and very flavorful.

Idli – 5/5
Soft, fresh, and delicious.

Filter Coffee – 5/5
Rich and well-balanced in taste.

Parking:
No space for four-wheelers, and two-wheelers can be managed somehow.

Price:
On the higher side. At this price point, I hope good-quality ingredients (not palm oil) are being used.
Overall, everything was great except for the pricing, so I’d rate it 4/5.

(The food is delicious, but that one star is because I found a hair in the chutney).

I was supposed to meet a friend here for breakfast and found the place packed, even at 8:45 in the morning.

This is an upmarket tiffin place serving a range of idlis, vadas, dosa, and of course filter coffee, among other items. All the food is served on banana leaves and waiters come around doling out extra helpings of coconut chutney, tomato chutney, and sambar.

I ordered a moringa leaf dosa while my friend had a rice idli, a millet idli, and a vada. Both of us also had filter coffee. The food and the coffee were delicious, but I fished a hair out of the chutney near the end, which was really off-putting.

name: Bombay Brasserie - Indiranagar
review_texts:
I saw lot of reviews on google and wanted to try this place very badly, and i must saw i am so much in love with their dishes.

You must visit here at least once and you might end up going there again.

The staff is okish, i have had better experiences.

Here is what i tried:

Aam papad panner- 4/5
Very new flavour but a must try, paneer was very soft and full of flavour. 🤩

Smoked madras lollipop-4.5/5
Oh it was amazing, tasty, delicious and mouth watery 🤤

Summertime zing- 4/5
Very refreshing for the summer heat

Aam ki lassi-5/5
Only to be ordered when you have more people and if you can finish thick drinks
Its very thick and sweet (obviously)

Cycle wala soup-5/5
Its very tasty and taste like Chinese soup, very delicious .🤤

Kashmiri naan kebab-4.5/5
We couldn’t finish it whole, it comes in a large quantity. Kebab is very delicious 🤤 naan is soft but not big enough to finish the kebab so we ordered one more naan 😮‍💨

Overall the place has very delicious dishes to try, would highly recommend this place.
