I loved the few fusions and experiments they had done with the food, by introducing few traditional dishes ingredients and recipes of Maharashtra. They had different take on the banarasi chaat, and it was surprising great. And the portion size is also good.
Their kebabs was good too, especially the accompanying walnut chutney was very refreshing. Their thecha prawn was not very spicy, but quite flavoursome. But its suitable for all, because not everyone has an appetite for spicy ingredients.
My favorite and showstopper is their cheese Naan bombs. They make one of the best here. Its my everytime order from here.
The staff is polite suggestive and very accommodating. There are 2 things I would appreciate improvement - 1. Making the space cooler, because bangalore has become warm these days even outside of summer season. So an cooler place would be nice to have. 2. Introducing salad options also, so that we can have refreshing options along with rich indian food.
Overall good experience with the food and staff.

We came for a mid week dinner and between the two of us, we shared the Bombay bhel (great texture and flavour), pepper wings (spicy but good), Irani kheema maska pao (tasty), prawn curry with coconut rice (the curry was good but the coconut rice was let down by an excess of coconut milk/cream - it was far too wet).

A perfect Sunday lunch at Bombay Brasserie, where time slows down and flavours take centre stage. From beautifully crafted dishes to the warm, elegant ambience, every detail feels thoughtfully curated. It’s the kind of place where conversations flow easily, plates are meant to be shared, and meals are enjoyed without rushing. The blend of traditional Indian flavours with a modern touch makes the experience both comforting and indulgent. A relaxed afternoon, good food, and great company—exactly how Sundays are meant to be spent. 🍽️✨

The rajasthani kebab was very good, served piping hot and very soft, but it all went downhill from there. The chicken main was way too salty and the ice cream sandwiches were outrageous. A bit of ice cream stuffed inside parle-g does not a dessert make! Unfortunately, cannot recommend the drinks either. Sangria was so tart, didn’t taste fresh at all. The service and atmosphere were the only saviour in the whole game. For the kind of price point, I expect much better culinary skills.

name: 1966 - The Mumbai Cafe @ Indiranagar
review_texts:
1966 Mumbai Cafe @ Indiranagar is a superb café where I thoroughly enjoyed all the food. They were running an offer and kindly provided a 10% discount on the overall bill.
​I was very impressed with the cleanliness and hygiene of the establishment. The atmosphere was good, though the seating capacity is limited. They offer a great variety of different foods, and I especially loved their special Vada Pav.
​The cashier and the food service staff were both good and kind.
​Suggested Improvement: My only suggestion for improvement would be the tea; everything else was excellent😃😋😍.

1️⃣ 🌯 Mumbai Vadapav – Taste is okay, nothing standout.
2️⃣ ☕ Masala Tea – Good and enjoyable; better than the snack.
3️⃣ 💰 Price – ₹70 total feels fair but not exciting value.
4️⃣ 🏙️ Vibe – Casual street-style café experience.
5️⃣ ⭐ Overall – Tea is the highlight; vadapav is average, one-time try.

Had Pav Bhaji yesterday at Mumbai Cafe and was very impressed with the cleanliness and hygiene of the establishment. The atmosphere was good, though the seating capacity is limited for a big crowd!
Our food was given just after 10mins of ordering so waiting time is also minimal.

Since, I am a very big fan of pav bhaji and is particular about the taste, it not 100% justifies the mubaikar taste.

Quick snack joint for all this who love marathi food. Everything is made fresh and served hot. They have a variety of vada pav, trust me the list is long!

My personal favorites are:
•Bun maska(classic!) the bun has a hit of sweetness that makes it so much better!
•Kothimbir vadi
•Solkadi(depends on availability)

They have special lotte icecream range and refreshing combos. Give this chain a try!

Stopped by this amazing Mumbai cafe for some snacks and tea. We had ordered vada pav and bun maska for snacks which was yummy 😋. Tea was also good. The ambience is pretty decent and airy if you're looking for outdoor seating . The prices were also reasonable. They also serve different chats , mocktails and icecream. Would love to visit again for exploring other options.

name: Cafe Terra
review_texts:
This is my second time at the cafe and this place never disappoints. Located at the very important junction of Indiranagar and close to many influencial buildings, this cafe can easily become your favourite.

On my most recent visit we had a comforting Soupy Momo Bowl with Pita Hummus platter. Both were BANGER! The portion size is perfect for one person and can be easily shared between two. The service is pretty quick and brings the food with the best plating.

Will keep coming for more. Thanks a lot!

Lovely Quaint Place with friendly Service… However the Food items are not anything special … it’s nice but not great … Portions are very small … i ordered a French toast expecting it to be a nice Square piece of perfect French Toast dusted with cinnamon powder but what I got was tiny triangular cut  pieces of jam sandwich made with Britannia bread.  It was nowhere near a French toast ( Try a Smoor French Toast. You will know the difference) … The portion of sautéed veggies that we ordered  was very small …  overall nice place to relax but food  was not great … Not a place I would frequently visit but maybe once in a way for a Coffee…

This place has gone down the hole. I used to visit it when it was on the double road. After a long time visited the new outlet and was completely disappointed. We ordered hash brown, bagel sandwich, white sauce pasta, Thai green curry with rice and Irish coffee. The food and the coffee was just terrible. The coffee was horrible with absolutely no flavour of Irish syrup. So was the bagel sandwich. The pasta was somehow still manageable. The decor is below average and there is absolutely no ambience of a decent cafe. I would never visit it again and recommend anyone to visit also. It was such a huge disappointment.
Great ambience, clean and well maintained atmosphere and superb food

Nice cozy place in Indiranagar perfect for a lazy weekend breakfast. We had Cream of Broccoli soup, Spinach & Cheese omelette, Pancakes and Garlic & Cheese mushrooms. Also took Tres Leches cake slices for to-go. Everything tasted great and the service folks are very attentive.

Happy to have chanced upon this during one of our random morning walks around Indiranagar.

Oh BTW they have a nice comic book collection as well. I finished one while waiting for our Tres Leches to-go order (which tasted just wow!)

name: Eddy's Cafe
review_texts:
Amazing, 1st time experience here for me and my pet dog. Other than the tricky parking, everything else is great. Love the idea that Eddy's is pet-first ❤️
We ordered their specials - the chicken steak and mushroom stroganoff. Our dog loved the hearty chicken , pumpkin and rice meal and also the pets from everyone. Cleanliness is also good here.
Will definitely come again! Great pick me up for pets post their vet visits :D
Good food, wifi available for working from here. Hot chocolate is absolutely amazing. Totally worth it. Loved the chicken steak and mashed potatoes also. They also have a cutu doggo waiting for you.

Really loved the vibe here—kind of reminded me of one of my favorite spots back in Dehradun.
My friends had told me good things about the breakfast, and now I get why.
I just had a ginger tea and a juice called Sunset—both were pretty good.
It’s a chill, quiet place… perfect to hang out, have a conversation, or even get some work done.

Went for breakfast; took them 30 minutes to serve without any crowd.
They didn't offer/ask for water, didn't look like the cared.
The food was decent but will not visit again.
I was also asked to pay directly to the staff (Supram) without a bill being generated

Eddy Café is a small and cozy spot in Indiranagar, perfect for a relaxed breakfast. We went there in the morning and loved the warm, inviting ambiance. The menu has some great breakfast options, and everything we tried was fresh and flavorful.

Highly recommend the Caesar salad and egg white omelettes—they were light, well-made, and delicious. The place does get a bit packed due to its size, but that also adds to its charm. Definitely a great café for a quiet and satisfying breakfast!

name: Toit
review_texts:
Toit Brewpub: A Bangalore Essential
​Every time I visit Bangalore, Toit is a mandatory stop. I visited two days in a row on my recent solo trip, including the IPL final day. Even with queue ticket #58 and an hour-long wait, it was entirely worth it!
​The Vibe: Generally secure and calm. It got a bit noisy during the match, but it was completely tolerable and a lot of fun for a solo traveler.
​Visuals & Details: The venue’s clear lighting and attention to detail really appeal to my aquarist side. The mood was so perfect I had to pull out my Sony a7III to capture some great shots of the space.
​The Service: The staff's behavior is excellent, polite, and they handle the busy crowd perfectly.
​Highly recommended!

TIOT Bangalore is an absolute gem for beer lovers and food enthusiasts! The freshly brewed craft beers are exceptional, with a great variety of flavors to suit every palate. Whether you enjoy a light, refreshing brew or something bold and rich, TIOT has something special for you.

The food is equally impressive. Every dish is packed with flavor, beautifully presented, and perfectly complements the beer selection. From delicious starters to mouthwatering main courses, the quality and taste are consistently outstanding.

The ambiance is vibrant yet comfortable, making it a perfect spot for hanging out with friends, celebrating special occasions, or simply unwinding after a long day. The staff is friendly, attentive, and always happy to recommend the best food and beer pairings.

A must-visit destination in Bangalore for anyone who appreciates great craft beer, amazing food, and a fantastic atmosphere. Looking forward to my next visit!

Toit in Indiranagar is universally famous for its incredible craft beers, lively crowds, and fantastic night-out atmosphere, but if you haven’t visited them on a weekend morning for breakfast, you are genuinely missing out on one of Bangalore's best-kept secrets. Stepping into the familiar, beautiful wood-paneled space when it’s calm, flooded with morning sunlight, and smelling of fresh coffee instead of hops is an experience in itself. While their continental breakfast options look great, the absolute star of the morning is their stellar appam menu. I managed to try all their appam variations, and calling them heavenly is an understatement.

The kitchen handles traditional Kerala-style textures flawlessly. Every single version features perfectly made lacy appams brilliantly crisp, golden, and webbed at the edges, while remaining soft, pillowy, and beautifully cloud-like right in the center. The Bull’s Eye Appams are an absolute work of art, topped with flawless sunny-side-up eggs that break into a rich yolk, perfectly balanced by the sharp, savory bite of the accompanying Sri Lankan coconut sambal and podis. The Egg Roast and Appams hit with a comforting, nostalgic heat; the country eggs are enveloped in a deeply caramelized, intensely spiced tomato and onion masala that coats the delicate appams beautifully. Finally, the Appams with Stew offer pure, unadulterated comfort. The rich, velvety coconut milk base is subtly aromatic, perfectly infusing the fresh vegetables or meats, creating a mild yet complex flavor profile that cleanses the palate. Pairing these traditional, fiery, and comforting dishes with a hot South Indian filter coffee in a microbrewery setting is the ultimate weekend plot twist. It’s a phenomenal breakfast that deserves just as much fame as their beers.

Had an absolutely wonderful experience at TOIT, Bangalore. From the moment you walk in, the ambience sets the tone — lively yet comfortable, with that perfect blend of industrial charm and warmth that makes you want to sit back and enjoy your time without rushing.

The staff truly deserve special praise. Everyone was polite, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They took the time to explain the menu, suggested great options, and made sure everything was perfect throughout the visit without being intrusive. You can really feel the professionalism and positive energy in the service.

The food was outstanding — fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Every dish we tried was well-balanced and clearly prepared with care. The quality of ingredients really shows, and the portions are generous, making it great for sharing with friends or family. And of course, TOIT’s reputation for its brews is well earned — smooth, refreshing, and perfectly paired with the food.

Overall, TOIT is more than just a place to eat or drink — it’s an experience. Great food, excellent service, and a vibrant ambience all come together seamlessly. Definitely a place I’d return to and happily recommend to anyone visiting Bangalore.

As a beer lover, I never miss a visit to Toit whenever I’m in town, and this time too, it did not disappoint. Visited on a Wednesday evening with colleagues and had an okay overall experience.

Pros:

1. Absolutely loved their wide range of craft beers. The IPA and Hefeweizen were my personal favourites.
2. The food was equally impressive — freshly prepared, tasty, and served in generous portions.
3. The ambience has a rustic, woody charm that gives the place a warm and welcoming old-school vibe. The pub was also neat and well-maintained.
4. Compared to many other pubs, the pricing felt quite reasonable for the quality and experience offered.

Cons:

1. We had to wait for over an hour to get seated as there was a huge queue, and the staff seemed overwhelmed.
2. The service was quite slow. It took us more than 20 minutes just to get hold of someone to place our order, and the food arrived after another 35+ minutes.

Despite the delays, the beer, food, and ambience made the visit worthwhile.

name: Spettacolare
review_texts:
A Must Visit: Spectacular Panzerotti & Neapolitan Pizza, but limited Pasta Options for Vegetarians

A very amazing Italian Place! The pizza was great, but the Panzerotti was spectacular or should I say Specttacolare!

The sauce with the Panzerotti was the best I have had in a while! Fresh and a little peperry, very amazing !

The pizza was good too!

Word of Advice: If you are a Pure Vegetarian, go for the Panzerotti and Pizza , because the Veg Pasta Options are limited, most of the widely known pasta options here have egg in them.

Further, the Pinsa Romana is not available any longer, so the only Pizza you would get in neopolitan style.

Hello reader , before you make your plans to visit this cozy cafe , here’s a brief review for the same .. I have been here twice , the first time I had bruschetta and Pizza and both were finger licking good and to mention It was on a week day so it not at all crowded , however today - I mean Sunday was my second visit to this cafe and the food was so very average today- we ordered two dishes today as well one was panuzzo and the other was ravioli pasta if I am not mistaken in pesto sauce , which had a stone in the food which was extremely disappointing. Overall it was a decent experience, hope my review helps !!

It’s a hard place to review. My judgement of a restaurant pretty much comes down to ‘ did the food wow me enough to make me visit it again?’ And in the case of Spettacolare I don’t think I will. Don’t get me wrong, there were some stand out  dishes but nothing that made me stop in my tracks. And when one is paying the prices they are at this joint I expect to be fully wowed. The dishes I have to highlight are the pizza which has an awesome base, one of the best out there though the toppings was a let down for me personally. The ravioli was decent but forgettable. The hot chocolate was devoured by the kids before I could take a snap. But with what I tasted it’s decent. Overall worth a visit to try out some decent vegetarian Italian fare if you are feeling experimental.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Spettacolare — what an amazing restaurant! It serves some truly delicious Italian cuisine. The pizzas are incredibly flavorful, with authentic taste and great ingredients.

Their hot chocolate is a must-try — rich, comforting, and absolutely delightful. I’ve visited this place multiple times, and it still never gets boring. The quality and taste keep bringing me back.

The only drawback is that the vegetarian options are quite limited, which can be a little disappointing for vegetarians.

Overall, a wonderful place for Italian food lovers and definitely worth visiting again and again. 🇮🇹🍕☕

I visited this restaurant today. The ambience is nice, but the food was just average. We tried pizza, pasta, bruschetta, and hot chocolate. While there are definitely better places for pizza and pasta, their pizza base was soft and impressive. The hot chocolate is more suited for those who enjoy a strong dark chocolate flavor. Overall, it was an okay experience—good for a one-time visit.

name: Chaayos Cafe - Indiranagar
review_texts:
Here's a more polished version:

> Visited Chaayos, Indiranagar for a Kintsugi workshop hosted by @art.attack143. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish. I also got to create and paint a clay keychain, which made the session even more enjoyable. Shreya and Pavithra were warm, patient, and incredibly helpful throughout the workshop, making the experience comfortable and engaging. Chaayos also offers a good selection of vegetarian food and beverages, making it a great place to relax while enjoying the workshop. Highly recommended for anyone looking to try something creative and meaningful.

Visited Chayos and honestly, I’m confused about what went wrong here — because this was nothing like the Chayos experience elsewhere.

The ambience was extremely dirty, tables and surroundings poorly maintained. The washroom was broken, and the ladies’ toilet wasn’t even functional, which is unacceptable for any café, let alone a known brand.

Food-wise, Litchi Pop Fizz was the only decent item. Everything else was a letdown. The chai itself wasn’t up to the mark, which is ironic for a place built around chai. The sandwich was burnt beyond edible, as clearly visible, and no one seemed to care.

Staff behaviour was unprofessional and indifferent, with zero urgency or accountability.

I’ve been to Chayos at Bhartiya City Mall, and the difference is night and day — better hygiene, better food, better service. This outlet is seriously dragging the brand down. Definitely not worth a repeat visit.

Loved the korean bun and have always been a fan of chaayos tea . It is definitely pricy but worth it.

Edit : visited chayos again and had the utterly disappointing experience unlike the first time and first review. Something happened here , ordered for 800 rupees got food worth 200 , burnt ! And of low quality- the korean cream bun worth 250 - was a bun with the least possible cheese on the top with no cream ! - the street food was way better . Service was equally pathetic. Lost its charm - never visiting again !
As usual, superb chai. Ambience was also good. Good place to chill and talk.

Hygienic is not maintained. Worst. Simply taking premium prices. Why should we pay so much for this?

When asked about this, manager is telling that they will wash chopped onions and it doesn't matter how we cut....is this road side or what?

Learn to say sorry to customers first when mistake is made. Absolute arrogance..

name: Dyu Art Cafe
review_texts: This cafe's ambiance is truly captivating! ✨ I adore the calm vibe, especially with the beautiful paintings, lush trees, and cozy lighting. The food is wonderful too! If you're planning a weekend visit, arrive before 5 PM to beat the crowd. Parking's usually easy to find on the main road. Highly recommend! 💖

Dyu Art Cafe is a small, cozy café with beautiful aesthetics and a peaceful atmosphere. The rustic interiors and greenery make it a great place to relax, catch up with friends, or spend a quiet afternoon.

The food was good, with a decent variety of options at reasonable prices. Overall, it was a nice experience and a café that’s worth visiting for its ambiance as much as its food.

Dyu Art Cafe is one of those hidden gems that instantly makes you feel calm and relaxed. The ambience is beautifully peaceful with its old Bangalore house-style architecture, cozy courtyard seating, greenery, and artistic vibe. It’s the perfect place to slow down, sip coffee, and enjoy meaningful conversations away from the city rush.

The food was fresh, comforting, and simple in the best way possible. Their coffee and breakfast options paired perfectly with the quiet atmosphere. What really makes the place special is the warm natural lighting, rustic interiors, and soothing music that create such a comforting experience.

Whether you want to work peacefully, catch up with friends, or simply spend some alone time with a book and coffee, Dyu Art Cafe offers the perfect blend of art, calmness, and great food. ☕🌿✨

Dyu Art Cafe is one of those rare places that instantly makes you slow dow, it has a beautiful, peaceful courtyard with lots of greenery and a charming rustic vibe that feels both cozy and refreshing. The ambience is perfect for unwinding, catching up with friends, or even spending some quiet time alone.
We tried their filter coffee along with fish and chips, chicken pasta and everything was absolutely delightful. Their cheesecake, in particular, is a must-try. The overall experience is elevated by the calm atmosphere and simple yet elegant setting.

The ambience is good, and friendly, peaceful. Best during evening hours due to lights and the environment. It has a few of paintings for showcase as well. Good for couples and group of friends.

We ordered pizza, chocolate cake, and coconut mousse. I found pizza was ok ok, may be thin crust is not my taste. However, the desserts were great.

name: Chaipatty Teafe
review_texts:
My first visit to Chaipatty was excellent. The owner was very friendly, and my friend and I worked from the café for around 4 hours. We ordered food worth more than ₹700, and I also paid separately for Wi-Fi, which was charged at ₹60 per hour. During that time, the owner even allowed me to use one of the rooms for a meeting. I was genuinely grateful for the support and hospitality. Before we left, the owner mentioned that many people come there to work and that they would be happy to host us again.

Because of that positive experience, I decided to return a couple of days later. If I had written my review immediately after my first visit, it would have been an easy 5-star rating.

However, my second visit was completely different. When I arrived, the café was almost empty. I worked there for about 3 hours and ordered food worth over ₹300. This time, I didn't use the Wi-Fi or even plug in my charger. After a few hours, the owner approached me and said the table was reserved. I was happy to move to another table, but then she commented that I had been sitting there without ordering anything. I offered to place another order, but the interaction made me feel unwelcome.

I packed up my things and left. What disappointed me most was the contrast between the warm welcome during my first visit and how I was treated on my second. I've worked from many cafés in Indiranagar and have never had an experience that made me feel this embarrassed or uncomfortable.

I understand that cafés need to manage seating and reservations, but clearer communication and consistency would have made a big difference. The reason I returned was because I genuinely believed what I was told during my first visit—that the café welcomed people who came to work. Unfortunately, my second experience left me feeling otherwise.

The ambiance is very cozy and warm, especially with evening lighting. Very friendly owner and family. The food and chai is great. Lovely options. We had the chai, maggi and french toast. Delicious breakfast place. Loved it all!

One of my favorite chill spots in Indiranagar has to be Chaipatty Teafe. The place has such a cozy and laid-back vibe that makes it perfect for long conversations, late evening chai sessions, or just relaxing after a hectic day. The seating and ambience feel warm and comfortable, giving it that homely café atmosphere that’s hard to find in Bangalore these days.
What really makes the place special is the way the owners and staff treat people. They’re genuinely friendly, welcoming, and make regular customers feel at home. You can tell they care about creating a space where people can simply sit and enjoy good company.

Loved the place…feels like we are eating at home. They cater some real good & healthy food here (in the world filled with unhygienic & fake food).

Chirag (owner) & auntie were real nice and we have had some good conversation with them.
Would definitely recommend this to all.
Loved the place & vibe. This is a hidden gem in the streets of Indranagar 🩵🩵

A perfect little tea spot for a cozy evening! ☕✨
The ambience is warm and inviting—ideal for unwinding with a cup of chai. The food feels homely and comforting, with every bite tasting fresh and delicious. What makes it even better is how budget-friendly everything is. Definitely a go-to place for relaxed tea-time and snacks!

name: Yuki - Cocktail Bar and Kitchen | Indiranagar
review_texts:
Had lunch at Yuki recently and honestly, it was such a good experience. The sushi was super fresh and probably some of the best I've had in a while. Every dish we ordered was packed with flavor and disappeared way too quickly!

The cocktails were amazing too and definitely not an afterthought. We ended up ordering a second round because they were that good.

The vibe of the place is really nice, not too loud, not too formal, just the kind of spot where you relax and enjoy good food. The staff was friendly and attentive throughout as well.

Already looking forward to my next visit. If you're a sushi lover, this place is definitely worth checking out.

Had dinner at Yuki recently. It was over-all a good experience. Following is what I ordered and my personal ratings:

1) Oriental Chicken Satay (8 out of 10): I personally found the chicken to be well flavoured, marinated and really juicy (although being chicken breast). I found the accompanying sause extremely sweet almost dessert like, but the Satay by itself is a must try.

2) Spicy Chicken and Celery Dimsum (7.7 out of 10): Honestly nothing to brag about, but a nice soup dumpling, and in a way really refreshing.

3) Belgian Pork Spare Ribs (7.8 out of 10): I found the pork to be slightly on the gamey-er side, but I enjoyed the tangy-sweet tamarind and chilli sause.

4) Spicy Miso Ramen Pork (7.2 out of 10): I liked pretty much everything about this dish, expect the noodles. I'm not sure what kind of noodles they used, but it didn't taste like the highest quality. I personally feel noodle holds the ramen together, hence I found this dish capable on a much needed improvement. I would strongly recommend a thinner noodle.

On the negative side, I found my table to pretty be sticky, likely from a beverage spill, which wasn't cleaned very well. I think Yuki can do better here to improve the dining experience.

The service was great, the staff were attentive, helpful and enthusiastic which added very positively to my dinning experience.

Something worth noting is that the restaurant can get loud, especially during the evenings, which can be unpleasant for a date or a smaller crowd, but that should be expected considering that it is also a cocktail bar.

Yuki absolutely blew us away! This is hands down some of the best Asian food we’ve ever had. After trying so many different Asian cuisines across North America, nothing has come close to the quality and flavor we experienced here.

The dimsums were incredibly fresh and perfectly crafted, and the tempura was light, crispy, and absolutely delicious. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared with amazing attention to detail.

If you’re looking for exceptional Asian food, Yuki is an absolute must-visit. We’re already excited to go back! 🍜✨

Yuki is a great spot for traditional Asian cuisine, including Japanese, Singaporean, and Thai dishes. We tried sushi, nasi goreng, a few desserts, and drinks, and everything tasted really good. The ambience was also lovely and added to the overall experience.

It feels more like a dining experience than just a regular place to eat. We’d definitely recommend visiting at least once, especially if you want to try something different from the usual Indian cuisine.

Finally got to try Yuki and see what the hype is all about! And honestly it didn't disappoint! The food, the atmosphere, the service was all top notch! We were served by Chavi and she was the sweetest of all to guide us and help us with everything!
There was live music as well which was amazing!
Overall a 10/10 experience if you love sushi and good food!
We tried : Sushi, Khoy sway, dimsums, cocktails and soju/sake!

name: Indiranagar Social
review_texts:
I visited Social on a Friday night with spouse. We prebooked the table and once we reached, we requested them a table at the ground floor so that we can enjoy the ambience.
They have separate seatings, one outside in the smoking zone, other near bar at ground floor and next at first floor which is super quiet if you just wish to talk and spend time here eating. We chose the place near bar.
We ordered Mocktails, Corn salad, Momos, and Paneer Biryani. Everything tasted good. Staff is also very calm, polite and friendly. One of the staff members helped us changing the place thrice so that we can be satisfied with our seating choice.
Parking of two wheeler could be a problem as there is no dedicated parking and one has to find the spot on his own. But anyways I would love to be here again.

SOCIAL Indiranagar is Bangalore's ultimate nightlife destination! The space is stunning — a repurposed bungalow with 3 floors, moody 70s decor, neon lights, graffiti, and a speakeasy bar on the 1st floor. It's like a house party hub! 🎉
The drink menu at SOCIAL Indiranagar is fantastic! Huge selection of draft beers (smooth, well-balanced), signature cocktails (perfectly mixed), and mocktails.
🔥 The place is MASSIVE......

It’s a nice eatery present at the Indiranagar main road. I liked the food options here mostly the snacks. I would recommend this place for a nice evening or afternoon snacking. Seating area could feel little enclosed but as an overall there are variety of seating options. Nice place for group of friends

this is my second time visiting here. Once again, it was a really good experience. The food was delicious and well presented. We ordered a loaded nachos dish with cheese and toppings and a flatbread style pizza. Both tasted great and were filling.

The ambience is lively and perfect for hanging out with friends, especially in the evening. Service was quick and the staff was friendly. Overall, a great place for dinner with good food, vibe, and quality. Will definitely visit again.

Located on the banks of indira nagar and thippasandra is a unique three floored socials like you have never seen before. Each floor has a theme of their own with the top floor turning into a rave party for the local DJs on a weekend night. The second floor is more of a quite zone and could be for those on date night. The bottom floor has a small dance floor as well. It definitely feels cramped up.

I like to get the negatives out of the way and that came in the form of their service. First of all they either need to keep the soft menus or remove them because we end up ordering from the phone which does not have all the items based on the time of the day. Even if you find a dish on the physical menu, it is so hard to locate that on the mobile app. They really need to improve on the UX of the application. The waiter also had no clue on the availability of certain dishes too. When we asked him to add those dishes through his system, he struggled and mentioned that the wifi was weak where we were sitting so was not able to place the order. Eventually he was able to. We waited for about close to 30-40 mins before we could place an order. Well that wasnt the end of the negatives. The ground floor AC unit was not working. I could have taken it on any other day but it being a Friday with an event going on, there was a flock of people which made the whole experience unbearable as well as suffocating. When we asked the staff, they mentioned that the unit was not working for the past 2 days. Not acceptable at all!!! I was just glad to be out of there.

Ok now thats done, its time for the positives which means its about the food. Socials everywhere has a standard when it comes to the food they serve. We had the mutton pressure cooker where they actually served it in a pressure cooker. We felt like taking the cooker home hahah. It was rich in flavor that was complemented with the spiciness. This made for the opening of a few sweat glands. The mixed grill platter was great as well. All the meat were cooked to perfection. Overall loved the food, not so much the rest of the package. Socials please look into these aspects. I feel the menu issue is something that the team might want to talk about. Either keep the physical menu or remove it. We end up wasting time because while deciding we were choosing dishes that were not available on the app.

name: Flax Cafe
review_texts: A real cozy spot on double road Indira nagar. The ambience is definitely made for a quiet reflection and recharge day, to which the food screams yes! The menu is filled with healthy items which might not suit everyone. Everything was made with fresh ingredients which I loved. The bowl was my favourite. Vegetarians would have a field day here. Again a disclaimer, it is mainly healthy food, so if you are looking to get more flavour then this is probably not the place.

Food was quite dry, and some of the ingredients did not seem particularly fresh. We ordered a wrap and a rice salad bowl. The wrap was served with an extremely small portion of dip—barely enough for a few bites—so we had to request extra sauce, which ended up being the only thing that made it enjoyable.

The rice salad bowl came with a good sauce initially, but the quantity was not sufficient for the bowl, so we requested an additional portion. The second serving, however, was noticeably runnier and more watery than the first, which was disappointing and inconsistent.

Considering the pricing, the overall quality and experience did not feel justified. The staff also did not come across as particularly welcoming, and the seating was uncomfortable. While the ambience was decent, it was not enough to make up for the other shortcomings.

Overall, there is significant room for improvement in terms of food quality, consistency, hospitality, and value for money. I would not choose to visit again.

Had gone here for breakfast.
We ordered a sandwich, shakshouka and a omelette with truffle oil cream cheese etc.

The fist two were really good but the omelette did not have any truffled mushrooms in it nor any cream cheese. On asking the waiter he said that they don’t make it like that anymore and the menu description had not been updated. A customer orders based on what is written in the menu.

Charging 425 for a plain overcooked omelette on a single slice of sourdough seemed unreasonable.

Wonderful little cafe downstairs with a full menu of delicious options being served in the restaurant on the first floor. Friendly staff, well-lit, good comfortable furniture makes this a good place to enjoy your coffee or a meal of your choice. Seating also available on the balcony for those seeking fresh air!

Tried the Falafel Super bowl after having tried Mediterranean bowl previously through a friend’s recommendation.

Absolutely love their ethos, food options, and quality. The price feels totally justified for what they offer.

It’s clear from this creation what and how the creator of this place thinks and I would love to meet him/her in person and thank them for creating this for us all.

Definitely recommended 👍🏾

Visited and reviewed on 25.10.2025

name: infinitea Indiranagar
review_texts:
I recently visited Infinitea Kitchen Plus Tea Bar, and it was a delightful experience.
The ambiance was warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxing break. The Hibiscus Tea was wonderfully refreshing, and the standout highlight was their sandwich which was rich in flavor and perfectly balanced.
Service was attentive, making the whole visit feel special. I’d definitely return for a mix of great food and a peaceful vibe.

Loved the place!

Great ambience and a really good location. The food was excellent… the Norwegian salmon stood out for me, full of flavour and perfectly cooked. I tried the Matcha Greenita. I was hesitant at first, but the host recommended it and I’m so glad I tried it.. Absolutely loved it.

My friend ordered the Enigma on the Rocks, which was quite nice as well.We also tried the Oriental Salad which has a nice pan pan Asian flavour ..yumm.. 😋.. Also the pan-fried momos, and they were really good too.

Overall, a great place to fine dine as well . Would definitely go back!

Honestly one of the most calming and cozy cafés I’ve visited in Bangalore 🍵✨

The food, ambience, music, and overall vibe were absolutely amazing. Perfect place to relax, work from café, or just spend quality time with your friends. Everything felt so aesthetic and peaceful 😍

Really loved the experience here and I’d definitely recommend everyone to visit at least once. Can’t wait to come back again 😊

The food is fresh, delicious and made of healthy ingredients (as opposed to maida). Even when you overeat (and it's so easy to overeat here), you don't feel bloated or uncomfortable.

Chef Gaurav and Deeksha have created an incredible space/tea room that feels intimate while serving the most delicious food and various kinds of teas. Their tea kombuchas are house made and again delicious.

Highly recommend this tea house.

My personal favourites are their masala tea which is served with khari biscuits, reminding one of a relaxed Mumbai evening; pastas, buerre noisette ravioli (the best I have had in India, comparable to what one gets in Italy) and the blueberry cheesecake.

A cute little tea room, it has amazing tea. The owner is very knowledgeable in different tea varieties, and has a tea garden of his very own. So the quality of the tea is guaranteed. However, the food portions are too small for the price they are charging. I wish they were providing a bit more on the plate.

name: Nerlu Cafe
review_texts:
Visited this place after hearing so many great reviews on social media. It was quite crowded on a Friday evening, but we eventually managed to get a seat.

They offer a wide variety of coffee options, including flat white, black coffee, and several other beverages. Their menu also features open sandwiches, quick bites, smoothies, salads, soups, and crostinis. The café has both indoor and outdoor seating, with the outdoor area allowing smoking. They also have a selection of merchandise available for purchase.

We ordered the Mocha Frappe, Hot Chocolate, Iced Nutella Latte, Peri Peri Fries, Marinara Veggie Sandwich, and Citrus Zest Espresso. Every item was delicious, and we thoroughly enjoyed the overall taste and quality of the food and beverages.

I grew up in crescent road and for me to visit this place is like going back to nostalgia.
It's that kind of a calm place I'm sure we can spend hrs to sit down.. unwind or chill with your friends.
The food is outstanding and the beverages are top class.
I like the Tea varieties and lemon iced tea I'd my favorite.
The staff is the core of the Cafe and they so caring with best customer service.
I'm sure I will comeback 100 more times.

Keep up the good work and quality!!

Nerlu Cafe was on our list for quite some time and we managed to come here a day after the heavy rains. Finding a parking for a four wheeler was quite the challenge over here. The ambiance is nice, loved how the open kitchen is sorta setup as the main focal aspect of the cafe. We had the following at Nerlu Cafe.

Saigon Special, a cold coffee version that was strong on coconut milk while shakerato was based on black coffee. Both were pretty decent, nothing spectacular as such.

Coronation Chicken is a open toast that tasted good, the small pieces of chicken were coated with masala and served fresh. Mushroom Crostini was good too, portion wise a bit small but I guess that’s fine.

The place is full most of the time and I wouldn’t say you get a lot of privacy here as the tables are too close to each other.

Ideally 4.5. This is a very café-looking café, it's the kind of place you imagine when someone mentions going to a café, the kind of place you see in illustrations and cartoons and I love that. The vibe is very lowkey and chill and the decor is minimalist. Their chairs (at least the indoor seating ones) are very comfortable too. I had a really good time, because I had good company and because it was very comforting to be here.
I got the elderflower espresso lemonade and it was very delicious (I love that it came with a metal straw). I thought the quiche was quite overpriced for the size but the open sandwich was loaded with chicken so it was worth it. The spices for the chicken were really popping and I think they use the same on the chips which made it really cohesive and a really good meal; I don't know where they get their chips from but they're thick cut and have a gorgeous crunch to it, really very good. The bread for the sandwich was also really good, a very well rounded plate of food.
Would absolutely visit again and bring other people.

Landed in Bangalore and headed straight to Nerlu. Told the barista, Razi, that I wanted an iced black coffee and asked for a recommendation. He suggested the Citrus Cold Brew. I said, “Fair enough, let’s do it.”

Best decision of the day.

That Citrus Cold Brew was an easy 5 out of 5. Actually, scratch that. It deserves its own rating system. Easily the best cold brew I’ve had. Smooth, refreshing, ridiculously well balanced. One sip in and I was questioning every cold brew I’ve had before this. Absolute god tier stuff.

While we were busy discussing coffee, pour overs and other coffee nerd topics, Razi asked what roast profile I usually prefer. I said light roast. A few minutes later he handed me an iced pour over and told me to give it a try.

That was another winner. Clean, bright and exactly the kind of coffee that reminds you why people become coffee snobs in the first place.

After I finished both drinks, I went back to tell him how much I loved them. That’s when he told me the beans were from Beachville Coffee Roasters.

Naturally, I smiled and said, “Yeah, I know them.” Sometimes being a coffee nerd actually pays off.

Nerlu absolutely nailed the experience. Great coffee, great recommendations and even better conversations. If you’re in Bangalore and remotely interested in specialty coffee, just go. Don’t overthink it. The Citrus Cold Brew alone is worth the trip

name: PlanB
review_texts: PlanB always comes with variety of wings options but now this time this place launches 9 new flavours in pizza which was really amazing. The ambience is really very cool, each corner was so photogenic. We have tried the pizza and really the taste was really amazing. And the reason Why I come here is the amazing offer which I really like the most that’s you will get 30% off on all burger which is applicable on Every Monday and also will get 50% off on all wings which is applicable on Every Tuesday. So Whenever you are searching for best pizza and wings spot in Indiranagar then don’t forget to visit this place.

Had a great lunch at Plan B Indiranagar with 4 friends. We ordered 6 dozen wings based on our server's recommendation, along with pasta, pizza, desserts, beers, and cocktails. My favorites were the Creamy Buffalo Wings and Spicy Garlic Wings—both were amazing!

The service was excellent, and the manager personally came to collect our feedback while we were paying. He also informed us about their offers, including 1+1 on beers and 50% off on pizzas. Great food, friendly staff, and a wonderful experience. Will definitely visit again!

Plan B in Indiranagar has become a fairly well-known casual dining spot in Bangalore’s East, often praised online for its lively ambience and relaxed vibe. But on our visit, the experience felt like a classic case of “good on paper, average in practice.” We started with a round of mocktails, but were struck by how inconsistent they were: every time we ordered a repeat, they arrived in different glasses and looked entirely different in presentation and colour. Unfortunately, this inconsistency was mirrored in taste and portion size too — which felt overpriced for what we got. The French fries variations we tried were solid and enjoyable, crisp and well-seasoned, but the positives tapered off after that. The Fiery Chicken turned out to be little more than diced chicken and onions with minimal flavour — hardly a “fiery” dish worth the name. We also tried two types of pasta (white sauce and red sauce), but both were meager in quantity given the price point, leaving us unsatisfied. One thing that stood out in a negative way was how limited the food menu itself was — for a place of this positioning, the absence of something as basic as a pizza was hard to believe. Service was another sore point: slow, lackadaisical, and not particularly attentive, even when the restaurant wasn’t packed. The ambience is nice and laid-back, and that’s genuinely where Plan B scores — it’s an Instagram-friendly, cozy space to hang out. But with inconsistent drinks, so-so service, limited food choices, and portions that don’t match the pricing, this place truly lives up to its name: Plan B. And honestly? It’s one I’d only pick if Plan A is nowhere in sight. Overall: 3/5.

Honey chilli wings balance sweet honey and bold chilli flakes for a sticky glaze. Peri peri wings bring sharp heat, citrus, and garlic using African bird's eye chillies. Both deliver a powerful flavor punch.
The spicy wing challenge is definitely not for the beginners
Good offers and happy hours 😉

Had a great experience at Plan B! The staff were very friendly, suggested good food options, and provided excellent service throughout. The Peri Peri Wings and Creamy Buffalo Wings were absolutely delicious — definitely a must-try! 🍗🔥

Also, they currently have a pizza festival offer with 50% OFF on all pizzas, which is amazing 🍕✨. Really enjoyed the music, atmosphere, and overall vibe of the place. Highly recommended for good food and a great experience!

name: Paris Panini - Gourmet Sandwiches & Wraps, Indiranagar
review_texts:
I've been here multiple times and I try a different panini everytime. What keeps me coming back is the freshness their food holds in general. I love the fact that their breads etc is made in house, and their French dip is just yum!
The staff are polite, friendly and professional.
It's great to see that they've shifted to a new location which is bigger & better in terms of space & ambience. I love how quiet it is, probably it's cuz of the timings I visit.
I've not explored other sections of their menu yet but, I'm positive that it would be good.

I had an amazing experience at Paris Panini in Indiranagar! The sandwiches and wraps are absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly crafted. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients in every bite.

The menu has a great variety, whether you're in the mood for something classic or something a bit more gourmet. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with a beautiful France flag color theme that adds a unique and charming touch to the place.

The staff is friendly, attentive, and quick with service, which makes the whole experience even better. It’s a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great meal.

Managed to find a spot in the hustle and bustle of Church Street.
We ordered:
• Mattheu Panini with chicken strip combo
• Buffalo sauce wrap
• Vanilla matcha latte(we asked them to make it cold)
• Caramel crepe

Inaka their very helpful captain helped us with our order, suggesting us and helping us customize the order as per our preference.
We loved the taste of all the food we had. Everything was yummy! I will be coming back for more!

Visited Paris Panini with a friend and had such a lovely experience. The food was excellent. The cheesy jalapeno poppers were an absolute favourite, followed closely by the Cajun fries. We also tried the Sophie panini which was filling and really well made. Everything came with their homemade ketchup and dips which were delicious.

What truly stood out was the service. We spent hours chatting and were never rushed or disturbed. A special mention to Arjun for being warm, attentive, and making the experience even better.

Highly recommend this place if you are looking for gourmet sandwiches and wraps in Bengaluru with great service and a relaxed atmosphere.

From the moment we walked in, the ambiance felt warm and inviting! Nice lighting, cozy seating and a relaxed vibe. The food was absolutely delicious, their pastas anre to die for annd their mathieu panini was made my day! The service was also top-notch., staff were friendly, attentive and quick which made the meal even more enjoyable.

All in all, a fantastic experience. If you’re in the mood for great food, lovely atmosphere and smooth service, Paris Panini is definitely worth a visit.

name: The Hole In The Wall Cafe
review_texts: One of the best breakfast spots in Koramangala! The food was fresh and delicious, the ambience was cozy, and the service was friendly. Items ordered were flavourful, portions were satisfying, and the cold coffee complemented the meal perfectly. The cafe has a warm, charming ambience that's ideal for catching up with friends or enjoying a leisurely breakfast. Definitely worth visiting for a relaxed brunch. Highly recommended!

I first visited this restaurant back in 2016, and I remember having a pretty good experience. The decor was very cute. Since then, they have actually renovated the place, and the atmosphere is quite nice now.

Looking at the menu, it hasn't changed much from before, and the drinks are still incredibly cheap. We ordered a mango juice and a mango shake, but I was really disappointed. My mango juice was clearly loaded with sugar and very watered down. My friend's mango shake was also very thin. It felt like the quality matched the price: cheap, but not good.

Despite that, the restaurant was still very crowded. Apparently, their food is supposed to be better, but since I didn't try any, I can't really comment on that. I just felt that the drinks were lacking.

We had a wonderful experience at The Hole in the Wall Café in Koramangala. It is famous for its cozy atmosphere and delicious breakfast options, the café offers a warm and welcoming vibe that makes it a great spot to relax and unwind. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, with generous portions that lived up to its reputation.

The service was friendly and attentive, and the casual ambiance added to the overall charm of the place. Whether visiting for a hearty breakfast, brunch with friends, or a laid-back coffee break, the café provided a memorable dining experience. A highly recommended spot for anyone looking for good food and a comfortable setting in Koramangala.

It's a beautiful cafe, felt literally like a quirky art museum. Reminds me of the twilight movie diner vibes for some reason. So to enter they have an online queue system and an option to order as we wait as well. A okish size 2 wheeler underground free Parking as well. For us after registering in the online queue the Waiting time wasn't much so we didn't get the time to order on queue, but still after being sitted the service and delivery was pretty fast only. A very student pocket friendly price range and wide range of options with possible customisation options as well. Became instantly one of our favourite places in the area. Must try are there burgers. The waffle though wasn't upto my taste. Overall a must try and highly recommended place. Do try avoiding weekends as there maybe a considerable waiting time depending on your party size.

Hole in the Wall is the breakfast spot for a lot of people in Koramangala, and that’s exactly why you’ll almost always find a queue outside. It’s become a post-workout ritual for so many locals, especially on weekends, so the place gets packed pretty quickly.

The food itself is good, but it’s not anything extraordinary. It’s simple, comforting breakfast food that’s done well. I ordered the English Breakfast, and it was decent—nothing mind-blowing, but definitely satisfying.

If you’re planning to visit, I’d recommend booking a table in advance if possible or getting there early to avoid the wait. And if the queue is too long, don’t stress—there are plenty of other nice cafés nearby that make for a good backup plan.

name: Little Italy Indiranagar
review_texts: The service is ridiculous. It took nearly half an hour to just get a pizza, that tasted awful. The Napoli pizza has no taste. It felt like I was eating pizza base. Its absurd to charge more than 800 for something like that. The Waiting time makes it even more disappointing. 10 mins to get water to table, 10 mins to get sauce, 10 mins to get the final bill. Would not recommend this restaurant even to my enemy. Ruined my night and whole weekend.

Really great sauces. The Pasta del Barone tasted amazing even without veggies. The Barbesca is like your usual pasta but with a more intense, richer flavour — really good.
Skip the mushroom starter though (don’t remember the name) — it’s basically a cutlet, just worse.
I’ve been here twice already and definitely planning to come again with new friends. The pasta’s just that good.

Little Italy never disappoints! I tried Cheesy garlic bread, Fried Ravioli and lip smacking Lasagne and everything was really tasty!
The only okayish one was the overly sweetened Peru delight mocktail!
Great hospitality, they also gave us a complimentary chocolate mousse which was equally delicious! Loved the experience!!

Little Italy has downsized and shifted to a new location that’s somewhat tucked away and easy to miss from the roadside, so you’ll need to look closely to find it.

The main menu remains the same, featuring the classic Italian dishes. They’ve also introduced a new limited-time menu with a few experimental options, but I found these to be just average compared to their staple offerings.

If you’ve been a fan of their classics, this new location still has something to offer, though it might not quite match the charm of the previous setup.

Washrooms are not well maintained.

Nothing can be better than this place for vegetarians who want to enjoy authentic Western food! Little Italy in Indiranagar never disappoints – the flavors, the variety, and the quality are simply outstanding. A special mention to our waiter, Hadibandhu, who was extremely polite, attentive, and made our experience even more delightful. Highly recommended for anyone who loves great vegetarian food with a Western twist!

name: Neon Market
review_texts:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a great experience at Neon Market! The food was delicious, the ambiance was lovely, and the service was excellent. A special thanks to Nita for being so sweet, attentive, and welcoming. She made our visit even more enjoyable with her warm hospitality. Her food suggestion was very helpful. Highly recommend!

Monica … amazing hospitality and warmth and comes across with valuable suggests … if it’s your first time to the place you know whom to call. Food is amazing no matter what you try. Ramen is just perfect. Cheese cake is very inviting. Definitely worth a next time drop in.

I've had ramen outside India, but the one from Neon Market was seriously the best I've ever had! The Fried Chicken Thigh Ramen was incredible. The chicken was so flavorful and juicy. Everything in it was super tasty and felt really authentic.

We also tried a couple of desserts. The Mochi was good, but the Mango Sticky Rice dessert was just okay.

The service was amazing and the whole vibe there is just really cool, unlike anything else I've seen in Bangalore. They even have a separate section upstairs with clothes and snacks inspired by South Asian, Japanese, and Korean pop culture.

It's definitely a must-visit, even though it's pricey.

Loved the food and the warmth of the Chef and the staff. All the dishes ordered were amazing. On the 1st floor, there is a shopping space for Japanese merchandise, jewellery, chocolates and some beauty products.
A special shout-out to the waiting staff- Ms.Nancy. Her service was good.

We managed to get a private table since we had our dog with us. The staff was very polite and checked in on us multiple times. The food was delicious and they even managed to make something for our dog which he thoroughly enjoyed. We ordered some starters and ramen. The ramen was a more than generous quantity and was very good. Both the veg and non veg. Will definitely be coming back :)

P.S - thanks to Nancy for being such a ray of sunshine and helping us out with menu options etc.

name: Starbucks
review_texts: The lemon zest cold brew was perfect with tangy flavour. And loved the chocohip cookie and chocolate croissant, the texture was perfect with mildly heated and delicious. The summer drink was also very refreshing. It was a bit crowded but good atmosphere to work or chat.

Starbucks Indiranagar is a nice place to relax and enjoy a good cup of coffee. The ambience is calm and comfortable, and the staff are friendly. It’s a good spot to sit, chat, or work for some time. Overall, a pleasant experience.
The staff are very friendly and polite. A good option to have a coffee and work for a while.

The coffee was good here, but not the sandwiches, it always disappoint me here, got a good and spacious place for sitting both indoor and outdoor. Good ambience. The only problem it has only one washrooms for both men and women, and mostly waiting most of the time. You can find most people are working from cafe. Crowded if you like that way. This is a good place to work or for a coffee date.

After visiting more than 10 times. Finally decide to review😁

I recently visited Starbucks - Indranagar branch, and it was a really pleasant experience. The ambience was warm, cozy, and perfect for relaxing or getting some work done.
A special mention to Dhanalakshmi for the excellent service—she was friendly, attentive, and made the visit even more enjoyable.
Overall, great coffee, great vibe, and outstanding customer service. I’ll definitely be visiting again! ☕

name: Maison du Brownie & Cheese Cake Pvt Ltd
review_texts:
The place is a hidden spot, located few lanes behind the other crowd favourites!
The cafe offers a small seating with a very limited but tasty menu!
We went for the crowd favourites that were the Cheese cakes and the brownies with ice cream.
The brownies were one of the best brownies I have tasted in my life! Soft and moist, which you generally don’t get anywhere. We loved it!
The cheesecake was equally good!
The best thing about the restaurant was the way they were preparing everything in batches. Every batch served warm and fresh!
However the place gets cramped up and since they are narrow and long, people were busy finding space.
The other problem was there were a lot of insects crawling around that leave a nasty sting!
They should work on it!
Rest the food was splendid!

Small, quaint spot tucked away in the lanes of Indiranagar, but the cheesecakes here are anything but subtle. The Basque cheesecake is absolutely next-level—rich, creamy, beautifully caramelized, and dangerously addictive. The Tiramisu Basque cheesecake was equally good, with bold coffee notes and that signature melt-in-your-mouth texture.

I’ve seen this place go viral on Instagram for its cheesecake for quite some time, and I finally had a chance to try it. The shop is very small, with only about 6-7 tables. It feels quite stuffy, with poor air circulation.
There are several types of cheesecake to choose from, so I ordered the burnt cheesecake to try. The taste was extremely ordinary and not outstanding at all. Personally, I really like burnt cheesecake, and there are places in Bangalore that do it much better.
The drink options are quite limited. for the plus is that the prices are not expensive.

It is a quaint cafe in uncrowded street, with probably seating capacity for 20 people. Ideal for some lazy afternoon drinks and snacks.

We just dropped in for desserts and try the cheese cakes. The basque cheesecake was very good, while the tiramisu styled cheesecake was more of a coffee flavoured mousse. Couldn’t like it.

Accessibility is bit of an issue, while it’s at ground floor, there are still 1-2 steps to get through. Toilet is at first floor with very narrow iron stairs which is quite intimidating for anyone who are having physical constraints or aged.

When we visited l, options were very limited and seating can have max of 4 folks seating together. More designed for couples due to space crunch.
The cheesecakes here are absolutely amazing! I highly recommend trying the Basque cheesecake, it's flawless. If you're a chocolate lover, the Black Forest cheesecake is a absolute must-try.

name: Starbucks
review_texts:
warm and welcoming ambience, making it a great place to relax, catch up with friends, or even get some work done. The seating is comfortable, the lighting is pleasant, and the overall vibe feels calm and cozy.
The service given by HARSHITHA was generally efficient and friendly.  Even polite, helpful, and quick to take orders, even during busy hours. Overall
The food and beverages are consistently good in quality. The coffee is rich and well-prepared, with a wide variety of options to suit different tastes. The snacks and bakery items are fresh and pair well with the drinks, though the prices are on the higher side.

Coffee and atmosphere great as always.
Good staff behaviour.
No dedicated parking.

I have been coming here in the mornings. The coffee and the food is great to start my day with. The staff here, Harshitha and Naman have especially added to the experience with their unwavering hospitality.

Went to the CMH outlet last week. Have been going to Starbucks for over a decade, but was surprised at my recent  experience.

Bought a couple of coffee beans packets and one brewed coffee for having in store.  Person on the counter was extremely unfriendly.  Was trying to use a gift card and she frowned on their use.  No one was waiting behind, yet you could see the frustration.

Secondly, Store has accessibility issue.  During rains steps leading up to the store are slippery, and do not have a support railing.

Terrible Service – Unprofessional Staff.
I had a highly disappointing experience at this location due to the staff's attitude. The receptionist/cashier was incredibly rude & lacked basic communication skills. When I asked to change my order from a large to a Venti cup during selection (before billing only)—a minor adjustments—she became visibly angry. She openly glared at us with a judgmental look, making us feel unwelcome as if she were looking down on us for being there. A simple size change should not trigger hostility from a customer service representative. Starbucks standard is usually much higher than this. I will not be returning to this branch.

name: Maverick & Farmer Coffee
review_texts:
It's one of those places that will be on my top spots for good coffee & food in Bangalore. Tried their espresso Citroen, the best I ever had. Also their chicken steak is delicious & healthy.

On desserts had maverick mazargan & cheesecake. Everything is just top notch. Staff is really warm & polite

The environment & atmosphere is superb! Overlooking football turf gives this spot a really must visit vibe.  Highly recommend this place 😄

I have to start by saying this cafe is highly recommended. If you are a coffee lover, this is a must-visit spot in Bangalore.

Location & Vibe:
The cafe is situated right next to a sports club and football turf, which gives it a really unique and pleasant charm. It’s a great place to relax and watch some action while you enjoy your brew.

The Drinks:
• Espresso: I loved my coffee; it had those perfect fruity notes I was looking for.
• Hot Chocolate: This was impressive—very dense, thick, and rich.

The Food:
We ordered a pastrami sandwich and onion rings. Both were delicious and prepared well, making for a very satisfying meal alongside the drinks.

The Verdict:
I enjoyed the coffee so much that I even bought a bag of their coffee grounds to brew at home. Whether you're a serious coffee geek or just looking for a cool spot with a great vibe, Maverick & Farmer is excellent.
The Mac N cheese wasnt upto the mark while the garlic toastee was delicious.  The apple pie with icecream was also delicious.  The coffee we ordered was just perfect 👌

Maverick & Farmer Coffee – Bengaluru ☕✨
⭐ Rating: 9.5/10

An excellent spot for serious coffee lovers. Maverick & Farmer delivers top-quality coffee, expertly brewed with rich, well-balanced flavors. You can really taste the care and craftsmanship in every cup.

The atmosphere is stylish and relaxed, perfect for slowing down and actually enjoying your coffee. The staff are knowledgeable and friendly, always happy to recommend something new.

The only small downside is that Wi-Fi is not available, so it’s not ideal if you’re planning to work from your laptop.

☕ Verdict: Amazing coffee and great vibe — just come to enjoy the cup, not to work. 9.5/10.

I always have a very good experience at M&F for brunch or just a drink to cool down after my spin class.
Ms.Senti who served us multiple times is very kind and sweet.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters | Jayanagar
review_texts: The place has a calm,quiet vibe and is quite work-friendly, making it easy to sit and focus. The iced Vietnamese coffee was excellent and definitely the highlight,and the pasta was good and well prepared.It is a bit on the pricier side, but the peaceful ambience and overall experience make it worth it.

I recently discovered this outlet and loving it. Spacious, great ambience and location. Been a long time fan of Blue Tokai selection of coffees for my home and now I am also enjoying the cafe experience. Loved the new specials, coconut jaggery latte and flatbreads. Staff is very courteous and friendly too. Perfect place for a weekend morning or weekday night visit.
Nice cafe to catch up and have some good coffee. They close at 11 pm but they have good seating arrangements.

Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters is a wonderful place to work all day. The staff is friendly, and there are enough plug points for charging laptops too. The cold coffee milkshake was awesome! We did find a stone in the Millet Tabouleh, but the team immediately replaced it with another dish of our choice, which was appreciated. The vanilla coffee felt a little bitter initially, but they gladly modified it on request.

The real star of the show was the Four Pepper and Bechamel Ragi Flatbread — absolutely yummy and a must-try!
Cold coffee and butter crossaint was very good.. decent ambience

name: Beanlore - HSR Layout
review_texts:
Beanlore Coffee Roasters – A Perfect Little Date Night Spot

Visited Beanlore Coffee Roasters with my wife for a cozy date night, and it turned out to be a really lovely experience. The place has a calm and relaxing vibe, making it perfect for spending quality time over good food and coffee.

What We Tried:
* Fried Rice with Chicken Stir Fry Bowl
Flavorful, satisfying, and well-balanced. The chicken was nicely cooked and paired really well with the rice.
* Korean Bun
Soft, delicious, and packed with flavor. A unique item that was worth trying.
* Strawberry Mascarpone Croissant
Light, buttery, and beautifully balanced with the sweetness of strawberry and creamy mascarpone. Easily one of the highlights.
* Jade Cream
Refreshing and smooth with a unique flavor profile.
* Hot Chocolate
Rich, comforting, and perfect for the cozy café atmosphere.

Overall Experience:
- Cozy and relaxing ambiance for couples
- Tasty food and well-made beverages
- Great café vibe for conversations and date nights
- Desserts and drinks were especially enjoyable

Rating: 4.5/5

Overall, it was a really good date night with tasty food, comforting drinks, and a pleasant atmosphere. A lovely place to unwind and spend quality time with someone special.

I enjoyed a wonderful dinner date with my wife here! The tea was truly exceptiona along with the banana bread, and the food selection, though minimal, was perfect. ☕ The ambiance is incredibly pleasant, and I especially loved the unique work pods. A rare find in cafes! ✨ I highly recommend this spot. 💖

If you are looking for work from cafe, literally the best place.
You get access to free wifi and charging ports. I recommed you to order thier frappe’s are just too good!
Its very safe place for working women and i would suggest you to go for it!
You can avail a paid space in private pod’s or conf room.
Great place to hangout n chill too!

Beanlore serves some of the best coffee I’ve had in Bangalore. I’ve tried multiple specialty cafes, but the richness and depth of flavor here truly stand out. Their coffee is strong, authentic and I was also impressed with their packaging.

I once ordered a cold coffee, and the quality of the container was exceptional. Unlike other well-known cafes where the cup often becomes damp  due to the ice, Beanlore's packaging held up beautifully. Even after about 30 minutes, there was barely any moisture on the outside.

It genuinely feels like your money is well spent, making it a place I would highly recommend.

Gem!
The ambience is cozy and modern, with warm interiors that make it perfect for both casual hangouts and quiet work sessions. The mocha is consistently excellent—smooth❤️
Food options like pastries and savory bites complement the drinks well.
Comfortable seating, and some small meeting rooms, making this outlet a must to go in the HSR layout✌🏻

✅ Overall: Great coffee, nice ambience, and a welcoming vibe. A must-visit spot in HSR!

name: Magnolia Bakery
review_texts:
Magnolia Bakery

One of the most popular dessert spots in Bangalore, Magnolia Bakery is definitely worth visiting if you enjoy desserts. The bakery has a beautiful white, minimal, Victorian-inspired aesthetic that gives it a classic New York bakery feel.

Must-tries:
• Vanilla Tres Leches – Easily my favourite. Light, moist and perfectly balanced without being overly sweet.
• Hummingbird Cupcake – I’m usually not a cupcake person, but this one genuinely surprised me. Definitely one of the best things on the menu.
• Red Velvet Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting – The cream cheese frosting is what makes this dessert. It complements the cake really well and makes it worth ordering.
• Hot Chocolate – Rich, comforting and a great choice if you’re visiting during the evenings worth the price.

Good, but not perfect:
• Classic Banana Pudding – One of their signature desserts and definitely worth trying, but it can feel slightly too sweet for many people.
• Pecan Cheesecake – Decent, but it didn’t particularly stand out to me compared to the other desserts.
• Coffee – Good enough to pair with dessert, but I wouldn’t visit just for the coffee.

Could be better:
• Chocolate Cake with Vanilla Buttercream – It honestly reminded me of a good Iyengar Bakery chocolate cake. It wasn’t bad, but for almost ₹500 a slice, I expected a more memorable experience.

Overall, Magnolia Bakery shines with its signature desserts rather than every item on the menu. If you’re visiting for the first time, I’d recommend sticking to the Vanilla Tres Leches, Hummingbird Cupcake and the Red Velvet Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting. Those alone make the visit worthwhile.

Had heard a lot about their cheesecakes and so was waiting to try. Got a chance last weekend and omg, it's worth all the hype! There was a short queue but it clears fast.
There's limited seating, 3 tables and 2 counters to the wall. That's the only negative, however the food 🤌🏻🤌🏻🤌🏻
We tried the chocolate cheesecake and chocolate chunk cookies. Both were excellent and melt in the mouth. The vanilla cheesecake is mild in taste and the best was their seasalt caramel chocolate cookie.  Their prices are higher than other such bakeries but the treats are excellent.

Indiranagar has many great spots, but this one stands out as a favorite. During Christmas, the store glows with festive charm, adding to its inviting atmosphere. A true haven for dessert lovers, everything on display looks fresh, immaculate, and thoughtfully presented. It’s the perfect place to unwind and indulge.
We’ve tried the tres leches, yogurt orange bundt, and their coffee on several occasions — and they never disappoint. It’s always a pleasure coming back.

Visited Magnolia Bakery recently, and it was one of my target spots for a long time.

I went there mainly to try their Tres Leches, especially the Lotus Tres Leches and it did not disappoint at all. It was sooo yummy, rich, soft, not too sweet and perfectly balanced. Honestly, I went just for this dessert, and it was totally worth it.
The place offers a great variety of desserts and cupcakes, making it a paradise for anyone with a sweet tooth. Yes, it’s a bit on the expensive side, but I’d say it’s worth trying at least once.

There was a queue, but the service was really good and well managed, which made the wait feel okay.

Overall, a must try spot, especially if you love desserts. Definitely going back to try more next time.

Visited Magnolia Bakery, Bangalore to try their famous Tres Leches dessert. The taste was good, but unfortunately we found a small hair in it, which was really disappointing. If you zoom into the cake picture, the hair is clearly visible. Hoping they improve their quality and hygiene standards.

name: Labonel Fine Baking - Indiranagar
review_texts:
A Truly Delightful Experience at Labonel Fine Baking
Had an exceptional visit to Labonel Fine Baking. The atmosphere is elegant, relaxing, and beautifully maintained, making it the perfect place to enjoy desserts and coffee.
The desserts were outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and presented with great attention to detail. Every bite reflected the quality and craftsmanship that Labonel is known for.
A special thanks to Mr. Renit Joseph, the Manager, for his warm hospitality and professionalism. He ensured that every guest felt welcomed and comfortable, and his attention to customer experience truly stood out.
The serving staff were equally impressive—courteous, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile. Their prompt service and genuine friendliness made the experience even more enjoyable.
Labonel Fine Baking offers the perfect combination of exceptional desserts, a sophisticated ambiance, and outstanding customer service. Highly recommended, and I look forward to visiting again soon.
5/5 – An experience worth returning for! 🍰☕✨

Labonel Fine Baking has a really aesthetic interior and a pleasant overall vibe. They offer a good variety of desserts to choose from, making it a great spot for dessert lovers.

The food was really delicious and the overall experience was nice. A good place to visit if you’re looking for quality desserts in a cozy setting.

Amazing and premium dessert place for people with a sweet tooth.

The ambience is pleasant and rich, with original marble tables and comfortable chairs.

They have all their desserts on display (which are for display only and are not served). They orepare fresh desserts depending on your order.

We ordered the tiramisu, which was without alcohol, and tasted delicious.

I don't think they have valet service, so parkong might be an issue. There is enough seating for around 25 people.

Amazing Desserts! The Cookies and Brownies are just amazing and so fresh and satisfying. To top it all of the Coffee is just amazing from the Tap with one click is so good. The Coffee lemonade and Affagato Mouse is a must try.

A quiet and best place to have good dessert. The ambience is really good. The dessert was really tasty and light. Each desserts costs around 350+. Want to try an off beat place for dessert then go for it. The presentation of the desserts were unique and taste was on point.

name: Theobroma Bakery and Cake Shop - Indira Nagar, Bengaluru
review_texts: Tried their coffee and brownies, and both were quite good and reasonably priced. We had the Overload Brownie, Outrageous Chocolate Brownie, and Eggless Cookie Brownie, and all of them were fresh and delicious. The café has a cozy and inviting atmosphere, and the service was quick and friendly. The packaging was beautiful and neat. It’s located on 12th Main, Indiranagar, making it a great spot to stop by for a quick coffee and dessert.

Visited Theobroma recently and had a good experience overall. The ambience is pleasant and perfect for a quick dessert break😋

We tried the Spicy Paneer Roll, which was excellent and full of flavor❤️The Fresh Cream Pineapple Pastry was smooth and delicious. However, the Dutch Truffle Cake was just average and didn’t stand out much.

They also have a dedicated cookies section with a wide variety to choose from, which is definitely worth checking out.

Overall, a nice place to visit—I’d love to come back and try more items next time!🤩

The place has honestly lost its charm. I've been going to Theos since it's bombay days and this present form now is so depressing. Stale hard brownies, overloaded with sugar but no richness of chocolate ..and tiny portions. We ordered two brownies. One was clearly smaller in size and stale and hard, looked like leftovers from a previous batch... but we were still served that. The decadence and joy of desserts is lost to the brand now clearly. It's simply a profit calculation. There are much better brands making honest and fresh food ... I won't be returning here.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Birthday Cake & Brownies at Theobroma!

We ordered a birthday cake from Theobroma for our celebration, and it was absolutely perfect! The cake was fresh, soft, and moist with a brilliant taste — not too sweet, just right.
The brownies are a must-try! I've tried several varieties, and they're all heavenly — soft and moist inside with a crisp crust.
🫰💝

Nice ambience and satisfactory service with a spacious interior. One of the best brownies I’ve had — rich, perfectly balanced, and reasonably priced by city standards. Parking can be managed on the side lanes nearby since the shop itself has limited space.

name: The Brownie Circles | Home for the best fudge brownies and dessert (Take away Only)
review_texts: Brownie Circle in Indiranagar is a great place for dessert lovers. The brownies are rich, soft, and full of chocolatey flavor. The place has a cozy vibe, perfect for a quick treat or takeaway. Quality and taste are consistent, making it a reliable spot to satisfy sweet cravings. Definitely worth a visit if you love brownies.
