It is a cute little dessert place. The ambiance of this place is quite aesthetic. Although the space is small, it has a great impact. We had here overload chocolate brownie and almond chocolate fudge.
Both were great to taste.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ Decent Brownies, Room for Improvement

I recently tried here and found the brownies to be pretty good, but not exceptional. Decent variety of flavors, which is great for people who like to mix things up. The salted caramel, for example, was a bit overpowering.

But I found some of the items unavailable which was very irritating. Overall, service and ambience was great.

Are u craving for brownies? - this place is highly recommended.

They have varieties with exceptional flavours.

The Ambience is very classy and cozy.

The staff is very warm and helpful and they are open to feed back.

I had great time visiting this place.

I highly recommend their Tiramisu tub and Tres Leches—both are absolutely delightful! The prices are reasonable compared to other places, making it even better. The ambiance is inviting, with plenty of picturesque spots for memorable photos. A perfect place for dessert lovers!

name: K A W A I I
review_texts: Kawaii Japanese mochi ice cream is available only for takeaway and online orders. The taste is quite normal and not as special as expected. Portions feel a bit pricey for what you get. Overall, an average experience and not fully worth the money.

Please try it at your own risk. Its pathetic, taste is very bad, it is overpriced,
rather make it at home with real mango or strawberries, the guy at the counter stated that it has real fruits inside whereas it is just a flavour.
Bad taste,
Overprice,(150 for  a mochi for the size they are sellimg is funny)
Mochi heaven! The Black Sesame and Mango are absolute must-tries. Perfectly soft, chilled to perfection, and bursting with flavor. If you haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out.🫶🏻🫶🏻🍡🍡🍡

If you come here, you have to try the coconut and sesame mochi icecream. It’s rare to find sesame that tastes this authentic and nutty. It’s the perfect little bite of happiness. Five stars for the flavors and the quality.

This is a small store that sells mochi ice creams imported from Thailand - the ice creams are not made at the store. The choices are, therefore, limited. They're expensive but a unique experience to try.

The vibe of the place is so spa-like that it's easy to feel like you entered the wrong store!

name: Corner House
review_texts:
The Corner House, locals flock to this iconic dessert joint all year round.
Their Death By Chocolate is one of the best desserts I had, it’s a generous serving of chocolate/vanilla ice cream with berries/nuts & hot chocolate fudge.
Cafe Caramel was a let down to be honest,
Wildberry Swirl was the newest flavor on the menu, it was mind blowing, mango was also nice.
There are always long queues, chaotic to collect your order too.
Parking can be an issue at peak hours.

Icecream scoops were all good but never to miss out on the sundaes here.

Fruit jackpot: such a bomb sundae really loved it
Lychee with icecream: looks like tender chicken and yoghurt but tasted really good
Choc-a-mocha: was avg
DBC(Death by chocolate) : best sundae ever had they use there house special chocolate sauce which is so good.

Not a sweet tooth person but loved the desserts and sundaes here

Visited Corner House, Indiranagar and had their signature Cake Fudge along with the iconic Death by Chocolate — both were absolutely worth it! The desserts were rich, indulgent, and lived up to the hype. The atmosphere was beautiful and very inviting that made the visit even more enjoyable. The Indiranagar outlet also stands out compared to other branches — it just feels a bit more special. Overall, a great spot to satisfy dessert cravings!

Corner house is one of the oldest icecream shops in bengaluru

Location📍- indiranagar
Timings - 11am-11.30 pm
Ambience- old cozy vibe

One of the specialities of it being the sundaes which include seasonal fruits.

Strawberry with fresh cream and one scoop of vanilla icecream is available currently.
However the stock gets over soon and also the availability is uncertain in the morning hours as they get their stock from kormangala and it takes time to get to indiranagar.

Fruit jackpot includes various fruits like peach,lychee,orange,pineapple,apple with fresh cream and one scoop of vanilla icecream.

Rich chocolate tarte had really really moist and soft chocolate cake and a side of butterscotch icecream with chocolate sauce as caramel sauce was unavailable at the moment.

They also have milkshakes,fruit sundaes,cake sundaes and icecreams

I visited Corner House this afternoon, and it was quite crowded—for good reason. We ordered their signature dessert, Death By Chocolate, along with a Crème de Caramel, and both were absolutely amazing. The place was clean and hygienic, and it was great to see the staff preparing the desserts fresh right in front of us. There’s also parking available right in front. Overall, a 10/10 experience—I would definitely visit again.

name: Karachi Bakery - Indiranagar bangalore
review_texts:
Visited around 3 PM

The place has a nice and well arranged ambiance. Popular for wide variety if biscuits.

Service was okayish, not great, not terrible.

I purchased their famous biscuits and also tried Bun Maska and Tea. The biscuits were really good, with a wide variety available and excellent quality. I bought Cashew Biscuits, Kaju Pista Biscuits, and Fig Rolls, and all of them tasted great.

However, the Bun Maska and Tea were disappointing. The bun was just okay and not very soft, and the tea was honestly the worst part of the visit.

Price wise, the biscuits are definitely worth it, but the Bun Maska and Tea are not worth the money.

The location is easily accessible. Overall, a great place for biscuits, but I would skip the tea and bun maska next time.

Good bakery with many options of cakes, pastries and cookies.
Ferrero Rocher pastry was average but the caramel brownie tasted really good.
Seating is small, better for quick bites or takeaway.
Nice place to try their famous biscuits!

Terrible service on a Monday when the place has only 2 customers. The north East help at the shop just don't care bout elderly people... Who were trying to order food n was interested only in the young girls who are regulars... By ordering a bun maska n staying the whole day! You guys are located at such a prestigious place & this how u treat people? Why? Truly don't even deserve to be on 100 feet road

I ordered a birthday cake from Karachi Bakery, Indiranagar, and it was a total hit! I went with their bluberry cake, and not only did it look stunning, but the taste was rich, moist, and absolutely delicious.

The staff helped me customize the cake with a sweet birthday message, and they even added some decorative touches. The packaging was neat and professional, and the cake stayed fresh even hours later during the celebration.

They have a wide variety of cakes — from classic flavors to more premium options — and they’re reasonably priced for the quality.

If you’re planning a birthday celebration and want a cake that looks great and tastes even better, this place won’t disappoint!

I recently visited and had a fantastic experience! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a perfect place to enjoy some delicious treats. They offer a wide variety of cakes and cookies, and everything I tried was incredibly tasty. The quality and freshness of the baked goods were impressive!

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great flavors and a cozy ambiance. Can't wait to go back and try more of their delicious offerings!

name: LICK | Lavonne Ice Cream Kitchen
review_texts:
Visited here recently and had a great experience. The ice cream quality is excellent, with rich flavors and a smooth, creamy texture that feels premium in every bite. There are plenty of unique flavor options to choose from, making it difficult to pick just one.
Sugarfree options are also available.

The store has a clean and pleasant ambiance, perfect for a quick dessert stop while exploring Indiranagar. The staff were friendly and helped with tasting and recommendations.

If you're an ice cream lover looking for something beyond the usual brands, LICK is definitely worth a visit. The fruit-based flavors are a must-try.

Lick – Lavonne Ice Cream Kitchen is a must-visit if you love premium, creative ice creams. The place is quite large and often crowded, which says a lot about how popular it is.

We tried a wide range of items including the Mango Tres Leches sundae, Smoked Dark Chocolate, Cookies n Cream, The Ultimate Pistachio, roasted almond brownie, and the Squats and Scoops sundae. Everything was top-notch, rich, creamy, and full of flavour. The Smoked Dark Chocolate and Ultimate Pistachio (very rich, you might not be able to finish it) really stood out, and the sundaes were indulgent and well put together.

One of the best parts was being able to taste almost all the flavours before deciding. The staff were very informative and patient, explaining the different options and helping us choose what suited our taste.

Their cookies, or “bookies” as they call them, are also exceptional and pair really well with the ice creams. Do try their Hallelujah, lemon raspberry, German Chocolate.

Yes, the pricing is on the higher side, but the quality, creativity, and overall experience make it worth it. Definitely a great spot for dessert lovers in Indiranagar.

If you are looking for high-quality, artisanal ice cream in Indiranagar, this place is serving up some total bangers. The quality of the ingredients is evident in every scoop, and they are doing some really interesting things with their flavor profiles.

**The Standout Scoops**
* **Protein Chocolate:** A huge win. It’s rare to find a high-protein version that actually tastes this good—perfect for a post-workout treat or a slightly healthier indulgence.

* **Ultimate Pistachio:** Rich, nutty, and incredibly authentic.

* **Watermelon Feta:** A refreshing, experimental flavor that works surprisingly well for the summer.

**The Reality Check**

* **The Pricing:** It is slightly on the pricier side considering the serving sizes. While the quality is premium, it feels like a splurge.

* **The Seating:** This is the main drawback. There are only about **4 stools inside with AC**. In the middle of a Bangalore summer, sitting outside in the scorching sun isn't ideal—your ice cream ends up melting faster than you can enjoy it!

* **Availability:** I’m really rooting for them to bring in even more healthy/functional versions of their classics.

**Final Verdict**
The ice cream itself is 9/10. If they can work on the pricing, expand the indoor seating, and lean further into those "healthier" versions, this place would be perfect. Definitely worth a visit for the flavors alone, but maybe aim for a late-evening trip when it's cooler!

Loved loved loved the ice cream here!

The ultimate pistachio is absolutely AMAZING 🤩 and the smoked dark chocolate was my fav too.

The lemon strawberry was so refreshing.

Also tried the Black Forest bar which was yum.

Luckily got a chance to try their cookies which were amazing! Tried the espresso pecan cookie and it was bomb 😍😍

Can’t wait to go back again 🫶🏻🙌🏻

Rich, creamy, and indulgent, these ice creams truly live up to the hype and are on par with Milano Ice Cream.

The only downside is the limited vegetarian selection. Similar to Lavonne Cafe, which offers just a couple of eggless desserts, they have only one vegetarian bookie, which didn’t look worth trying, so I skipped it. Hope they introduce a few more vegetarian options soon.

Worth visiting.
They also let you sample flavors before choosing, which is a nice touch and something Milano doesn’t offer now.

name: Polar Bear Ice Cream Sundaes - Indiranagar
review_texts:
Crowded place always, specially at night. Visited couple of times. Ice creams are good as usual asxper polar bear standard.
Many cases you won't get seasonal specialities like strawberry specials or in mango seasons, mango specials dishes. They always run out of stocks within 9-10 pm. Thats sad, faced multiple times.
Good ice cream. Quality very good. Service is good. Atmosphere is good too.

Indoor sitting, flavoured desserts and sundaes, very reasonable price, this place is peace, clean, neatly maintained, very silence, no crowded, private conversation can b done. Can spend more time with your loved ones..One Death by chocolate (DBC) can fully loaded ur tummy.

Giving less quantity and telling that its standard quantity but in other polar bear near by they give full.staff are not even sure how much quantity should be there as the person I asked told he doesn't know and has to ask his seniors.
Seriously I'm not a fan of this Ice cream. Not a place which serves better quality of ic creams or I found their options are not worthy of the taste and the pricing.

name: Cake Walk ಕೇಕ್ ವಾಕ್
review_texts:
Recently visited Cake Walk Café in Indiranagar, and it was such a delightful experience! The place has a cozy and inviting vibe — perfect for catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time.

The pastries and cakes were absolutely delicious — fresh, not overly sweet, and beautifully presented. I tried their Banana Cake and Strawberry Pie, and it was easily one of the best I’ve had in Bangalore. Their coffee also pairs perfectly with the desserts.

The staff was friendly and courteous, and the service was quick. Definitely a must-visit spot if you’re in Indiranagar and have a sweet tooth!

Cakewalk  is a delightful spot for anyone looking to indulge in tasty treats. They are especially known for their cakes, which are not only visually appealing but also of excellent quality, offering a perfect balance of flavor and texture. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just craving something sweet, their cakes do not disappoint.

In addition to cakes, Cakewalk offers a variety of savory options like chicken and vegetable puffs. The puffs are a popular choice, with a crispy, golden exterior and flavorful fillings that hit the spot whether you prefer a hearty chicken option or a lighter vegetarian one. They also serve freshly made sandwiches, which are both satisfying and well-prepared, making them a great option for a quick meal.

One of the shop's highlights is its ambiance. The sitting area is well-maintained, with cozy seating arrangements that invite you to stay for a while and enjoy your food. Whether you're meeting a friend for a chat or just looking for a quiet place to relax, Cakewalk provides a pleasant environment.

Overall, Cakewalk  combines great quality food with a warm, inviting atmosphere, making it a wonderful place to visit for both sweet and savory delights.
Nice quite place in Indiranagar, they have options of pastries, cakes etc. tried their classic cake and it was delicious

The place is absolutely amazing. It is well built and has a great ambience. The pastries and cakes are so tasty, I enjoyed eating here a lot but I would like to point out that the cost is on the higher side. The staff is polite and friendly too. However there are very few vegetarian options, it mostly consists of non - vegetarian cakes/pastries. Otherwise this place is really good, recommended!

After a long time had been to cakewalk !! My absolute favourite is cakewalk special and brandy bar. And oh boy, it tastes the same.
The store is taken all the precautions of Covid.
I noticed they have reduced the size of the items and probably a bit of price slash. The cakes and pastries are very good. And other gourmet items are good too. Again one of the very few good places in Bangalore for bakery products. A slightly warm Brandy bar is an absolute delight.

name: Milano Ice Cream
review_texts:
One of the best ice cream places around! The quality is truly top-notch, and they offer a great range of innovative and unique flavors that you don’t usually find elsewhere. The popsicles are especially amazing and definitely worth trying.

Their bakery section is equally impressive, with delicious cakes, croissants, and other treats that perfectly complement the ice cream.

It’s almost always crowded, but that just speaks volumes about how good the place is.

Highly recommended for anyone with a sweet tooth!

It has a great ambience and an impressive variety of desserts to choose from. From gelatos and popsicles to cookies and pastries, there’s something for everyone, and everything we tried was delicious. It’s definitely a nice place to satisfy your dessert cravings.

The only downside is that the outlet is quite small, so it gets crowded quickly. We had trouble finding a place to sit after getting our order.

Tried Milano for the first time and honestly loved it. This was also my first time trying gelato and it definitely felt different from regular ice cream. It was much smoother, richer and more natural in taste.
I tried Mango, Wild Berry and Truffle, and all three were really good. The fruit flavours especially tasted very close to the actual fruit instead of being overly artificial or sugary. The texture was soft and melting, which made it even better.

Milano Ice Cream is a great place for ice cream lovers. They offer a wide variety of flavours with great taste and a smooth texture. They have three different cup sizes, and you can choose up to three flavours in one cup. The ambience is nice, and the service is good and well-organized. They also serve ice cream in cones. Apart from ice creams, they have cakes, croissants, and other snacks as well. Overall, it’s a good place to relax and enjoy desserts.

The Ice Cream is really Good here, the texture of the Ice Cream is Super Smooth and the Taste is amazing.

Gelato Ice Cream -
NOTE:
Taste testing is not allowed due to hygeine protocols

1. Strawberry - 2.5/5 (People who like Tangy Flavors will love this, I did not enjoy this personally)
2. French Vanilla - 4.5 ( Super Smooth, very light and mind blowing Taste)
3. Wildberry - 2.5/5 ( Again people who like Tangy Flavors will Enjoy this, did not enjoy this personally)
4. Truffle - 4/5 ( people who like Chocolate should definitely go for this, not too chocolately, not too sweet , just the right taste)
5. Choco Wafer - 4/5 ( The wafers added in this really bring in the taste, absolute bomb)

About the Place -
1. Small and Compact
2. Chill Ambience, good place to come with Friends

Cost -
1.So instead of Charging 60/70/80/90 rs for a Single Flavor, you pay for the Cup Size - Regular(120)/Medium(180)/Large
2. I had 1 Regular and 1 Medium
3. You can add any 2 Flavors in Regular and 3 Flavors in Medium
4. Place was clean Inside and Outside
5. No Handwash, Just tissues
6. Vegetarians who do not eat Egg will not be able to Enjoy their pies, macaroons, different breads,etc
7. Popsicles were also available

name: ulo icecream
review_texts: I had mango sorbet & lemon on top ice creams. The mango sorbet had amazing mango pulp flavour and was really yummy to eat. It was fruity, sweet, cold and really yummy. The lemon on top was sour, sweet and had bit of dough flavour as well. I wasn’t a big fan of it. Despite it being a best seller I didn’t quite like it. The service and ambience were both good. The shop was a little difficult to find via Google maps, so maybe the restaurant could update the location. Overall the mango sorbet is a must try!!!

Honestly everyone talks about the ice cream but THAT FREAKING COOKIE IS WHERE ITS AT!!! Delicious warm chunky cookie with a gooey center and the sea salt on top just brings out the chocolate and brown butter flavors. Absolutely Phenomenal. That being said, the ice creams themselves weren’t as strong in flavor as I would have liked and the portions were pretty tiny.

We didnt expect a lot when we walked in to ulo, as, in recent days I had visited many Dessert parlours and walked out with a 'meh' feeling. But this surely hit different. At ulo, I liked how the flavours popped for each one. Especially the nostalgic "Boost". I loved the 'lemon on top' and 'Murder in the Snow' as well. Service was fast. Cone was crispy.  The bill took me by surprise. Generous 4 scoops costed me only Rs 660. Glad I walked in.

Their flavours are bit different from your standard gelato places and so are the prices.
The attention to quality seems evident, however some flavours need work.
The importance of salt in a dessert is not lost to them, but I'd ask them to tone it down a bit in the cookie.
Ice cream flavors were unique, but to me it tasted just average. Did not find it value for money. Out of the lot, I liked the Pazam berry better. Service was good.

name: Nirula's Indiranagar
review_texts:
Food ordered
Pizza - Roma Margareta
Ice cream DBC
Ratings -
Pizza was okish 2.5/5
Ice cream DBC - 5/5
Service and Atmosphere -
Service was quick and they were very polite
Atmosphere it's so beautiful and nice place to sit and chit chat. Way to silent it's like ur inside Museum
So nice to enjoy a romantic date.

I enjoyed their ice creams as take away and decided to visit the center to try their snacks. Unfortunately, that turned out to be a disappointing experience.

The rolls were below average, and the pizza was easily one of the worst I've had. The menu mentioned a hand-tossed pizza base, but what was served appeared to be a thick, ready-made maida base loaded with cheese and very few toppings (but ironically I had ordered veg supreme expecting more toppings). And the price is also exorbidantly high for their quality.

The ambience also felt quite uninviting and didn't add to the overall experience.

The only positive for me was the ice cream. They have some really good flavors, and I'd recommend it only for takeaway.

Based on my experience with the food and overall dining experience, I wouldn't return for anything other than the ice cream.

Tried ice creams here - unique taste and really delicious!

However, seating was a hassle. It could be a bit smoother as we had to wait a bit for chairs.

Great ice cream, but service needs improvement. Overall a nice experience.

Looking for an less-crowded, air-conditioned, ice cream place on a hot summer afternoon? This is the place to go. They have other options on their menu too but all I had was their ice cream and it was good. The cool, less crowded space was what made me like this place a lot. The staff was also kind.

Indiranagar, Nirula's Restaurant is a hidden gem waiting to be discovered. Despite its unassuming facade, this place offers a delightful dining experience perfect for a quick bite or a leisurely meal.
The ambiance at Nirula's is inviting, with a cozy interior and two balcony seating options, adding a touch of charm to your dining experience. Whether you're catching up with friends or enjoying a solo meal, the ambiance sets the perfect backdrop.
One of the highlights of Nirula's is undoubtedly its diverse menu, offering both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options that are sure to tantalize your taste buds. Having sampled both, I can attest to the deliciousness of their offerings. The pizza and burgers are standout items, bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. The paneer dim sum is a must-try, showcasing the restaurant's culinary expertise.
The pizzas at Nirula's are a true delight, with options for both thin crust and regular crust lovers. Whether you prefer a lighter bite or a more indulgent experience, both varieties deliver on taste and quality. Even the regular crust pizza maintains a perfect balance, with a not-too-thick crust that enhances the overall enjoyment of the dish.
From the inviting ambiance to the delectable food and wallet-friendly prices, Nirula's Restaurant exudes a vibe that keeps diners coming back for more. Whether you're a local resident or just passing through, this underrated gem is worth a visit.
In conclusion, Nirula's Restaurant in Indiranagar is a culinary haven that deserves more recognition. With its charming ambiance, mouthwatering menu offerings, and affordable prices, it's a dining destination that won't disappoint.

name: Lavonne Café
review_texts:
Got to know about this cafe from a friend,  and went to check it out. First of all amazing place to sit and chill. Very cozy and peaceful place. Probably will have to wait for a healthy 15 to 20 min but not much. They have amazing food I heard but we went for snacks and coffee.
We had Flat white coffee and Pumpkin spice hot chocolate and both were good.
But their Croissants are extremely delicious, it's a much have. And they also have very nice breakfast options, I would definitely try them next and I strongly recommend the place to everyone.

One of the best cafe in Bangalore. Their sandwich is what always brings me back here.. had a hearty breakfast with family. The staffs are great at suggesting what we should try and we love everything they served! Great work Anam and team ❤️
P.S try the croissant sandwich if you’re here for breakfast and if post 12 pm, ask for their chicken sandwich..

Had the croissant and cappuccino, and both were absolutely excellent. The croissant was perfectly flaky and buttery, while the cappuccino was rich and beautifully brewed. Great food, warm ambience, and attentive service made the experience even better. Easily one of the best cafes in town. Highly recommended!

I’ve had this cafe on my bucket list for ages, and after finally visiting this weekend, I can confirm: it’s worth every bit of the hype.
The food experience was standout.
The Turkish Omelette was the undisputed star of the show—easily my absolute favorite—though the Lavonne Breakfast Platter was a very solid contender.
As a recent matcha convert, their Vanilla Matcha hit all the right notes, and the staff-recommended Blueberry Smoothie was genuinely top-notch.

I even grabbed a loaf of their Sourdough to go, and it’s just as high-quality as the dine-in menu.
A few things to note:
• The Wait: Getting a reservation is a mission, so plan well in advance.
• The Price: It’s definitely on the pricier side, so keep that in mind for your budget.
Overall, it’s a must-visit for any foodie!

This cafe was on my bucket list for a long time and finally decided to hit the place. Tastefully done interiors which resonates with the Christmas Season. The bakery products are displayed beautifully and would love to taste them all.

Tried the Matcha specials - Spiced white chocolate matcha which was matchasmic and super good. Also tried the orange matcha latte that was below expectations taste wise and it was not so hot either(small things but need to be taken care for the price charged)

Tried the savory Barbecue feta Danish. It was excellent. Also took a takeaway item - Pain au Chocolat which was excellent.

Cafe gives an old school bangalore vibe. I remembered the cafes like cassapiccola and sweet chariot.

Though the place is Indira Nagar i would say the place is pricey and a bit expensive.

name: ibaco - Indira Nagar, Bengaluru
review_texts:
I Regularly visit Ibaco, and it’s honestly my favourite place to just sit, relax, and enjoy some amazing ice cream. 🤍
What I love most is the concept — choosing your flavours and toppings exactly the way you like it. The ice creams are super creamy, rich, and indulgent. Every visit feels like a little treat-yourself moment! 🍫🍓
The ambience is comfortable and perfect for spending quality time, whether alone or with friends. It’s my go-to spot whenever I’m craving something sweet or just want a peaceful place to unwind.

Visited Ibaco recently and absolutely loved the experience! The variety of flavours is impressive, and each one tastes rich and fresh. The toppings are generous, and the ability to customise your scoop makes it even better. The ambience is clean and welcoming, and the service is quick. A perfect spot to satisfy your ice-cream cravings!
Has a good park nearby and easy to find parking. As always excellent ice cream and friendly staff..

Harison is one of the best staff I’ve met in India …. He went way above and beyond . I tried many flavours and the. Mediate of him I ended up buying 3 scooops and taking time to leave this review as I really appreciated his efforts to make me feel comfortable. .

The 2rd ibaco i came to today just for their icecream shake. Out of stock (what they mean is there is no milk)

Can you believe it. Not one, not two, three outlets i tried and none of them have it.....IF YOU DON'T HAVE STOCK - SHUT YOUR STORE. Atleast that way customer who is trying online will understand not to bother rather than taking the trouble of going to 3 outlets in Bangalore Traffic

name: The Pizza Bakery - Indiranagar
review_texts:
Pizza hunt led me to The Pizza Bakery 🍕
Ordered a pizza loaded with sundried tomatoes, feta & olives — and honestly, this one hit the spot! 🔥 The crust, the toppings, the flavour… really good. Definitely the highlight of the visit.
But small disappointment — no Tabasco available 😕 (was expecting that extra kick with the pizza).
Being a big fan of Aglio e Olio, I also tried their Fettuccine Aglio e Olio… and this one didn’t impress. Missing that authentic touch — no parsley, very little parmesan, and garlic chopped too big. The balance just wasn’t right.
Ambience is quite good — nice vibe to chill. ✨
Service needs improvement — staff were not very welcoming or smiling, and better menu knowledge would definitely enhance the experience.
Overall: Go for the pizza 🍕, skip the pasta (at least this one).

Visited for dinner. Ordered their garlic bread with blue cheese which was the highlight. The sourdough pizza was light and decent. Service was efficient. Loved their scan based waiting system. Valet parking team was a blessing on this busy street next to naturals icecream on 12th Main, Indiranagar

Amazing pizza restaurant in Indranagar.  We tried the potato wedges which were delicious, crispy on the outside and comez with a lovely dip.
The pizzas were all sourdough with plenty of flavours and toppings which tasted amazing!
The garlic bread with sundried tomatoes and onions was absolutely fantastic, and definitely a must try.
Small place but a must visit for all those that enjoy pizza.

Ordered the garlic bread with olives and butter garlic prawns for starters. Both were delicious. The Pepperoni Diavola pizza was super spicy but extremely tasty. And the Apple Crumble with cream and icecream was a great way to end the meal!

Great pizza made with fresh sourdough bread, very flavorful and well baked. The garlic bread was also really good.
The only downside is the 10% service charge added by default. Overall, a good place for pizza.

name: Giani Ice Cream
review_texts:
FRAUD RESTAURANT!
I ordered three different flavours scoops from Swiggy.  On the order page scoop sizes were mentioned 100ml, what they sent was just about 40-50grams scoop!
Swiggy could not do anything about it and suggested I share feedback for the restaurant.
Better go to Polar bear or ULO even their ice creams are way better and they don’t cheat in quality!

​This is my absolute go-to ice cream parlor! Since it's right near my place, I visit all the time. They offer a massive variety of flavors that are incredibly budget-friendly. But the absolute best part? They have a swing! It’s the perfect spot to sit quietly, relax for an hour, and just enjoy your dessert. Whether you're looking for a peaceful escape or a fun hangout spot with friends, this place is a must-visit.

This is the mango kulfi , your competitors across the street Polar Bear is offering while you are empty on mango kulfi, all faludas during summer season. We would have been okay with your being out of stock but the only thing colder than your  ice cream was your approach to your customers. Giani was never that bitter.

Stay away from this shop. Zero transparency. The employees have no idea what they are selling. Menu had brownie sundae mini. The guy says has it. After eating, during payment, they say there is no mini and charge you 300rs. Avoid this place. The employees are clueless about everything.

The ice cream flavours are good. We tried their chocolate whisky, pista and chocolate hazelnut ice creams. Many of the flavours we asked were not available but the staff suggested these flavours to us. The staff is very friendly and they would recommend some of the best ice creams to try.

name: ASHA SWEET CENTER
review_texts:
GENUINELY IMPRESSED .
The standout item was the Litchi Rabdi, easily a must-try. It was unique, refreshing, and one somehow the fruit and malai worked somehow.

The Badam Milk was served ice cold and was probably the best badam milk I’ve ever had. Absolutely delicious.

I also tried a nut baklava, which was good, but honestly got overshadowed by how amazing the other two items were.

The store has a huge variety of sweets and desserts on display, and if these three items are anything to go by, I doubt you can go very wrong with whatever you pick. Definitely worth a visit if you have a sweet tooth. Now off to Anand Sweets to see which side of the Bengaluru debate I end up on! 😄

Visited Asha Sweet Center recently and tried their Bhel Puri. The bhel puri was fresh, crunchy, and nicely balanced with the perfect mix of tangy and spicy flavours — a perfect quick snack!
I finished it with their famous Dharwad Peda, which was rich, soft, and absolutely delicious. Both items were really good and satisfying.
The only downside is that there is no seating available, so it’s more of a quick grab-and-go spot. Parking is also not available nearby, which can make the visit a little inconvenient.

The sweets are delicious, with a lot of varieties. As it was April, they had an interesting Mango festival going at their store with Mango sweets, mango milkshake, mango shrikhand and more.

Food is served on the first floor. It is slightly on the expensive side. I ordered the cheese pav bhaji with fries. Their fusion menu is quite impressive!
This place offers a huge selection of sweets with great quality. The sales staff provide excellent service and guidance. Everything tasted fresh and delicious truly a satisfying experience.

Asha Sweet Center is truly a gem! 💎 Their sweets are absolutely divine, consistently fresh, and bursting with authentic flavors. The staff provides exceptional service, always welcoming and helpful. I always leave with a smile! 😊 Highly recommend a visit for a delightful treat! 💖

name: Naturals Ice Cream
review_texts: After a hearty lunch at the Indiranagar, Bengaluru outlet of ‘Burma Burma Restaurant & Tea Room,’ we wanted to have ice cream as dessert. Therefore, we decided to hit the ‘Naturals Ice Cream’ outlet right opposite the eatery. We thought of trying two different varieties. While my partner went for Anjeer and Raspberry, I chose Black Current and Raspberry. I am sorry but both the varieties were the worst that I have ever had. Extremely sweet almost to the point of being bitter, no apparent flavour, and a peculiar stench - I had to throw my cup to the bin. My partner liked the Anjeer one but hated the Raspberry. After this experience, I do not think we would every go to a Naturals ever again!

I have visited Naturals Ice Cream on two different occasions, both during weekends, and overall it has been a good experience.

Location:
The outlet is located in one of the busiest streets of Indiranagar, making it very easy to find.

Space & Crowd:
The shop is quite compact, with limited indoor seating (around 10–15 people max). On weekends, it gets crowded, and both times we visited, there was a queue of about 5 minutes. Seating is limited, so most people end up standing outside and enjoying their ice cream.

Menu Variety:
They offer a wide range of options including classic ice creams, seasonal fruit-based flavours, sorbets, and cone/cup servings. The seasonal fruit flavours are a highlight.

What We Tried & Ratings:

First Visit:
Tender Coconut – 4.5/5: Very refreshing and light, with small coconut bits that add to the texture. Definitely one of the better flavours.

Malai Khurma – 3.5/5: Creamy and decent. It tastes somewhat similar to rasmalai, which may appeal to those who like traditional dessert flavours.

Second Visit:
Mango Ice Cream – 2/5: Slightly disappointing. It felt a bit stale and didn’t have the freshness you’d expect from a fruit-based flavour.

Malai Pista – 4.5/5: Very good. Creamy with a mild nutty flavour—well balanced and enjoyable.

Overall Experience:
The quality of ice cream is generally good, especially for their signature and creamy flavours. However, consistency can vary (as seen with the mango flavour). The crowd and limited seating are the only downsides.

Final Verdict:
A good place to try natural and seasonal ice creams in Indiranagar. Worth a visit, but be prepared for crowds on weekends and choose flavours wisely.
My most favourite ice cream parlour. All the flavours are palatable. Mango malai is now in all fvrts. Space is there for seating inside and outside. Tender coconut and sitaphal is my favourite.

I recently visited Natural Ice Cream and picked up their tender coconut and sitaphal flavors. Both tasted absolutely fresh and delicious—just the right amount of natural sweetness! The store itself had a pleasant vibe, and the staff were friendly, helpful, and quick to serve. Overall, a great place for anyone looking for authentic, flavorful ice cream. I’ll definitely be back to try more flavors!

The service was quick but there were limited flavours available and also the seat was limited.
I would strongly recommend not to try Mango and Kala Jamun icecreams, both of them were just flavoured, not good at all. However, as usual, tender coconut was tendering as always.

name: Myfroyoland Premium Frozen Yogurt - Indiranagar, Bangalore
review_texts:
Noticed insects around the toppings 😢, which raises concerns about how frequently cleaning is done. The yoghurt consistency also varies quite a bit between flavours, making it feel a little inconsistent.
That said, the taste of yoghurt itself is good.

Please spend less than Rs 100 to buy epigamia yogurt and enjoy it with fresh fruit. This place has ruined the meaning of froyo for me! They should learn from IKEA who is selling top notch frozen yogurt under Rs 50! This place is highly priced and is serving artificially flavoured runny yogurt so watery. Also i saw insects in one of the toppings

Good place for dessert. You can self service as you like and can take whatever flavors you like. After you take, you can add toppings too like gems, cashew nuts, chocolate chips , KitKat etc.
Finally you've to weigh and you are charged according to the weight in grams.
I recommend trying strawberry and mango they are very good. Others are not that good.
Overall 4/5

there are many flavours and topping available. You can try how many ever flavours you want. You can also mix a couple of flavours. the toppings include, oreo, choco chips, biscoff, nutella, chocolate sauce, and many more. The pricing is done based on the total weight of your frozen yoghurt.

Have visited on Friday evening and found the experience to be quite enjoyable. While the variety of flavors and toppings was impressive, I did find the cost to be a bit high for what was offered.the quality of the yogurt itself was delicious and the hygiene standards were well-maintained, Overall, I would recommend giving this place a try, especially if you're in the mood for some tasty yogurt with a variety of toppings to choose from."

name: Amma's Pastries
review_texts:
One of the worst places when it comes to food safety. The cakes are often stale or spoiled, which is especially concerning for customers purchasing them for children. Please be extremely careful before ordering.
In my experience, this outlet does not appear to be maintaining acceptable food safety and hygiene standards. I am also highlighting this issue across other platforms ( Social media)  to help raise awareness and prevent others from facing similar problems.

Irresponsible people are working here ..

Very reasonable prices and fast service. Although the place is largely crowded, almost all of their chocolate cake items are fantastic tastes great (especially their chocolate truffle and mousse cake)! If you haven't placed any order before, they have a good variety of cakes which are ready to swallow want a freshly prepared cake in no time and the taste just finger licking, head to any of the branches of Amma pastry and get one. The staff is friendly, excellent customer service and the taste of the cakes is brilliantly amazing at an affordable price. The chocolate cakes are the best and they even customize pastry for birthday, wedding, party cakes as well. Undoubtedly the most spacious amma bakery in Bengaluru, crowd is usually high during peak hour but the delivery is correspondingly quick, you need not wait for long period. You have ample space to park your vehicles. As a compliment they give a candle and knife which is a plus.

Worst pastries I have ever tried not as expected too much of suger syrup flowing out from the pastry tastes so bad.. 90 rupees for a truffle ? highly disappointed. I went to the bakery and got it parcel very bad taste.. and got veg puff also that tastes horrible really not expected this..I will never ever taste pastry or cakes from this shop in my life..not worth the money.. highly disappointed, I  repeat highly disappointed.
Iam taking 10 pes cake paking charges extra 60 very bad paking charges

This is bad experience..nowadays only when I go and ask for Black Forest the sales person will tell wait for some time it will take time and he will go inside and come telling that no stock..this is not first time Everytime same kindly don’t go to this branch

name: WarmOven
review_texts:
We ordered litchi cake for our Mother’s Day celebration and it was delicious. Order came on time as requested in spite of heavy rain in our area and delivery guy was really polite. It was well packed. I would order all my cakes from warm oven from now on.

Follow my food journey on Instagram (@vy_was_here)

I have ordered a many times  online from Warm Oven. All the times I am overwhelmed by the quality, delivery of the cakes they make.

I have ordered red velvet couple of times which is their trademark cake and most recommended. Tried the frozen photo cake which was also perfect. The other time we tried death by chocolate cake which was delicious too.

WarmOven website is reliable to place orders and you can choose your delivery slot accordingly. Cakes from here are highly recommended.

Have tried the most of the cakes from here. Till now nothing has disappointed me.

If you plan for a surprise at midnight this would be the site to order from !!

One classic cake! It's rich, tasty and awesome! The price is little high! But the cake , the make everything is beautiful. Had ordered a red velvet cake from here. And it was world class. There delivery was good too. I don't have any negative point as such. Looking forward in ordering more from you guys. Keep up the good work! Keep rocking.

I wanted to give them private feedback on the awful shakes namely - death by chocolate thick shake and red velvet thick shake,  Bottle cakes- chocolate cake in bottle & red velvet cake in bottle, but it seems they do everyhing via a centralised system, so it is unlikely to help in improving anything. Ordered via swiggy- cakes came without spoons so was very difficult to eat, children created mess and was like chocolate paste.  Shakes were like sweet syrups .I did get a note from the chef asking for feedback, but without any contact information.

I loved the smooth ordering process, the quality of the order and their service. I ordered a birthday cake at the last moment after a hard day at work. The ordering process was automated via the website, yet personalized as I called to check availability. The person on the call was patient to stay with me as I completed the order. He was very courteous and supportive. The delivery was made within 1.5 hours and the delivery-man was humble and cheerful even after a possible struggle through the Bangalore traffic. The cake was fresh, most and so delectable; it quite literally made our day! Overall, in my first order there were several reasons for the five stars!

name: Apsara Ice Creams
review_texts:
Apsara Ice Cream offers soft-on-the-palate ice creams with really nice and natural-tasting flavours. They have a good variety of unique options to choose from. If you visit on the 22nd of the month, they usually offer a special 50% discount, which is a great deal.
The place is quite small and can accommodate around 4–5 people at a time. Parking is not available, so plan accordingly. Overall, it’s a good spot to enjoy different and natural flavours at a reasonable price.

I visited Apsara ice cream parlour on a weekend evening with my spouse. As it's in busy street of Indiranagar, we preferred to taking our two wheeler so that we can explore the streets and have ice cream at the end. So we parked opposite to the parlour in the same lane.
We first tried many ice cream flavors and finally chose Pinaberry Colada and Choco Berry, though everything was tasty. They had 4 flavours of sorbets as well: Watermelon, Imli, Mango and Pani Puri. Even they were really good, tangy and fresh.
I would love to go again here to have other flavors.

It is a small place within walking distance from Indiranagar metro station. They have good variety if flavours. We tried Jackfruit Jazz and Cheeky Chikkoo both were quite good. They do have sugarfree options as well. Comparatively prices are tad bit higher.
There are 3 high chairs inside the shop to sit and couple of chairs outside.

Apsara Ice Cream is a true delight! Their flavors are unique, refreshing, and crafted with real creativity — not just the usual vanilla and chocolate. I especially loved their tender coconut and sitaphal ice creams, which tasted so natural and creamy. The staff is friendly, welcoming, and always ready to suggest new flavors to try. The ambiance is cozy, perfect for enjoying a scoop with friends or family. Prices are reasonable for the quality, and portions are generous. If you’re looking for something beyond ordinary ice cream, Apsara is the place to be. Highly recommended! 🍨✨

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Tried the Guava Glory and Pani Puri ice creams here and both were absolutely unique and delicious! 😍 The flavors are super refreshing and something totally different from regular ice creams. Creamy texture, good quantity, and great service too. A must-visit place for anyone who loves experimenting with flavors. Highly recommend! 🍦✨

name: Krispy Kreme Doughnuts & Coffee | Indiranagar
review_texts: I seldom happen to have an urge to have doughnuts, and when I did this KrispyKreme in Indiranagar satiated my craving quite well. The service personnel was also very warm, patient and well behaved. Thank you for pleasant service & experience.

I visited this place with a few friends to satisfy our sweet cravings. It’s located on a busy street, so there’s always a bit of a crowd around. As for the donuts, they were okay, not amazing but not bad either. The staff were friendly and welcoming, which I appreciated. Overall, both the taste and the experience were fairly average.
My daughter and I had a lovely Sunday morning treat at KK. The food and drinks were delicious, and the service was excellent. We especially enjoyed the wide variety of coffee and shakes.

I recently visited this place and was delighted by the delicious assortment of donuts they offer. Not only were the donuts incredibly tasty, but there was also a fantastic offer: buy 3 and get one free! The location of the shop is perfect, making it convenient to stop by for a sweet treat. Additionally, I was impressed by the cleanliness of the place and the quick service provided by the staff. Overall, it was a delightful experience, and I highly recommend this place to any donut lovers out there! 🍩✨ #DonutDelight #GreatDeals #YummyTreats
The doughnuts are great and i ordered through Swiggy dineout about 7 doughnuts the staff were not good from my perspective there was a misunderstanding

name: Watson's Indiranagar
review_texts:
The initial approach to this venue is, frankly, unsettling. The entrance is decidedly eerie, bordering on scary, which doesn’t exactly scream "fine dining." However, crossing the threshold reveals a surprising transformation.
The interior is beautifully designed, offering a stark, aesthetic contrast to the exterior. More importantly, the climate control is a literal lifesaver; the temperature inside is perfectly calibrated to provide a refreshing escape from the sweltering heat outside.

We arrived for Sunday brunch at 1:00 PM and were the only patrons there. Even by the time we departed at 4:00 PM, the space remained curiously empty.
While this makes it an ideal spot to chill with friends for hours without being rushed, the culinary experience fails to live up to the decor.
The menu is disappointingly limited.
The Kodagu Pork Taco and Pandi Pork were highlights (4/5), boasting authentic flavors. We even went off-menu for a Prawn Butter Garlic (3/5) since all listed prawn dishes were fried.
However, the Asian Chicken Wings were an absolute disaster (0/5).
On the beverage side, the Garden Fresh gin cocktail and the Daiquiri were well-executed (4/5), though the Curried Pineapple felt like an odd experiment that didn't quite land.

Ultimately, while the ambiance is serene, the inconsistent food means I cannot recommend a visit.

We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at this restaurant. The food was outstanding—every dish was fresh, flavorful, and prepared to perfection. From the appetizers to the main course, everything exceeded our expectations and showcased the quality and care that goes into every meal.

What truly made our visit special was the exceptional service provided by Sanju. A huge shout-out and heartfelt thank you to Sanju for making our experience so enjoyable. From the moment we arrived, Sanju was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely dedicated to ensuring we had a great time. He checked on us regularly, made excellent recommendations, and handled every request with a smile and professionalism.

It’s rare to come across someone who is so passionate about providing outstanding customer service. Sanju’s positive attitude, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality made us feel valued and well taken care of throughout our visit. He is a true asset to the restaurant and played a big part in making this one of the best dining experiences we’ve had.

The combination of amazing food and Sanju’s exceptional service made this visit unforgettable. We will definitely be returning and highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food and outstanding hospitality. Thank you again, Sanju, for going above and beyond—you made our evening truly special!

Visited solo after nearly four years, and the space still impresses, expansive layout, positive ambience, and a generally helpful crew. The environment feels welcoming, and the initial service experience was smooth.
However, toward the end of the visit, as I was preparing to close out, the service noticeably slowed and became a drag. This was surprising, especially since the venue was not fully occupied. There appeared to be some reluctance or disengagement from the service staff during the final stretch....
After such a long gap, I genuinely expected consistent, end to end service throughout the visit. Customer experience should remain attentive from the moment one walks in until the bill is settled.
That said, hoping the next visit will be better,the place has the potential to deliver a truly solid experience if service consistency is maintained from beginning to end.

I had a very disappointing experience at Watson’s Indiranagar. The food quality and hygiene standards were extremely concerning. While eating one of the dishes we ordered, we discovered a cockroach in the food. This completely ruined our dining experience and raised serious questions about the restaurant’s food preparation and cleanliness practices.

Food safety should be a basic expectation at any restaurant, and finding an insect in a served dish is unacceptable. Although the ambiance may be good, hygiene cannot be compromised. I hope the management takes immediate corrective action, conducts a thorough inspection of their kitchen, and improves their quality control processes to ensure this does not happen to other customers.

Unfortunately, based on this experience, I cannot recommend this place.

Visited Watson  Pub after a long time and the nostalgia hit instantly. Tried their signature cocktails for the first time and the vibe felt the same. Ordered chicken tikka , buratta pizza and Kerala style prawn dry which tasted really good and they now have a cute Photo Booth. Took some pictures and it was fun to take the photos back home

name: The Reservoire Indiranagar
review_texts:
Recently visited this pub on a Friday night. We ordered Chicken Nachos, Malai Chicken, Mutton Biryani, and wine. The pricing was quite reasonable, and the overall atmosphere and ambience were really good.

The Chicken Nachos were decent, but I had tasted better ones at another pub recently, so they didn’t stand out for me. The Malai Chicken was good, but it wasn’t as creamy as I expected—it felt more like a chicken barbecue than a classic creamy malai dish.

The only drawback was the waiting time, which was around one hour. Apart from that, the ambience and overall experience were enjoyable. A nice place to hang out, especially for the vibe and atmosphere. 🍷🍗✨

The place was a bit on the expensive side, but the overall experience was quite good. The food quality was impressive, with fresh ingredients, well-balanced flavors, and attractive presentation. Every dish we tried was prepared carefully and tasted great, making it a worthwhile choice for anyone who values good food.
While the prices may be higher than some other restaurants in the area, the quality of the food helps justify the cost. The menu offers a good variety of options, catering to different tastes and preferences. Whether you're visiting for a casual meal with friends, a family gathering, or a special occasion, the food is definitely one of the highlights of the place.
Another strong point is the drinks selection. They have plenty of options available, including a wide range of beverages to complement the meal. Whether you prefer refreshing mocktails, cocktails, soft drinks, or other specialty beverages, there is something for everyone.
Overall, I would recommend this place primarily for its food quality and diverse drinks menu. Although it may not be the most budget-friendly option, the taste, quality, and variety make it a good choice for those looking to enjoy a satisfying dining experience.

Visited this place in Indiranagar recently and honestly, the experience was a mixed bag. We had a reservation for 8 PM for a group of five, but still had to wait almost an hour for our table, which was quite frustrating. Since we had invited others as well, we decided to stay instead of looking for another place.

While waiting, we checked out the bar area and tried the Reviver mocktail, which was pretty average and not something I’d personally recommend.

Once we got seated, we started with the Dahi Kebabs (3/5), California Sushi Roll (4/5), peri-peri fries (really good), and paneer tikka, which was just okay. Later, I tried their Strawberry Cheesecake cocktail and that was honestly the highlight for me. If you enjoy Bacardi/white rum-based drinks, this one is definitely worth trying again.

For the main course, we ordered dal makhani, paneer butter masala, naan, and rotis. The food was noticeably spicy, so if you’re sensitive to spice levels, it’s better to ask them to tone it down beforehand.

Overall, despite a few good dishes and drinks, the long waiting time made the experience underwhelming for me. Personally, I don’t see myself visiting again.

This place holds a very special place in my heart. My partner planned our first date here, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable evenings. Since then, I've been back countless times—with my partner as well as my girl gang—and it has never disappointed. The cocktails are absolutely to die for, the food is consistently delicious, and the overall experience is always exceptional. It's one of those places I keep coming back to, and it never fails to make every visit feel special.

Visited Reservoir, Indiranagar with high expectations, mainly because the 4th-floor ambience looked lovely. Unfortunately, we were shifted to the 3rd floor due to ongoing work. The indoor seating felt quite congested, so we chose the balcony instead.
The experience went downhill from there. We specifically ordered a thin-crust pizza but were served a thick-crust one that was bland and lacking flavour. When we asked for Tabasco, we were handed cheap ketchup instead. The mocktails were overwhelmingly sweet, and the Lavender Oats Iced Coffee sounded far more impressive than it tasted.
The only standout dish was the Honey Chilli Lotus Stem, which was genuinely delicious. The Fish Koliwada was decent but nothing memorable. Blueberry panacotta wasn't what I was expecting.
Would I visit again? Unfortunately, no.

name: Daddy Bangalore
review_texts: Visited Daddy Bangalore recently and the vibe was absolutely amazing. The rooftop ambience, music, and overall atmosphere make it a perfect place to chill . Few of their starters were too good — especially the prawns roast , chicken fries and paneer dishes. The food presentation and drinks were also impressive. Service was decent and the place had a lively Bangalore nightlife feel. Definitely a good spot for weekend hangouts and evening plans.

Had been wanting to visit the place since ages & finally did & WOW, what an ambience, absolutely loved it❣️ The food too was amazing 👌 but though not completely bad, what could be improved upon is the Service. The waiters frown & reluctantly click pics if you ask them to do so.  Another thing to watch out for is the bill. Even after charging SGST, they additionally add Service Charges that too when the service was not even up-to-mark 😞!!! So Yes as I liked the ambience & food, I will go again but I will be doubly sure to check the bill.

Daddy Bangalore is one of the most happening and vibrant places in the city — a perfect mix of hotel and pub vibes that makes it truly stand out...
The food menu is quite diverse, and everything we ordered was flavorful and well presented. The cocktails are creative and fun, with a good mix of classics and house specials. The staff specially  *mr. Bhojaraj* were courteous and attentive, making sure we were comfortable throughout. Overall good experience

We visited Daddy Restaurant in Indiranagar and got a 25% discount, plus 2 complimentary drinks, which was a nice bonus.

What we ordered:
•	Tandoori prawns (9 pieces) – 3.5/5
•	Chicken peanut dumplings – 4/5
•	Chicken tikka pizza – 4/5
•	Mango colada – 2/5
•	Cosmopolitan – 2/5

The food was good overall, especially the chicken peanut dumplings and chicken tikka pizza. The drinks, however, were a bit disappointing.

A special mention to Sisir, who served us. His behavior was very sweet, polite, and welcoming, which made the experience better.

If a place can have attitude, this is it.
Everyone was rude, no one responds. You'll have to fight for your life to get a waiter's attention and on top of that you'll be treated as a criminal if you ask to remove service charge. I would've been fine if the service was fine but it was abysmal
Food was bad too, people should really know what a biryani is before putting it on the menu. Making matters worse, it came in a tiffin box (nothing but aesthetics) we assumed ateast 2 stories would have biryani in it, only one of them has biryani that too half the container.

Gave two instead of one star just because noodles were good, some what of a redemption

name: 21st Amendment Gastrobar Indiranagar
review_texts:
I went on a Monday evening and love the music playing in the background, it was of decent volume but we can still talk easily.
Coming to service, it was good and the staff was available at your disposal.
We ordered, peri peri French fries but it got cold in no time, cheese atom bombs were really good, cheese garlic bread and thin crust veg pizza were good as well.
In mocktails, Hawaiian Punch was good with a slightly sweet taste of pineapple.
They still charge 10% service charge i guess but do payment using Zomato to get best offers.
Overall a good place to meet friends.

Had a great time at 21st Amendment. The place has a lively ambience, good music and a fun crowd, making it a solid spot for weekend hangouts with friends.

Drinks were well made and the menu had plenty of options across cocktails and spirits. Service was quick even during busy hours and the staff were friendly throughout. Food quality was also impressive and paired really well with the drinks.

Overall, a very good mix of atmosphere, music, food and drinks. Definitely one of the better places to chill and unwind in Bangalore.

Really enjoyed the snacks here, the nacho chicken and crunchy corn were super tasty and perfectly crispy. The cocktails were also very refreshing, especially the Sex on the Beach, Watermelon & Basil cocktail, Bellini, and Hawaiian.

The pizzas were good too, especially the Chicken Pizza and Classic Farm Fresh Veg Pizza with fresh toppings and nice flavors. Overall, good food, good drinks, and a nice experience.

We booked through Swiggy and went on week days but it was still busy and full crowd.
I must say better to book and go.
The ambience is okay and good specially for youngsters.
Food is tasty and cost is also normal, pocket friendly.
Beer is options are good and cheap.
The fish was good along with chicken pizza and nachos
You can try the Coorgi Pork

The whole place is smoke plus drinks and hence don’t expect separate no smoking place.

You can visit your friends and definetly throw a party their

Great selection of cocktails. They are cost-effective as well. Even the food options were good. We had the pepper lamb, 21A prawns - both chilli garlic and butter garlic were great, the wine tossed pork was also delicious. The spicey dicey mushroom was a great veg option. Service was a little slow, they need to know all the items in the menu like the back of their hand, other than that production is fast.

name: Big Pitcher Indiranagar
review_texts:
Had a wonderful time at Big Pitcher, Kodihalli! The rooftop seating was definitely the highlight. The cool evening breeze and the beautiful night view made it even more special. Watching the flights glide across the night sky like birds was such a peaceful and mesmerizing experience.

The ambience was lively with good music, and the food and drinks were enjoyable too. The service was polite, though it was a little slow during busy hours. Overall, it's a great place to unwind with friends, especially if you can get a rooftop table. The rooftop view alone is worth the visit!

Had a wonderful team lunch at Big Pitcher, Indiranagar with a group of 30+ people. The venue handled our large gathering very well, with comfortable seating and excellent service throughout the event.

The highlight was definitely the happy hours package, which included unlimited mocktails and beer. The beverages were served promptly, and there was a good variety to choose from. The food was tasty, well-presented, and catered nicely to a large group.

Overall, it was a great experience with good food, refreshing drinks, a lively atmosphere, and attentive staff. A great choice for team outings, corporate lunches, and group celebrations. Highly recommended!

Had a wonderful experience at The Big Pitcher with my wife. The overall atmosphere was lively, welcoming, and perfect for a relaxed evening out. The food was delicious, well-prepared, and served promptly. The beer selection was good and enjoyable, although there is always room to further refine and elevate some of the brews.

What truly stood out was the exceptional service, especially from the Floor Manager, Ashok. Being from the hospitality industry myself, I naturally pay close attention to service standards, guest interactions, and staff professionalism. Ashok was outstanding in every aspect. He was warm, attentive, patient, and genuinely focused on ensuring guests had a great experience. He handled everything with a smile and showed a level of hospitality that is becoming increasingly rare.

It's clear that he understands the true meaning of guest service and goes above and beyond to make people feel valued and comfortable. The Big Pitcher is fortunate to have someone like Ashok leading the floor. Team members like him leave a lasting impression and are a major reason guests return.

Overall, a fantastic experience with great food, good beer, excellent ambiance, and truly memorable hospitality. Looking forward to visiting again soon. Highly recommended! 🍻👏🏻

The ambience is really nice, and the overall vibe is pleasant. The staff and service are polite, friendly, and welcoming. While the food is decent, it felt a bit average to me. That said, it’s still a good place to visit for the ambience, relaxed atmosphere, and positive vibes.

A cool and relaxed place with great service and good food. Their in-house brews are excellent and well crafted, making the experience even better.
The bathrooms are clean, and overall you feel well looked after throughout the visit  attentive without being intrusive.
A solid spot for good brews, comfort, and dependable service.

name: The Balcony Bar
review_texts:
​Balcony Bar is a fantastic, cozy spot that’s absolutely perfect for catching up and having great, long conversations with friends. The ambience has a really cool, fantasy-like vibe, which is beautifully complemented by a nice selection of music. The food was also good and definitely hit the spot.
​For smokers, they offer a convenient open smoking area. A quick tip: try to arrive a bit early to snag a seat with the road-side view, as that’s easily the hotspot of the bar. Just don't set your expectations sky-high for the seating setup itself, but the view still adds a great touch to the evening. Overall, a wonderful place to unwind!

After a social gathering in Indiranagar last weekend, we headed to The Balcony Bar after being unable to get a table for 8 at Toit. Compared to larger breweries nearby, this place felt more approachable, affordable, and relaxed.

The balcony seating and overall ambience were really good, creating a nice social atmosphere for groups and casual hangouts. Service was quick, the servers were polite and attentive, and the food tasted good with satisfactory portions.

The balcony area fills up quickly, but thankfully we were offered a balcony table within about 10 minutes of entering. Overall, a good option in the busy Indiranagar nightlife scene, especially if you are looking for a more easygoing experience.

I’m sitting right here. The vibes and the food are both amazing. Oh, and the service too. There’s live match screening. I ordered tandoori chicken and Canadian rice. My friend had a Toit beer. We totally loved the food and the beer. It’s a perfect mix of breeze and chaos. They’re quick with regular service also like refilling water etc.

Recommended

Hands down my favorite weekend spot on 100 Feet Road! The open balcony setup combined with the refreshing breeze and a unique music playlist gives The Balcony Bar an entirely different, stellar vibe. Their cocktail game is incredibly strong, and the Purple Lantern cocktail is easily the star of the menu—you cannot leave without trying it. It is the ultimate place to relax, catch up with friends, and enjoy a vibrant Bangalore evening. Highly recommended!

We went here for lunch with our kid. The ambience is average, but the food was good overall.
We tried several dishes. The Mangalorean Mutton Sukka was tasty and the mutton was cooked well. The Butter Garlic Chilli Prawns had a slightly unique flavour compared to the regular version and were quite nice. The Turkish Tale Fish was unfortunately very bland. The Lehsuni Lajawab Chicken was excellent and definitely a must-try. The Veg Bechamel Pasta was just okay.
The music was initially too loud, but after we requested, the staff reduced the volume, which we appreciated. However, the non-smoking zone was closed. When we had called earlier, we were informed that the place was kid-friendly, but people were smoking inside. When we requested to shift, we were told that the non-smoking section was not available.
Also, Google mentions valet parking, but there is no valet service. Finding parking nearby is quite difficult due to limited space. We had to park about 500 meters away, and it took us nearly 15 minutes to find a spot.
Overall, it was a decent experience, mainly because of the food, but a few aspects could definitely be improved.

name: Bob's Bar
review_texts:
We recently visited Bob’s Bar, Indiranagar, as a group of eight people, and we had a really enjoyable dining experience. The place has a classic, lively ambience with multi-level seating, which gives it a unique and energetic atmosphere. Even on a weekday, the place was completely packed, and we had to wait for a table. However, the experience was definitely worth the wait.

One of the biggest highlights was the service. Despite the restaurant being very busy, the staff were quick, attentive, and efficient. The food arrived surprisingly fast, and the overall service was well managed throughout our visit.

Coming to the food, we tried several dishes and were happy with the quality and taste. The Chicken Kebab was delicious and well prepared, while the Pepper Chicken was flavourful and tasty. My personal favourite was the Raw Banana Cutlet—it was unique, delicious, and definitely something I would order again.

Another major advantage of Bob’s Bar is the pricing. Considering the location, food quality, ambience, and service, the prices are very affordable and offer excellent value for money.

Overall, we had a very good experience as a group. Great food, fast service, a lively classic ambience, affordable pricing, and a wonderful atmosphere make this place worth visiting. Be prepared for a waiting time because the place seems to be busy even on weekdays, but it is definitely worth the wait.

Highly recommended for groups of friends looking for good food, a lively atmosphere, and an affordable dining experience in Indiranagar

Absolutely loved the experience at Bob’s Bar Indiranagar — easily becoming one of my favourite chill bar spots in Bangalore. Tried Tanqueray Gin, Bacardi Reserva Ocho, Jack Daniel’s Honey and finally Don Julio Blanco tequila, and the pricing honestly felt quite reasonable for the quality and overall vibe.

Food was excellent too. Chicken Wings 65, Bob’s Chicken Kebab, Lemon Chicken and Bob’s Tawa Chicken were all really good bar bites and paired nicely with the drinks. The atmosphere was relaxed, crowd was fun and service was quick throughout.

Overall, a great place for casual hangouts, good spirits and affordable weekend scenes without feeling overly fancy or crowded. Definitely coming back again.

Bob’s is honestly an emotion and always a place we love, so checking out their new outlet was a great experience.

The space is more compact compared to their Indiranagar and Kalyan Nagar outlets, but it’s thoughtfully designed across multiple levels with plenty of seating, which works really well. The menu, as always, is solid and the food didn’t disappoint, we tried quite a few things and really enjoyed it.

What stands out is that it still carries the same Bob’s vibe, great lighting, great music, and that familiar energy. Had an amazing time here with friends!

I visited Bob’s Bar Indiranagar and honestly, it is one of the best places in Indiranagar if you want a lively, affordable, no-fuss bar experience. The place has a proper young Bangalore crowd, great energy, quick service, and very reasonable pricing for this location.

What stood out for me was the lightning-fast service. Even though the place was busy, the food and drinks came really quickly. The food is classic bar food — simple, tasty, familiar, and perfect for sharing with friends. The overall vibe reminded me strongly of Oly Pub Kolkata: old-school charm, pocket-friendly prices, fast service, and a place that feels more about people and atmosphere than unnecessary show-off.

For anyone looking for a budget-friendly bar in Indiranagar, good food and drinks in Bangalore, or a casual place to hang out with friends near 100 Feet Road, Bob’s Bar is definitely worth visiting. Great value, great crowd, and a very Bangalore kind of evening.

Visited Bob’s Bar in Indiranagar for lunch and chose an inner-side corner seat, which offered a relaxed atmosphere. I placed the order online, making the process smooth and hassle-free. The service was quick, with all items reaching the table without much waiting.

For food, I ordered a beer bottle, akki rotti, buff roast, Malanad pork, and a Mangalore-style rice cake (name forgotten). All the curry dishes came in small portions. Among the dishes, the Malanad pork was easily the highlight—flavorful, well-cooked, and truly top notch. It clearly stood out from the rest.

The remaining items—buff roast, akki rotti, and the rice cake—were good but didn’t offer anything extraordinary or memorable. Overall, Bob’s Bar delivered a pleasant lunch experience with decent food and fast service. I would rate it 3.5 out of 5.

name: Travellers Bungalow (Bar & Restaurant)
review_texts:
Traveller’s Bungalow is truly one of Bangalore’s hidden gems. The place is beautiful, comfort, and nature, creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere from the moment you step in. The ambience is thoughtfully designed, with every corner reflecting character and attention to detail.

The staff are welcoming and the overall experience feels both peaceful and memorable. Whether you’re visiting for a meal, a gathering, or simply to unwind, Traveller’s Bungalow offers a unique escape from the city’s hustle and bustle.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great vibes, beautiful surroundings, and a genuinely delightful experience. Looking forward to visiting again!

Came across this place randomly and it was the best thing. The food here has my heart. Menu is selectively limited but every dish is curated with such professionalism. Pappu served us and please do ask for him. His recommendations are too good. We tried a bunch of dishes here and everything was amazing

Decent food, Nothing mindboggling, but not average either, Worth a visit for the ambience alone!

Paneer Plant Meat with Lavash 3/5 - Not too flavourful, not bland either, it's Okay.

Ravioli 4/5 - Really great! The sauce especially! So sweet and bright! Coupled with the creaminess of the cheese and the kick of the chillies this is a must order!

Beignet 4/5 - It's like a berliner, nice a fluffly. And really worth the 150 odd bucks.

Service was good, Ambience of the place feels so unique! Like a tavern of sorts. But it's too hot even inside, the AC needs to be really ambed up.

A random visit turned out to be a great choice. Nice ambience,good food, great staff. Price is on the higher range. We ordered Spanakopita in starters, Napoli and Ravioli in main course. Definitely worth a visit.

One of the most underrated places in Bangalore. This place has amazing food, good menu and delicious dishes priced well. The ambience is also great, they've made it traveller themed, the food is oresented in the same way, even the tissues are theme-based. The place had amazing music, they had a good playlist initially and then a guy performed live and both which was really good. All in all 10/10 place for a casual dinner with friends.

name: House of Commons
review_texts:
Drinks were good, open space facing the road, so you can, hear the vehicles passing sound. Nachos were good in taste.

Service needs to improve as we went in afternoon it was not at all crowded but the staff was least bothered to attend our table. We have to keep looking for them to place an order. Cheeseballs we're good in taste too.

The food was good although it took them a while to get it. The onion rings and fries from the 'HOC chip and dip basket' starter was just too good🤤 The HOC Mezze platter was really refreshing too, with the salad and falafel bites. I enjoyed it! The only downside is that it becomes a 'house of commotion' later in the evening when people get drunk, so if you're going with fam, it's best to go a little early like around 7pm😼👍
Valet parking made it pretty convenient and it was free too!
It had good vegetarian options too.
A good place to chat and dine. The atmosphere is lively during live matches. Service is quick and prices are reasonable. There are separate smoking and non-smoking areas.
I had ordered around 10 dishes/drinks yet the bill value did not cross ₹2000.. had one of the best dining experience

Not a good experience. Asked hot water multiple times and received it only on my 4th request. The service could have been more polite. When I requests for the bill, I was only given a scanner with the amount, without explanation. The food was good, especially the lettuce salad.

name: Tipsy Bull
review_texts: Decent food and a pleasant ambience that makes the place comfortable for dining. However, the overall experience was let down by very poor service support. The staff seemed inattentive and unresponsive, which significantly affected our visit. With better service, this place could offer a much better experience.

Had a fantastic time at Tipsy Bull in Indiranagar. The ambiance is lively, the music sets the perfect mood, and the unique bar stock exchange concept keeps the energy high. The food and drinks were top-notch as well.
A special shoutout to Swu for the exceptional service! They were incredibly attentive, polite, and made sure we had everything we needed without any delays. Excellent hospitality truly elevates the whole dining experience. Highly recommended, and will definitely be visiting again!
Feel free to tweak any specific details about the food or drinks you enjoyed before posting it!

It's good it's friendly and it's lovely vibe loved it.Tipsy Bull offers a lively atmosphere with stylish interiors, making it a great spot for casual outings and weekend gatherings. The food is flavorful and well-presented, with a good variety of options to suit different tastes, while the drinks menu is equally impressive. The service is generally attentive and friendly, adding to the overall experience. Although it can get crowded during peak hours, the vibrant ambiance and quality offerings make Tipsy Bull a place worth visiting."
Food: 5/5  |  Service: 5/5  |  Atmosphere: 5/5

Reservation
Reservations not required

Group size
2 people, 3-4 people

Wait time
No wait

This restaurant is one of the best places to visit for both delicious food and a warm atmosphere. From the moment customers walk in, they are welcomed with smiles and treated with great respect. The restaurant is always clean, well-maintained, and beautifully organized, making people feel comfortable and relaxed while dining. The food is prepared with fresh ingredients, and every dish is full of flavor and served with care. Whether it is breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the quality of the meals always remains excellent and worker swu was very kinda with us must visit restaurant.
Had a good time at the restaurant. Sufi night was awesome, the ambience and food was great. Chicken brusetta was extraordinary. Loved the experience here.

name: Jook
review_texts:
