Jook Taproom, located in Indiranagar, is one of the most affordable restobars in the neighbourhood. It is easy to spot, and there is very little parking space available at the entrance.

There is a separate elevator for the customers, and the restobar is located on the third floor. It is spread across two floors, with the metro line running in the background. The ambience is great. The food is tasty, and the staff is courteous too. The staff confuses the orders, and this experience is not very pleasant. This makes for the perfect place to have a joyful evening with your friends.

Headed here for the UCL final and the ambience was spot on. It had a great, lively crowd and a fantastic match-day energy.
The menu, however, was a mixed bag. The food was strictly okay-ish, and the cocktails were overcomplicated—they're forcing too many heavy Indian spices into drinks where they just don't belong.
Go for the great atmosphere and a beer

Had a really good time at Jook Taproom!

Food was definitely a highlight. The pork and fish fingers were really good and paired perfectly with the drinks. We had 4 Jägermeister shots, a LIIT, beer, and a Cosmopolitan, and everything was nicely made 🍹

Service was quick and attentive, which made the overall experience even better. The only area that could improve a bit is the music the DJing and mixing weren’t quite up to the mark and could be more engaging for the crowd.

That said, with good food, solid drinks, and great service, it’s still a nice place to hang out.

Not a great place overall.
Food was below average with very limited options. Didn’t find any exciting side dishes either 😒
On top of that, the pricing felt quite expensive for what was offered.

Overall, a below-average experience and definitely not worth the hype.

The food here is really good, especially the starters—they stand out with great flavour and freshness. The main course is decent, more on the “ok-ok” side, but still enjoyable. The ambience is one of the best parts of the place: calm, nicely designed, and perfect for a relaxed meal. Since it’s popular, making a reservation is definitely recommended. The staff is polite and the service is overall good. There was a small argument during billing due to a misunderstanding, but the team quickly realised their mistake and corrected it without any hesitation. Appreciated their professionalism. Overall, a nice dining experience with great starters and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: 1131 Bar + Kitchen
review_texts: Everything about this place was wonderful. The food and drink was absolutely excellent, packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The environment has a great ambiance, making it perfect for a relaxed meal. Top it off with good, attentive service, and you have a flawless dining experience. Will definitely be back! Recommend 👌.

Had a wonderful experience! The food and service were top notch, and the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive throughout our meal. I really loved the overall ambiance, though it’s worth noting it gets quite lively and noisy on the weekends. Despite the crowd, everything was fantastic. I’ll definitely be back!

We had a really nice experience. The ambience is lively and perfect for an evening out.
We ordered Paneer Tikka Charred Peppers ,Basket of Fries, Signature Nachos, Coke and Cool It Alphonse everything tasted good and portions were decent.

Service was also  good and attentive. Our food came on time .
Total bill was ₹2,049 for two.

Overall, a great place to hang out with tasty food and good service

Good Ambiance,  Good Food.
Crowded Weekends , Doo Pre book the tables.Plan to pay using Zomato Pay at the Resturant for some amazing offers.

Average Food, Great Ambience

Went here for a team dinner. The restaurant scores well on ambience and convenience — spacious interiors, a pleasant vibe, and valet parking available. The service was courteous and timely, which made the experience smooth.

However, the food didn’t quite match the setting. We ordered a variety of starters, but most of them felt repetitive — same base, overly saucy, and a bit too spicy. The flavours seemed to clash and overpower each other rather than complementing the dishes.

Overall, it’s a decent spot if you're looking for a nice place to hang out, but the food could definitely use more variety and balance. I'd rate it average, mainly for the ambience and service.

name: Jimi's
review_texts: The place has a good selection of food. What we tried was Jimi's spl chicken, loaded nachos, Cajun spiced potato, all these items were so amazing. Specially their jimi's spl chicken was super crispy and so flavourful, the loaded nachos were so good with their house made tortilla chips and their Cajun spiced potatoes are not the usual ones that is available in other places, but it's completely different and is seriously a MUST TRY ITEM.  Definately going again for Cajun spiced potato and chicken.

One of the only places in Indira nagar that has a pool table. I believe you need to book it though. Great vibe. Makes for a perfect spot to catch up with friends if you want to avoid the usual busy crowds of the regular pubs around the area. The would say the service here was too good. The uncle serving us needs a trophy. He kept us happy at any cost. He is a champ. I hope he sees this. The food is also good. I was really impressed by the soya chaap tandoori. The prawns butter garlic was nice and juicy. These guys do a good job than the average bars. No loud music so you can have peaceful conversations with friends which makes for a great evening.

Laid back dive bar with a rock theme. Music was very low in volume and the dj played the usual commercial rock songs from the 80’s and 90’s. Good variety of craft beer. Pool table in the back and some rock memorabilia. A coffee area in the balcony. The crafts were good and I tried an IPA

The place has good options of food and drinks. The fish fingers were extremely juicy and fresh the prawns were awesome and the other dishes were flavourful too. The service can be improved and the outdoor seating space needs more comfort. Overall a good experience, would like to visit another time as well.

The place has 3 stories, and it was confusing when entering the building.
There’s no elevator and lots of stairs.
The first floor was quiet with inside sofa tables. Alongside there were outside tables with totally different ambiance!
As I climbed the floor it got even better.
The rooftop is just amazing with lots of tables, open sky ambiance.
The food I ordered was great and the service was pretty quick too.
They do not charge a service tax, so might wanna tip your serving staff~
I recommend this place for rooftop ambiance.

name: Bohemians
review_texts:
The place looks old and rustic. Seats are dirty and not cleaned on purpose it seems. We were 5 people and the total bill came to around 9k which is quite decent.
I liked their chutneys, dishes and the good quality.

Best place to randomly find. Noel is amazing and suggested the best options. Also the food is yummy and totally worth it. If you want a very boho and relaxed karaoke evening, visit Bohemians on a Wednesday evening. ❤️ it. The ambience and vibe is perfect.

It's an old bungalow converted to a restaurant and bar which is very cute. The Aam Pannh cocktail was superb. The karaoke host provided some really good warm up and entertainment as well.
Good for groups or even for a date.

Very disappointing experience overall. The service was extremely slow, and it felt like the staff prioritized tables ordering alcohol and the Genz crowds while largely ignoring other customers. It seemed their focus was on bills that would generate higher service charges rather than providing equal service to everyone. They forcefully charge service charges and they remove it.

The food was another major letdown. We specifically asked the waiter for their best-selling and recommended dishes, trusting their suggestions, but every item we ordered turned out to be below average. The quality and taste were nowhere near what you'd expect for the price.
Communication with the staff was also difficult. The waiter struggled to communicate clearly in both English and Hindi, making it hard to understand recommendations or ask questions.

Overall, between the slow service, poor food quality, and lack of effective communication, the experience was far from satisfactory. I wouldn't recommend this place, especially when there are many better dining options available in the area.

Visited Bohemian with a group of friends on a Saturday night, and unfortunately, the experience was disappointing from the very beginning.

Before even taking our order, the waiter informed us that the service charge was mandatory. Starting the dining experience with that conversation left a poor first impression.

The food itself was average at best and felt significantly overpriced. Given the menu prices, we expected generous portions, but each serving was barely enough for one person.

Another major issue was the number of mosquitoes around the seating area, which made it difficult to enjoy the meal.

The restaurant also uses a web-based menu instead of a physical one, which wasn’t very user-friendly. To make matters worse, an additional ₹30 platform fee was added to the bill, which felt unnecessary and wasn’t something we expected.

Overall, the combination of average food, small portions, mosquitoes, and extra charges made the experience poor. I wouldn’t consider returning.

name: Mojo By Vapour Pub
review_texts:
Overall it was a pleasant..evening
Ambience was great..we opted for outdoor seating as the breeze was cool and refreshing..❤️ Wide range of seating arrangements for variety of people..duo..trio and groups..
Light music in the background made the evening quite cozy..

Food was very good but not soo great..
I loved the nachos..👍
Pricing was a bit pricely i felt compared to other resto..but its fine for a pub..located in bangalore..👍

Overall a one time visit place...

Visited Vapour Pub recently and had an amazing experience.🫶🇪🇸❤️ The vibe, music, and crowd were all perfect. 🪇Food was delicious and drinks were well made. Highlight of the night was meeting Dance coreo Varadha Master🕺🏻such a great moment! Highly recommend this place for a fun night out.🥳🍾

Had been to Vapour pub, terrace. Place is very small, Dec night time is very cold. Doesn't have much great view from terrace. No much decoration and they dont even have the logo on the terrace to click pics.. i would say this is just Ok place to hang out. Prices are higher than compared to other places. Food which I had in chicken was very good, veg not so much. Service is very good, they have pleasant kind staffs and manager is friendly as well.
Most importantly, if you find any offers or packages on any apps or website, I would suggest you call the place and confirm everything before you book, especially the drinks, what ever they had mentioned was not available, had to choose from different plan.

Visited on Friday night at 8...was totally empty and was quite surprised! Later learnt that everything there is falsely advertised like the poster below. You have to read the fine print if you want to go here! Prices are exorbitant and the ambience/ atmosphere not worth it. So we didn't spend much time (or money 😀)  and left!

This place has become so average off late. The food & drinks prices are through the roof for below average quality, service is abysmal & late, and the DJ is still playing mixes of bole chooriyaan & chittiyaan kaliyaan type of songs (most of the tracks were the same played 2 years back!). Vapour has lost its sheen by a big margin.

name: Native Bar and Coastal kitchen
review_texts: Aesthetic and chic ambience. Reasonably priced drinks and most food items are good. Service is decent. The 2nd floor with sunroof is beautiful but there was no service when we visited. The 1st floor bay window seatings are lovely.

Found this spot completely by chance while walking through Indiranagar, and it turned out to be such a solid find.

Tucked away beside Wanley, Native Bar has that perfect mid-scale neighborhood vibe—nothing too fancy, but exactly what you want when you’re out to unwind. The liquor is surprisingly well-priced, and the bar bites hit the mark. The seafood, in particular, really stands out.

The closed rooftop is definitely the place to be—great energy, especially in the evenings. It’s ideal for post-work hangouts or catching up with friends over a match.

We unwinder with couple of beers paired with chicken ghee roast and fish kebab, and honestly, for the price, no complaints at all. The vibe inside is consistently electric, which just adds to the whole experience.

Definitely a spot we will keep coming back to.

Exceptional food, cozy vibes, and solid drinks 🍽️✨

Visited The Native, Indiranagar, and honestly, it turned out to be one of those places where everything just hits right. The taste is absolutely top notch and every single dish we tried was packed with flavour and authenticity.

I completely fell in love with the Anjal Tawa Fry. It was perfectly cooked, beautifully spiced, and easily the highlight of the meal. Apart from that, the chicken ghee roast, pepper chicken, and other tawa fry dishes were outstanding. Paired with soft neer dosa, the combination was chef’s kiss 🤌 Whatever we ordered was consistently good, which says a lot about the kitchen.

They also have a good selection of booze, which complements the food really well and makes it a great place for a relaxed lunch or dinner with friends.

The ambience deserves a mention too. Cozy, warm, and comfortable, without being too loud or cramped. It’s the kind of place where you can sit back, enjoy good food, good drinks, and have proper conversations.

Overall, The Native delivers on taste, quality, and vibe. If you enjoy coastal flavours, well cooked non veg, and a cozy dining experience, this place is a must visit. Definitely coming back to try more from the menu.

Native Bar and Coastal Kitchen offers a great blend of vibrant ambience and delicious food, making it a perfect spot for a relaxed outing. The place has a warm, lively vibe with a coastal-inspired touch that adds to the overall experience.
We tried the tandoori chicken, garlic naan, and chicken Hyderabadi.Overall, the food quality and ambience make this place worth visiting. If you're looking for a good dine-in experience with flavorful dishes, Native Bar and Coastal Kitchen is definitely a great choice.
Had a nice lunch here. The food and drinks were good, though the mushroom stuffed tikka could be better. It’s a small place, but the prices are affordable, so overall a decent experience.

name: Arena Brewhouse Bangalore
review_texts: Had an amazing evening at Arena Brewhouse on 100 Feet Road! The pyramid-style architecture and the stunning Gatsby-inspired bar setup give it an incredible, upscale vibe. We tried their Hefeweizen wheat beer and the Stout, both of which were brewed perfectly. For food, the pork ribs, chilli chicken, and dim sums were packed with flavor, and the Belgian fondant was the perfect end to the meal. Excellent hospitality and prompt service throughout. Highly recommended for a night out with friends or team parties.

Visited Arena Brewhouse for an office party where the entire venue was booked and the place definitely makes an impression. The pyramid shaped dome is the standout element, visually stunning and gives the space a very distinct vibe.

The bar experience was decent. Tried a couple of mocktails, Guava Chilli rated 3/5 and Mango Madness rated 4/5. Did not try the beer but since it is brewed in house, heard good things about it.

The non veg buffet was the highlight of the evening. Fish Kolivada and Golden Fried Prawns were absolute standouts. Even the Paneer Chilli was surprisingly good. In the main course, the Neer Dosa paired with chicken curry was easily the best combination.

They also have a smoking zone on the same floor which is convenient and valet parking is available. The only letdown was the DJ, the music did not quite match the energy of the place.

Overall, a great venue for large gatherings, especially if you are going for the ambience and food.

Great food, amazing ambience, and the beer was super smooth. The staff even suggested a hot toddy since I wasn’t feeling well, which was a thoughtful gesture. Felt much better and had a great time. Will definitely be back!

We reached the venue at 7:45 pm on a Friday. There was sizable crowd. Lighting were too bright to my lighting, but the music was soothing and not too loud which was just perfect. But by 8:30 PM, they increased the loudness and decreased the brightness of the lightings. Some items were very good, and some were average. Ice cream bomb in particular was very bad. Overall we left with mixed feelings.

Really good one. Good interiors, well maintained, trained staff, overall it's good. Two of us went there. Ordered 2 cocktails and three glasses of beer. Apart from the drinks, ordered greek style mutton gyros looking at the Google reviews. It was okay but too many bone pieces and too less stuff to eat. Crispy Chicken curlies had 4 pieces but they were very tasty. The ordered green chilly garlic prawns. Tasty was ok. Only 5 small pieces were there. Not worth for the cost. Finally, we finished with a prawns and egg truffle fried rice. It was tasty.

name: Quarter Peter Indiranagar
review_texts: Budget friendly, pocket friendly and great staff. Food is served in small plates which helps us taste all their dishes and explore different cuisines. Also the menu isn’t confusing with too many items on their menu. Best for friends and family.

The drink and food was totally amazing but I felt the menu or the options were quite limited, probably because we visited for lunch but still it was a Sunday lunch. It was worth the money, slightly quieter ambiance for early birds. Do check out and explore

The quality and taste of the dishes are satisfying, however the portion sizes are quite small for the price. Service is slow, with noticeable delays in getting orders, which can be frustrating. There’s also a long waiting line to get in, especially during peak hours, so be prepared to wait. Worth visiting once for the food, but patience is definitely required.

Loved the food, ambience and service ❣️
Would definitely recommend it to my friends and family

Visited Quarter Peter Indiranagar last weekend. It’s a cozy, dimly lit resto-bar with a dark theme that gives it a nice vibe. On weekends, the place gets quite crowded, so it’s definitely better to pre-book your table.
As the name suggests, you can order food in quarter, half, or full portions, which is a great concept if you want to try multiple dishes.
Coming to the food—overall, it was average mainly because some items weren’t served hot. I tried Peter’s Choice Chicken, OMG Chicken, Chicken Saaru (Curry), Cheta’s Parota (Kerala Parota), and Green Salad. The curry and parota stood out and tasted good, while the other dishes were just okay.
I didn’t try any drinks, but the pricing looked quite affordable. Food prices are reasonable as well.
Overall, it’s a good place to hang out and have a decent time, especially with friends.

name: CHIN LUNG BREWERY INDIRANAGAR
review_texts:
Chin Lung is one of the best places to dine, whether it’s with friends or family. The atmosphere is always great, and the Indiranagar outlet stands out, with a massive tree growing right through the bar and spreading across the brewery, making the place feel truly alive.

The food was really good overall. I especially liked the dip served with the peri peri French fries, it was a highlight for me. However, I was a bit disappointed with the Oreo milkshake; it could have been better.

Overall, a fantastic spot for ambience and good food, with just a few minor misses.

Lovely place and great ambience, went on a Friday night, totally packed and noisy. Thankfully we reached a little early and got tables. Food was really tasty and beer was good too, except for the Mango ale. Honey chilli chicken on the spicer side, butter garlic prawns was subtle and juicy. You should try the crackling spinach chicken that was nice too. Best part very reasonably priced unlike other breweries and great part is they play English music of all genres.

Visited Chin Lung Brewery Indiranagar recently and the place definitely stands out for its energetic nightlife vibe and buzzing crowd. The ambience is lively, especially during weekends, with good music, multiple seating areas, and a proper Bangalore brewery atmosphere. Their craft beers are decent, especially for casual hangouts with friends, and the food menu has some good bar-style options like tandoori items, nachos, and starters. The staff was polite overall, though service can get slightly slow when the place becomes fully packed.

What I liked most was the vibe — it feels like one of those places where people come to chill for hours, watch matches, enjoy loud music, and have a fun evening. The interiors and lighting add to the experience, making it a good option for group outings and weekend plans.

However, the place gets extremely crowded during peak hours, and waiting time for tables can become frustrating. Parking is also limited, so valet becomes the only practical option. Some dishes were excellent while a few felt average, so the food experience can be slightly inconsistent depending on what you order.

Overall, Chin Lung Brewery is worth visiting if you’re looking for a lively brewery experience in Indiranagar with good ambience, crowd, and casual party vibes. Best enjoyed with friends during evenings, especially if you like loud music and a happening atmosphere.

We recently visited Chin Lung for my birthday and honestly, it was a great experience overall. The ambience is warm and well-designed, and the music adds a vibrant energy without being overpowering exactly what you want for a relaxed yet lively outing.
Coming to the food and drinks we tried chicken popcorn nachos, prawn 65, shots, kombucha, guava-flavoured beer, and cheesecake, and everything was well-presented and flavourful. The prawn 65 stood out, and the guava beer was refreshing and different from the usual options.
The service was attentive and smooth, making the experience even better. Overall, Chin Lung is a solid place for good food, good drinks, and a great vibe. Definitely worth visiting if you’re looking for a place with good ambience and an energetic atmosphere.

🍕🍣Visited on a Saturday around 3ish when the place was almost empty, so expected service to be a little more attentive… but sadly, not really. Had to follow up just to get the table cleaned, and even basic things like cutlery weren’t kept properly. Also, we’re a couple and our sushi arrived with just one pair of chopsticks 😭

Coming to the food, the sushi was honestly very bleh, felt more like something put together in the name of sushi rather than actual good sushi. The margarita chicken pizza was okay-ish, nothing memorable, and the menu felt quite limited too. Would’ve loved more topping options like prawns or bacon instead of the usual basics.

Now the good part,the ambience is beautiful. There’s greenery all around and the huge tree inside the brewery genuinely adds to the vibe, making the place feel aesthetic and calming.

Overall: pretty place, average food, service definitely needs improvement. Has potential, but can do much better.

name: Vesparo
review_texts:
Decided to check out this place after seeing it all over Instagram. It was spacious and we loved the outdoor seating. They also had a rooftop area and galactic bar. Our favourite dish was the flying noodles which had crispy noodles with sweet, tangy and spicy sauce. The mango sticky rice was really delicious and the Japanese tacos were unique. Overall had a wonderful time at Vesparo

Great for families or large groups

They have 2 floors .one is good for night.but in day time also you can enjoy there. Its very quite.  3rd floor they have outdoor and indoor. In this sunny summer you can't sit outdoor in day time.  It's very hot. Indoor is small area . I went for Sunday lunch. 1st didn't get the sear in 3rd floor so Veronica helped us . She's very nice hostess. Very polite and helpful.
Kelly too. Very gentle.
Sunday it was very chaotic. High volume of music and banter of people made the place more chaotic.
Food menu is very limited.
Found cocktails are bit in high price. Mocktails also very limited. Food was very tasty. But dumplings was hard.
We have ordered black paper pork.it was very delicious. Then we repeat the same. Unfortunately we couldn't get the same thing. Even we tried to explain they also take it back and presented but it was not the same. Which  was very disappointing.
Waitstaff's are very polite but not efficient.
Overall it was  good.

Vesparo impressed me with its stunning dimly lit ambience and thoughtfully curated new cocktail menu.

Inspired by a journey across Asia, each cocktail captures the flavors and drinking culture of a different destination while paying tribute to Asia’s 50 Best Bars. If you love creative cocktails with a story behind them, this place is definitely worth visiting.

I tried the Oh My Jasmine, inspired by Singapore, and it was easily my favorite. The floral notes of jasmine paired beautifully with matcha and whisky, creating a smooth yet bold cocktail.

I also loved the Sabai Sabai, inspired by Thailand. The refreshing blend of spiced rum, sugarcane, makrut lime, lavender, and lemongrass made it light, citrusy, and incredibly easy to sip.

I came in for one drink but ended up staying for more. Paired with the succulent Paneer Ghee Roast and flavorful Drunken Chicken, it was the perfect way to end a weekday evening.

Vesaparo feels like a place designed for a slightly upscale night out. The terrace seating looks fantastic and I can imagine the vibe really coming alive in the evening; for lunch though, the Bengaluru sun was definitely winning. They also have a nightclub section called Pulse for those looking to extend the night.

For some reason, we landed up here for lunch and weren't disappointed. The Avakai Mutton Pulao and Coorgi Chilly Pork were both solid flavourful, well-portioned, and comfortably enough for two people. The staff were warm and attentive, which always adds to the experience. With the Zomato discount, the bill felt surprisingly reasonable for the ambience and overall experience. Would definitely come back, preferably for a weekend night out.

We went to this place for dinner. The vibe was nice. The ambience is good. Service was also nice.
The food was okayish.
The cocktails were below average.
The tres leches was really nice.

We had ordered vegetable dumplings which seemed stale and sticky and we informed about the same, our waiter Charan replaced it.

name: Amicii Bar & Kitchen
review_texts:
Had a wonderful experience at Amicii. The ambience is stylish and vibrant, with a perfect balance of energy and comfort. The rooftop setting adds to the charm and makes it a great spot for a casual outing, date night, or celebration.

The food was excellent—beautifully presented, flavorful, and made with quality ingredients. The drinks were equally enjoyable and complemented the meal well. Service was prompt, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit.

What truly makes Amicii stand out is the overall experience. From the atmosphere to the food and hospitality, everything comes together seamlessly. Definitely a place worth visiting, and I look forward to coming back soon.

Amicii was honestly such an incredible experience, right in the heart of Indiranagar. From the moment we walked in, everything about the place felt so warm, vibrant, and special. Their sushi was genuinely some of the best I’ve ever had — fresh, flavorful, and absolutely unforgettable.
The Thai red sauce rice with chicken was equally amazing for the main course, packed with flavor and easily one of those dishes you keep thinking about later. Their cocktails were super refreshing and perfectly complemented the entire meal, making the whole experience feel even more elevated.
And dessert? Their tiramisu was the perfect ending — rich, indulgent, and so satisfying.
Honestly, Amicii turned an ordinary Sunday into something so much better. If you’re looking for a place with amazing food, great drinks, and an atmosphere that feels both lively and memorable, this spot is an absolute must-visit in Bangalore.

The ambience is definitely the highlight of the place. The interiors are beautiful, and the overall vibe makes it a good spot for a casual outing.

However, the food was average. The Chicken Gyoza was good (4/5), but the Spicy Tempura Sushi was disappointing and didn’t taste great (3/5). The Chicken Steak with Herb Rice was just okay (3/5) and nothing memorable.

What was more disappointing was the service. Despite adding a mandatory 10% service charge to the bill, the service was not up to the mark and certainly didn’t justify the extra charge. If you’re charging customers for service, the experience should reflect it.

Overall, it’s worth a one-time visit for the ambience, but not a place I would recommend for the food or service.

Do I drink(alcohol ofcourse)...?
No...
Do I stop visiting bars and breweries...?
Not yet all... :-P

Visited this cocktail bar for one of our weekend lunches. After reaching there we realized it's more than a cocktail bar which offers delicious food along with the drinks.
The ambience is very soothing with minimal interiors and dim lighting (perfect for dates). The restaurant/bar appears to be huge with multiple floors, indoor/outdoor seating arrangements but we couldn't explore since we decided to sit on the first floor.
We were attended by Mr.Abhishek, who was very kind and helped us to figure out the menu and took our order.

A Spinach soup and Paneer tortellini, Asparagus cream cheese Uramiki from sushi bar, A caesar salad along with Tom yum flavoured french fries.
We ordered 2 drinks from the summer special menu(I don't remember the names),but one with mango flavour and another one with pineapple.

The Caesar salad was delicious, the vegetables were fresh and crunchy, The dressing had a perfect consistency and the bread did really complimented the salad, french fries were perfectly fried, good length and nicely spiced.( I can talk only about Caesar Salad and french fries because that's the only thing which I ate)
My friends looked and happy and they appeared to be enjoying their food, Guess the rest of the food was nice too.

The place was really clean and neat, the washroom was well maintained but they can improve the lighting in the washroom for better mirror selfies.

I also noticed that they had this 3 dots symbol on almost everything, we got to know that it featured 3 dots and dash and it's currently in the same place of 3 dots and dash.

Had a great time visiting here.

Love the aesthetic of the place. The food menu had everything from Indian to global cuisine, we tried the Crispy Lotus Stem, Fish and chips & my fav Tiramisu⭐️✨

The place is pinterest coded with disco balls 🪩 around and soft sunlight!

Loved the experience!

name: Pecos Stones 2.0
review_texts:
I really loved this place. It’s located right on Indiranagar’s 100 Feet Road, making it very easy to find and highly accessible. As expected, it’s a great hangout spot for rock music lovers.

The atmosphere was lively, with people enjoying the IPL matches, and the staff were extremely humble and welcoming. They even served complimentary peanuts, which was a nice touch. I especially loved the chicken nachos.

My only suggestion would be for Pecos to refresh its rock music playlist across its Bengaluru outlets. I feel they’re missing out on many legendary rock bands from the ’80s and ’90s. A more diverse and updated selection would make the experience even better for rock music fans. 🤘🎸

This has been my constant 'goto' place for a decade. It's one of the places I miss ever since I left bangalore.I try to come and visit the stuffs whenever I make it to bangalore. In one word it's incredible.

Pecos is a must try place in Bangalore. It has a nice old school vibe with classic pop music and a great atmosphere.
Good food, great beers, and overall a chill place to hang out. This is my go to spot with friends and definitely one of my favorites.

Visited here with a group of friends. Liked the old classic rock give of the place and continuous classic rock playlist that complements the beer and food. We ordered Egg curry with Neer dosa and was delicious. Staff is humble and service is good.

It is an old establishment. The moment I enetered I felt that I have travelled back in time. The food is nice and the beer options are decent.
I am definitely returning for another round. They also have a card system where your 11th round is free. There are two cards. Pitcher and mug card and each card will fetch you the respective thing.

name: Jamming Goat 3.0
review_texts:
A versatile and lavishly designed pub, beautifully laid out with strong visual appeal. From the moment I walked in, the concierge experience was smooth and welcoming, setting the tone for the visit.
I was guided straight to a bar top table, where Koina took charge behind the bar. She asked for my preferences and delivered an excellent Old Fashioned cocktail made with whiskey. I also had a Jameson, both of which were well executed. Koina deserves special mention.. confident, attentive, and genuinely engaging. A great presence behind the bar.
The only miss was the boiled peanuts, which were not boiled enough. They were firm rather than soft and soggy, making them difficult to bite and enjoy.
For smokers, the designated area is outside or on the terrace, which is clearly defined and well managed.
A standout moment was being handed Spotify control, being able to play classic rock tracks of my choice added a very personal and memorable touch to the experience.
Overall, a vibrant place with excellent service at the bar and a strong ambience. With minor improvements on food consistency, it delivers a premium pub experience.

This restaurant is really great. When you order something, they deliver the food very quickly, and they decorate it so beautifully. Their DJ is also fantastic, perfect for corporate parties. They have seating both on the ground floor and the first floor. And the best part is, they have their own lift, so you can easily come and go if you have any errands. Overall, the food quality, drinks, and staff are all amazing!

This place is absolutely beautiful and leaves an impression right from the moment you walk in. The space is absolutely stunning — lush natural greenery, warm aesthetics, and such a beautifully put-together vibe. Every corner feels thoughtfully designed and effortlessly cool, making it a space you instantly feel drawn to.

The food and drinks complement the ambience perfectly. The dimsums are delicious, the starters are flavourful, and the mocktails are refreshing and well crafted. Everything feels balanced and thoughtfully done.

One of those places that makes you want to sit longer, talk more, and come back again. Came curious, left impressed — truly a must-visit. Easily a new favourite in Indiranagar ♥️♥️

Went here for lunch and the mutton jhol dumplings and Blue pea and Truffle cream cheese dumplings were the highlight and absolutely delicious. The mocktails were also good with a decent options. The pizza and other dishes, though, were fairly average

Had a great experience at Jamming Goat.

We ordered three items for ₹1544, and everything was worth it — good quantity, great quality, and very satisfying overall. The food was delicious and well-prepared.

A special mention to Aying, who served us. She was warm, professional, and attentive, and made sure we had a comfortable and pleasant experience throughout.

The ambience was lively and welcoming, which added to the overall vibe of the place.

Definitely a place I’d visit again.

name: Doff Estd. 2011
review_texts:
Doff Pub is a proper old-school sports pub.

Dropped by for the Chelsea vs Liverpool screening and stayed back for the United game because honestly, this place is built for football lovers.

The beer is preety cheap, a pitcher for around a 1000 bucks. We ended up ordering 4 between 3 of us, helped massively by the cool Bangalore rains, the open seating, and the windy atmosphere.

They have good options in food including and mostly bar bites along with some regional delicacies. We had the Coorgi pork which was lipsmacking — smoky, flavourful, and reason enough to come back again. We also had the crispy chilli mushrooms and green salad.

If you’re someone who believes football is a personality trait, Doff is your kind of place.

It is a sports bar with very good varieties of veg and non veg along with variant of both toits beer and common bottled beers.
Their coorg pork was very good.

I went to watch villa vs utd match. Once the match was about to start, fans came in. Then it was fun to watch with all of them.

Would suggest reserving seat before going

This place is a legendary hang-out spot! For nearly four years, it's been my go-to for fantastic food and stellar service. The sports bar vibe is on point with screens galore, and the foosball is a total goal!

I took my boyfriend out to watch football, and I hit the jackpot with this sports pub! The vibe was electric, and the crowd was passionate about the game. He absolutely loved it. The food was great too – we enjoyed the pork sausage dish, which was a new try for us, and the chicken pizza was delicious. The chicken tikka was little spicy and drinks were okay but we'll overlook that for the love of the game. We're definitely coming back, especially for football!"

Last week, I decided to spend some quality time with myself. I went to Doff Estd. 2011 with a simple plan—to enjoy a beer, sit quietly, and read a good book.
Unfortunately, the experience did not start well. At the entrance, the security guard questioned me in a manner that felt unnecessarily harsh. He repeatedly asked how long I would stay, why I had come, whether I was planning to eat or drink, and seemed quite aggressive in his approach. The interaction left me uncomfortable and created a negative first impression of the place.

Despite that, I chose not to let the experience ruin my evening. Once inside, I found my own corner, ordered a beer, and immersed myself in my book. The atmosphere eventually allowed me to relax and enjoy the solitude I had been seeking. In the end, the day reminded me that while we cannot always control how others treat us, we can choose not to let those moments take away from our peace. What began as an unpleasant experience eventually turned into a meaningful and enjoyable time with myself.

name: Sly Granny, Indiranagar
review_texts:
We had a good time overall when we went here. The service was really good. Food wise, most items were good but some were not to be honest. I had tomato soup and it tasted like plain tomato puree. The options on the menu are less and the quantity too was less.

The ambiance is nice and is a good place to have a good time with family or friends.

A cafe/bar in indiranagar with a quirky vintage decor. They also have a breezy rooftop with great vibes. It is bit expensive but it’s definitely worth it. I was here for their Sunday brunch which is a special chefs tasting menu. They have really well crafted cocktails which are too good. The tasting menu has a wide selection of food from different cuisines. Everything is served in small portions to get a chance to try multiple dishes. The food quality is top notch and delectable.
The desserts deserve a special mention from my end. They are absolutely delicious and bite sized so you get to taste everything.
Loved the hospitality, vibes and had a great time here.

Nice place with good ambience. Has a separate area for family dining . The dancing area is a bit shady . But a good place altogether with good food . We tried  tamarind chicken, chicken fries, and chicken pizza. You would experience some different taste other than the traditional taste of the item on the menu.

The highlight of my entire experience was the food here. We started out with their gnocchi(it was a home run) and a couple of drinks. Followed by crispy chicken n fries(goes so well with a 🍺) and grilled fish which were equally good. The place is spread across two floors, we opted for the rooftop for the cool breeze and good ambience. The service is prompt and the staff is courteous. Already looking forward to the next visit.

Amazing place . Have delicious food. The balcony sitting area on not so hot days are very pretty and the indoor sitting area is also very beautiful. But the most important thing was the food was exceptionally good. We had a great brunch experience . We took the unlimited buffet package and could take as many number of refills .

name: The Fatty Bao
review_texts:
Extremely meh at best, not for someone who is trying to find a flavourful ramen. The broth was extremely mid, I had much better even in vegetable options.

Bao was extremely soft but filling was just like any other restaurant. Although decent quantity for price but pretty lame taste.

We went to Fatty Bao with our family and had so much fun. Service is quite good, ambience is amazing. Their taste is just perfect for a family gathering, right blend of pan-asian with Indian taste. Totally recommend this place. The only con - service is a little slower (expect 20-30 mins) and portion size is little mismatched (like rice to curry ratio).

Went to this place for dinner.
Ordered prawn bao, Edamame Dimsum and Raw mango fried rice.

The food was kind of okayish although I expected it to be better. The bao hardly had any filling, it felt like I am just having maida.
Edamame Dimsum was okay but not that great. And the Raw mango Fried rice felt like lemon rice instead of the real feel of raw mango.

Went to this place for the rating but disappointed a bit.

Extremely disappointing experience at The Fatty Bao.

Arrived at 12:15 PM and still waited almost an hour for our order, while others who came later were served first. Our server, Hriday, admitted it was his fault but disappeared without any update or resolution.

This reflects very poor service standards and lack of basic accountability. Food quality does not make up for this kind of experience.

Nice place, the place is small with kinda uncomfortable seats but the food was good. Tired baos, an appetiser and the ramen. One of the best baos I have tried, mind-top rated ramen. The place is a bit rusty and felt the food was a bit overpriced but it certainly didn’t disappoint! Some make shifts in the restaurant atmosphere will maybe elevate the dining experience for the price!

name: Elvnthrtyone
review_texts: Beautiful place, we visited it in later evening and the place looked beautiful... We heard about this 21-inch long pizza and wanted to test it, or was definitely worth all the effort... Also their white sauce pasta is absolutely amazing! Great, courteous  and very friendly staff too

Excellent food options, crafted beer, friendly and prompt staff, this place is a must visit if you like open areas and wide spaces. Good place for brunch or dinner. They have multiple floors so lot of sitting area. Also, they have these walls with graffiti on it so you can click a lot of photos.
This place is great for lunches and even for an evening hang. The food is reasonably priced and great. The ambience is pretty and the service is excellent.

Excellent ambience and courteous servicing. The food was amazing and the Honey chilli potato is a must try. Located in the ever hustling Indiranagar 100 feet road. It is definitely worth a shot in the evening with some drinks.

Loved the ambience and the food! Three floors setup is great with inhouse music jockey. Requests were taken and played as well.  Staff was okay and they were open to the feedback. Best thing was that they suggested based on the availability of the menu items. Overall a good weekend party place with a group!

name: Daysie (MG Road) : All Day Casual Bar
review_texts:
Place is very cosy, also I can say its very small.
Was seated in 1st floor. Had been through company party. Not sure about the prices but food was not up to the mark. Any packages should include Biryani and this place did not provide, non veg starters were not that great and pizza too.
I wouldn't recommend this place for corporate party.
Good dishes were Naan and chicken gravy was excellent and desserts were good too.
DJ was there and it was very good, he played all regional language songs as well.
They do have smoking zone in first floor as well.
Gents washroom was well maintained.
There are some good tables and chairs and high table n chairs are not comfortable if you plan on drinking well, do mention the seatings before booking.

Great place with a really nice, cozy environment that makes you feel at home the moment you walk in. The ambience is warm and inviting, with just the right lighting and seating that works well for both small groups and larger gatherings. The staff were attentive without being intrusive, making sure we had everything we needed throughout the evening.

Tried a guava mocktail (not sure about the exact name), chicken tikka, prawn fingers, pizza, corn fries, pork fry, and more. Everything tasted good. The ambience is nice, making it a perfect place for a team outing or dinner.

Good ambience but the food doesn’t live up to the expectations and their pricing. Very overpriced food for their portions and quality.  Considering it’s gourmet, we got a chipped plate and the dessert was overly artificially flavoured and coloured and unpalatable. Very unhappy with the experience. Wouldn’t recommend.

I recently visited DAYSIE during their Weekends in Thailand experience, where they showcase global flavours region by region and it’s so much more than just Thai green curry. I tried dishes I’d never had before, and I was super excited with every plate that arrived.

We began with their amazing drinks, which set the tone for the meal. The grilled cottage cheese was smoky, tender and packed with flavour. The Thai lemongrass chicken was fresh, aromatic and perfectly balanced. The Bangkok street BBQ jumbo prawns were juicy and beautifully charred, while the jungle basil stir fry brought bold, herbaceous flavours that really stood out. The Khao Man Gai Reloaded was comforting yet refined, showing off so much technique in a familiar dish.

We ended with the Sago Ma-Muang — lush mango and silky sago that made for the perfect cooling finish after such a flavour-packed experience.

name: Tycoons
review_texts:
I recently visited Tycoons in Indiranagar for dinner and had an overall pleasant experience. From the moment we arrived, the hospitality stood out — the service was prompt and the staff were exceptionally courteous. What really added a personal touch was the involvement of the owner himself, who checked in on us both while we were being seated and again during dessert to ensure we were comfortable and enjoying our meal. That level of attention is always appreciated and reflects a strong focus on customer satisfaction.

We began our meal with veg dumplings, which were absolutely delicious — perfectly steamed, well-seasoned, and packed with flavor. I also ordered a Diet Coke and a tofu-based starter, which was equally satisfying with a nice balance of spices and textures. For the main course, I tried their pizza, which was well-made with a crisp crust and generous toppings. The Pad Thai, however, was just average — lacking a bit of the authentic tangy-sweet balance I was expecting. We wrapped up the meal with Baked Alaska for dessert, which was decent, though not particularly memorable.

While the food and service were impressive, I do feel that the ambience could use a little upgrade. The interiors were functional but didn’t quite match the warmth and attentiveness of the staff. With a bit of improvement in the overall setting, Tycoons has great potential to be a favorite go-to in Indiranagar. I’d definitely consider going back, especially for the hospitality and some of those tasty appetizers.

Easily a place one can miss with so many places of similar setup on 12th main. This is an old place for sure but some good setup of regular customers. The owner uncle comes in the evening and chat with customers. Food mostly continental. Offered us heineken silver which was flat. We ordered KF premium. Seating spread out with no AC and only fans. The furniture requires maintenance and roof some repairs. The music was medium but you have to avoid the zone facing the speakers. Prices are reasonable for the location.

The service was good but then they dropped food while placing bruchetta on the table.
It is not an upscale.place..it is just okay. Taste and quantity of the food is good.

It has the old world charm and is one of the oldest bars around. The owner makes you feel elevated by visiting and interacting with each of the clients. Worth visiting and one of the most important places to visit, if one wants to have a feel of old Bangalore

Good mood and delicious steak!
It's a perfect place in Bangalore

name: La Gioia - Italian Bar and Restaurant | Pizzeria
review_texts:
We had a wonderful dining experience at this Italian restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious and very authentic — especially the seafood and pasta, everything was fresh and perfectly cooked.

A special thank you to Lal for the excellent service. He was attentive, friendly, and made sure we felt comfortable throughout the meal. His recommendations were great and really improved our experience.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for genuine Italian food and warm hospitality. We will definitely come back again! 😊🍝

Visited La Gioia in Indiranagar recently and absolutely loved the experience. The place is beautifully designed and spread across two floors with elegant French–Italian style architecture that gives it a very charming and classy vibe.

We started with the sun-dried tomato garlic bread and eggplant bruschetta, and both were flavourful and nicely done. For mains, we tried the spicy veg pizza — and it was definitely super spicy, just the way the name promises, so spice lovers will enjoy it.

The mocktails were refreshing — we tried a cranberry juice–based one and a creamy mango-flavoured drink, both were well balanced and enjoyable.

We ended the meal with tiramisu, which was absolutely perfect and a great way to finish the meal.

A special mention to Tenau, who provided excellent service. He was very friendly, suggested good mocktail options, and even checked with us beforehand about spice levels and whether we were comfortable with egg and alcohol in the tiramisu — a very thoughtful touch.

Overall, a beautiful place with great food, attentive service, and a relaxed dining experience. Definitely worth visiting in Indiranagar.

I went here this weekend with friends and decided to try this 'fine dining' restaurant. There were so many things wrong with this place, when they call themselves italian restaurant.
Things that didn't make sense:
1. While ordering, they didn't have some basic italian dishes on menu and said that, because its fine dine, we dont serve it here.
2. The inside seating menu is so limited and the outside seating doesnt have space to accomodate even 7 people
3. Half of the things in the bar menu are not available, from cocktails to mocktails. Out of the 10 pager menu thry hardly had 4-5 things i guess-- ON A WEEKEND
4. They took order for a drink and when they didnt bring it for 20 mins, we asked about it and thats when we get to know that its not available
5. The bruschetta bread was not even toasted
6. The pizza was siggy by the time it reached the table
7. They're serving main course even before the starters
8. It took 15mins and 2 reminders to get a glass of water

I'm honestly very disappointed to have spent even a single dime on this place.

Best ambience food was tasty specially the grover champagne , raviolli pista and tuna fish were good and nepolitano pizza is the best.
Thank you roman for being a good host for us.
And at last on the house sweet dish was cherry on top

I had reserved a table for lunch with a friend, hoping to enjoy good food and a pleasant afternoon. We started with a couple of drinks, and since my friend wanted hers sweeter, we requested an adjustment. That part was handled well.

Next, we ordered a starter after reading the description of Tartar di Tonno:
“A refined tuna tartare, infused with the subtle heat of ginger, accompanied by a vibrant passion fruit coulis and a velvety cheese cream (fish).”

We had no idea what the dish was supposed to look like, but when it arrived, we were completely shocked. The plate had chopped, cold pieces of tuna that looked nothing like what was described—it genuinely resembled cat food. We couldn’t even bring ourselves to take a bite.

We immediately asked if they could take the dish back. Instead of cancelling it, the staff told us they would “toss and cook it,” but even then, the dish was neither refunded nor replaced. The waiter never warned us that it was a raw-fish preparation, and the menu description did not make this clear either. For a dish priced at ₹900, this was extremely disappointing.

What made it worse was that instead of preparing something new, they simply baked the same dish and returned it. It looked exactly the same, and when we finally tasted it, it smelled unpleasant. We asked to have it packed just to end the ordeal. The entire lunch was ruined, and my friend even experienced itchiness in her mouth after tasting it.

We settled the bill and left, thoroughly disappointed. I would never return and definitely would not recommend this place to anyone. You’re better off going to Chianti, where the food is far better, reasonably priced, and the customer service is excellent.

name: Pasta Street - Indiranagar
review_texts:
Google review version:

Tried the Pizza Calabrese with feta cheese here and it’s genuinely one of the best Neapolitan pizzas I’ve had in Bangalore — the 48 hour fermented dough makes such a difference, crisp and full of flavour. Also had the ricotta stuffed ravioli in sage and gorgonzola sauce, rich and perfectly balanced. Loved that all the pasta is made fresh in-house from scratch using high grade semolina flour, you can really taste the quality. Would highly recommend for anyone who loves authentic Italian food. Will definitely be back! 5⭐

I met my friend here over a cafe date and loved everything. From lively ambience to the open kitchen where we can literally see the chef making pizza and have our little unwinding moment to the actual food being served, it’s on point. We loved the flavours, sauses used, and the way the food made us feel, we are definitely gonna go back here. Thank you pasta street for serving us right🥰🤌

Had a good experience overall. The place is nice, and the ambiance is pleasant, making it a great spot to catch up with friends. The service was a bit slow, and it took quite some time for our food to arrive.

The pastas were enjoyable, and the ravioli was absolutely amazing—definitely a must-try. However, the butter garlic prawns felt a little bland compared to what I’ve had at the JP Nagar and Vasanth Nagar branches, which seem to have more depth of flavor. A little enhancement in seasoning and flavor would make the dishes even better.

The music was also a bit too soft for my liking, and improving the music and overall atmosphere could elevate the experience further. That said, I had a wonderful time overall and would definitely recommend this place for a relaxed evening with friends.

A beautiful space in Indiranagara which has indoor and outdoor seating area and they serve some really good lip smacking Italian food and the vibe is super chill and great place to go with friends or family. Something i love apart from their dessert menu is mango tiramisu which was outstanding.

As this place have a wide spread of menu even for vegetarians, the taste for each dish is great. Pesto garlic bread, ravioli, pasta, mocktails every dish is on point. Though the service is little slow as weekend is mostly crowded however it worth to visit.

name: The Bier Library
review_texts:
Had a wonderful experience here! The ambience is fantastic, making it a perfect place to hang out with friends and family. We visited on a weekday afternoon and were able to get a table without a reservation, though I hear weekends can get quite busy.

The brewery offers a great selection of freshly brewed beers, and the beer tasting platter is a fantastic option if you want to sample multiple varieties. While I'm no beer expert, I genuinely enjoyed every beer I tried.

The food was the real highlight of the visit. The Chilli Billy Pork was incredibly tender and flavorful, with the fat practically melting in the mouth. The Pepperoni Pizza and Mixed Pork Pizza were excellent, featuring a thin crust and generous toppings. The BBQ Lamb Chops had a lovely smoky flavor, while the Butter Garlic Prawns and Honey Glazed Chicken Wings were equally delicious.

The drinks were refreshing, and the Pull Me Up Tiramisu was the perfect way to end the meal—light, creamy, and absolutely heavenly.

The presentation of every dish was impressive, and the quality matched the looks. The prices are on the higher side, but the overall experience, food quality, drinks, and ambience make it worth a visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, craft beer, and a lively atmosphere in Bangalore! 🍺🍕🍖✨

Visited The Bier Library recently and honestly, it’s such a vibe! The pond-side seating with all the lights makes it perfect for a date night or even a chill evening with friends.

The food was absolutely amazing, not a single miss, everything we tried was a solid 10/10. And the best part? Their summer cocktail menu is a must-try 🍹

Great ambience, great food, and super good energy overall. Definitely one of my favorite spots in Bangalore right now. Highly recommend!

The Bier Library is easily one of the best spots in town! The space itself is beautifully designed, spacious, and has a fantastic, open atmosphere that sets the perfect mood for a night out.
The service was incredibly fast and attentive, even with the weekend rush. But the absolute highlight of our night was after 10:30 PM, the dance floor completely comes alive with some of the best Bollywood tracks! If you love grooving to Bollywood music, this is the place to be.

It is on the slightly pricier side, but honestly, for the excellent service, amazing crowd, and unmatched vibe, it is worth every bit. Will definitely be coming back!

Visited here on a summer night for dinner, it was a clear 10/10 for ambiance and atmosphere, the crowd was great too!

The staff were very welcoming and showed us to our table, as I had a 2 year old daughter we wanted sit near the pond/pool area so she could see the fishes, but they said you have to specify the particular pool side table while making a reservation, only then we can give, so we went to a different table, later since one table was cleared they gave us the poolside table, which made it more delightful for us!

The staff/service is excellent and trying to help you in any way they can.

We got a beer and mock tail both of which were very good!

The food options were less because of the ongoing LPG shortage, even then therr were decent amount of options, we got paneer Tikka which was flavourful and good, paneer was super soft, got cheese jalapeño Kulcha which was good and masala Kulcha as well, then we got chocolate cake with ice cream, everything was good!

Overall we had a wonderful experience, kudos to the staff, it felt they were happy doing what they do rather than just being well trained!
Definitely recommend this place and will visit again!!!

Had a wonderful experience at Bier Library! The food was delicious, the ambience was amazing, and the overall vibe was perfect for family gatherings and get-togethers. The place is very spacious, making it comfortable even for larger groups.

The food was served on time without any delay, and the service was excellent throughout. The staff were courteous and attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Overall, a great place to relax, enjoy good food, and spend quality time with family and friends. Highly recommended!

name: Chianti, Indiranagar
review_texts:
Chianti is a great place if you’re looking for good Italian food and a cozy dining experience.

The highlight for us was definitely the wine. We tried the Mulled Wine and Bellini, and both were amazing. The Bellini was fruity and refreshing, while the Mulled Wine was a bit stronger but equally enjoyable.

We were served a complimentary bread basket, which was a lovely touch. Based on our preference, the staff also recommended the Mini Seafood Platter, and it turned out to be a great choice. Among the desserts, the Pannacotta was our favorite, and the Rosata, suggested by Manoj, was perfect for our taste.

A special thanks to Manoj for his warm hospitality and excellent recommendations throughout our meal.

The ambience is cozy and charming, with beautiful interiors that give a classic Italian dining feel. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely visit again.

Chianti is a great place if you’re in the mood for a cozy Italian dining experience. The ambience is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed evening.
What really stood out was the service—special mention to Mana, who was extremely helpful. All his recommendations were spot on, from food to wine. The wine, in particular, was very smooth and soothing, which added beautifully to the overall experience.
The food was genuinely impressive—each dish was tasty and well-prepared, with a good variety of Italian options. The presentation was also quite appealing.
Prices are slightly on the higher side, but honestly, it feels worth it for the quality and taste you get. Price is the reason i deducted one star.
Overall, a lovely place with great food, excellent service, and a calming vibe. Would definitely recommend!

⭐ 4.5/5

Visited Chianti in Indiranagar for lunch around 1:30 PM and had a great overall experience.

We started with a bruschetta—crispy toasted baguette topped with tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and parmesan. Simple and well done, though slightly on the crispier side. For drinks, we ordered a peach iced tea, a virgin mojito, and a virgin sangria with fresh fruit pieces—it was refreshing and nicely balanced.

For mains, the bruschetta pizza with sun-dried tomatoes was excellent—flavourful and satisfying, though a bit heavy after starters. The highlight was the ravioli di spinaci e ricotta (homemade ravioli with spinach and ricotta), served in a buttery garlic sauce with hints of tomato—rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. Best shared, as it can feel slightly heavy for one person.

We ended with tiramisu, which was light, soft, and very enjoyable—slightly on the sweeter side but well balanced.

A special mention to our server, Amarjeet, who was extremely helpful with recommendations and ensured smooth service throughout.

The total bill came to around ₹3,000 for three, which felt reasonable for the quality and experience. Overall, a very good meal—definitely a place I’d visit again and recommend.

While walking around in Indiranagar near the 100 feet road, around 8pm, you either see hipster cafes, or loud watering holes with questionable food, or the overpriced overhyped padthai and kopitam-la type of pan-asian food places that are always booked out and unavailable.

In the middle of all that is the highly reliable, cosy, and totally good value for money, Chianti. The food is really fresh & delicious. The menu is something I could actually understand and imagine unlike many of the new-age recipes that just turn out to be so different from how they read. The ambience is quiet, with just enough ambient noise that makes to alive but not crowded and loud. I loved my meal.

Dishes ordered: Minestrone Soup, Carpaccio Del Chianti (small plate NV), Sana Insalata Del Chianti (fresh, wholesome, refreshing salad with lots of green-leafy veg), Fussili Pesto. Also got a complimentary fresh bread basket. Soft, fragrant and sumptuous. 💕

We were well taken care of by Amar from the serving team. Excellent staff, warm & welcoming and well-mannered. Felt at home.

Chianti continues to be one of the best places in Bangalore for authentic Italian food, and this meal was a reminder of why it has such a loyal following.

We started with the Suppli al Pomodoro, which was perfectly crisp on the outside and packed with flavour inside, followed by the DIY Bruschetta that was fresh, vibrant, and fun to customize. We also tried the Chicken Ravioli, which was comforting, well-balanced, and beautifully executed. Another standout was the Doppio Ravioli, part of Chianti’s Monthly Pasta Special, where they showcase lesser-known handmade pasta shapes from Italy. This unique pasta parcel featured two different fillings in a single bite, making it one of the most memorable dishes of the meal.

For dessert, the Mango Crostata was light and refreshing with just the right amount of sweetness, while the classic Tiramisu was rich, creamy, and the perfect way to end the meal.

From the food to the service and ambience, Chianti continues to deliver a consistently authentic Italian dining experience that’s worth coming back for.

name: BOHO Koramangala
review_texts: BOHO Koramangala is one of the craziest and busiest party and food streets in the area. The place is maintained very well and has a lively vibe that makes it perfect for hanging out with friends. There are multiple food options available, and the quality of food is good with plenty of choices for everyone. The atmosphere is energetic, especially during evenings and weekends when the place is usually jam-packed with people enjoying food, music, and drinks. During the Holi celebrations the crowd was slightly less compared to regular days, which made it easier to explore the place comfortably. Overall, BOHO is a great spot in Koramangala to chill, eat good food, and spend a fun evening with friends.

Tried the Rollatini and Canelloni.
Both were overdosed with so much sour tomato sauce - not edible. Sadly, had to dispose them.

Update to owner response: Not giving a single further chance. This was a repeat order. You had already mentioned that next time this won't happen and the same issue happened again. You're banned!

Shame on Boho for the false acknowledgement, seems to be their modus operandi. Boohoo!

Been there last Sunday when DJ Sandy was pertming, and it was an amazing experience!

The music was top-quality, the transitions were super clean, and the energy on the dance floor was just insane.

Thanks for the invite DJ Sandy
Food and atmosphere is very good but staffs service need some improvement. And it's also need to improve their sound systems( Music is ok ok not so loude and no deep base)

great place to hang out, especially on Saturdays and Sundays. The nights are lively, full of music, energy, and happiness 😊. The ambience is vibrant, the crowd is fun, and the overall vibe makes it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy with friends. A really happening place for weekend outings.....

name: The Boozy Griffin Bangalore
review_texts:
The ambience is amazing. Dim lighting, great DJ, music, dance floor, seats around and lots of drinks, good food.
These make it a perfect reason to dance, enjoy and relax the evening.
Food menu is great too, the fried rice is yummy 😋. Peri peri items, cheese balls, biryani, noodles and salads, every item is prepared with care.
This is an ideal place for catching up with friends, mates, enjoying the night out, even celebrations can be hosted here.
Great staff and prompt service.
The biggest issue is regarding car parking. There is no place to park the car. We searched and found that car can be parked on the nearby main road.

Overall a lively place, vibrant atmosphere and a themed pub.

I wouldn’t recommend this place. The service was fine, but the overall atmosphere felt very dull. We visited on Valentine’s Day, and the music was really disappointing. We asked the DJ multiple times to change the songs and create a better vibe so we could enjoy and dance a bit, but nothing changed.

The whole place felt a bit awkward, and we even noticed people constantly staring, which made it uncomfortable. The food was okay, but the DJ and overall ambience really ruined the experience.

Overall, not a place I’d suggest for a fun night out.

What a vibe! This spot nailed the perfect evening with its killer music collection—think soulful classics and upbeat tracks that make you forget the world outside. The atmosphere is electric, cozy lighting, and just the right energy to unwind or vibe with friends.
Food? Spot on—flavor-packed bites that hit every craving, from crispy starters to hearty mains. And the service? Super attentive and friendly, making it feel personal and special.
If you’re in Bengaluru chasing that beautiful night out, this is your go-to.
Highly recommend! 🍻🎶 #PubVibes #BengaluruNights #GreatEats

Boozy Griffin Pub has a charming old-school ambience with dim lights and a lively vibe, perfect for hanging out even if you’re not into alcohol. The music and atmosphere create a great mood to relax with friends. Food is okay with a decent variety of options to enjoy while spending time here. Overall, a cool spot to unwind and experience a classic pub feel

It’s a best place to come with friends. Best time to come here on weekends. Miss Sabitha is best to take care of your table.

Ratings 10/10;

Food you can try here;
1) Egg chilly 10/8
2) Fries 10/10
3) Chicken tikka 10/10
4) Peanut masala 10/10
5) Egg Fried Rice 10/9

Alcohol which we have taken;
1) LIIT cocktail 10/10
2) Virjin Morjio mocktail 10/9
3) Beer of buckets
4) Cosmopolitan cocktail 10/7

name: AnTeRa Kitchen and Bar - Indiranagar
review_texts:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Absolutely Amazing!
AnTeRa is a fantastic restaurant with exceptional food and service. Every dish I tried was perfectly prepared and full of authentic flavors. The ambiance is great, the staff is friendly and attentive, and the overall experience was outstanding. Whether you're looking for a special dinner or just great food, AnTeRa is the perfect choice. Highly recommended!
The biryani was outstanding – aromatic, rich, and cooked to perfection with tender meat that melted in the mouth.

I recently visited AnTeRa Kitchen and Bar in Indiranagar, and it turned out to be an absolutely delightful experience. From the moment we walked in, the ambience struck me as breathtaking and mesmerising. The space beautifully combines a simple Indian aesthetic with subtle Western design elements, creating a warm yet classy atmosphere that makes you want to linger.

What truly stood out, however, was the food. The menu reflects a thoughtful blend of North Indian authenticity with a refined touch of South Indian culinary style. Each dish felt carefully crafted, maintaining traditional flavours while elevating them with a contemporary presentation. The balance between richness and subtlety was impressive.

A special mention must go to the Paneer Chatpata—it was bursting with flavour, perfectly spiced, and incredibly satisfying. The Kaju Chicken was equally remarkable, rich, crispy and absolutely delicious. Both dishes are a must-try for anyone visiting.

The service added significantly to the overall experience. The staff were extremely attentive and courteous, constantly checking in on us and ensuring that we were comfortable. What I particularly appreciated was their proactive approach—they made sure we didn’t have to serve ourselves, which added a touch of luxury to the meal.

Overall, AnTeRa Kitchen and Bar offers not just great food, but a complete dining experience. With its stunning ambience, thoughtfully curated menu, and exceptional service, it is definitely a place I would recommend and revisit.

A Royal South Indian Escape with a Chinese Twist!
I recently dropped by this popular spot during a visit to Indiranagar. Though it's a massive three-story resto-bar known for dinner, I stopped in for lunch, and wow—the ambiance immediately transports you straight to a remote, charming village in Andhra Pradesh or Telangana. The decor is steeped in rich Indian heritage; honestly, walking up the staircase made me feel like I was checking into a king’s palace!
The place is top-notch when it comes to hygiene, which is always a massive plus. While they have an extensive Indian menu, I veered off-road and ordered Chinese—the noodles and chicken drumsticks were absolutely on point. The staff were incredibly friendly and took the time to guide me through the menu. My only regret? I didn't have enough stomach space left for their famous biryani. I'll just have to call that "unfinished business" for my next visit.

Bonus: Valet parking is available, so zero parking headaches in busy Indiranagar. Highly recommended!

The atmosphere here is absolutely amazing, and the staff are incredibly friendly and attentive — always ready to help with a smile. You can truly feel their passion and professionalism in every interaction.

I tried both the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes, and I must say, the vegetarian options really stood out — rich in flavor and perfectly balanced. This place is definitely a must-visit restaurant in Bangalore!

Whether you’re with family, friends, or your partner, AnTeRa is the perfect spot to refresh your palate and indulge in some truly mouthwatering dishes.

What I ordered:
🍽️ Veg: Thotakura Liver Fry (starter), Pachimirchi Kodi Pulav (main)
🍗 Non-Veg: Coriander Chicken (starter), Guntur Mutton Bilal Biryani (main)
🍮 Dessert: Jamun Ka Ghasla

Every bite was flavorful and satisfying — AnTeRa delivers a dining experience that’s both soulful and memorable. Highly recommended!

This place is a gem for anyone craving authentic Andhra and Telangana Rayalaseema cuisine! The ambiance is lovely, and the service is impressively quick. They've got a fantastic spread, from delicious cocktails and appetizers to generous portions that are totally worth the price. The biryani is on the spicier side, but if you're a fan of a good kick, you'll absolutely love it!

name: Brik Oven - Woodfired Style Pizzas (Indiranagar)
review_texts:
First time visiting at this Branch - 20240418. Tried three different Pizza in the small size - Margherita, Four Cheese, and Massive Vibe. All equally good.

The service by Saraswati was excellent- in stead of checking mobile phone (which most of the waiters do), she was attentive. Asked if I had ordered, cleaned the table on time, and didn’t hackle for my contact number. Planning to visit again.

The wood-fired base was perfect. Just improving the cheese will make it best pizza place around (Si Nonna’s have an edge here).

We ordered:
1. The Anna: vegetarian recommended option by the staff. Tangy tomotao with hint of roasted chilly(not spicy) 3/5
2. Mushroom and chicken: Non veg options as per reviews.. 4.5/5
3. Caesar salad: A filling portion of classic Caesar salad 3/5
4. Tiramisu: sumptuous portion and good flavour 4/5

Woodfired pizza has essentially a softer crust compared to pan fried Pizza. If you are into crispy crusts you probably won't like the place. However, if you appreciate soft crusts then this hits right at home

Brik Oven is one of the best cafe discovery in a while. True cafe like ambiance, perfect coffee, affogato, amazing pizza, and the freshest burrata I’ve had.
Bonus: they gave us complimentary tiramisu on our first visit. Super warm staff.

Went in the morning so I was able to try their breakfast menu. Smoked Salmon Bagel Sandwich was fresh and really delicious. Classic Cold Brew and Nutella Hot Chocolate were nice. The service and the ambience are good.

This place has a huge variety of pizzas, which is great if you like options. However, what disappointed us a little was that toppings weren’t generous, the pizza wasn’t cheesy enough.

That said, the pizza base itself was actually good. The Tabasco sauce definitely helped elevate the flavor.

We ordered the Seafood Pizza, the OG Pepperoni Pizza, and Jalapeño Garlic Bread.
The garlic bread was actually really good — nicely spiced and flavorful.

The best item of the night was the tiramisu. The mascarpone topping was beautiful and perfectly balanced, making it the highlight of the meal.

Maybe we just ended up picking the wrong items because almost everyone around us seemed to be ordering pasta. So next time, we’d probably try their pasta instead.

name: Taiki
review_texts:
The food was below average. We were very disappointed. We had ordered edamame dumpling, bul dak (chicken small plate), and chicken yaki soba. Everything tasted bland. Even the bul dak starter was far from spicy. The yaki soba was way too oily and had zero flavour.
We also tried the bubble tea which was good (a bit sweet but okay). This was the only thing we liked that evening

I have been to many Asian places and I absolutely love authentic Asian food. This was terrible to the point that we did not even finish the yaki soba.

The chicken pieces in the bul dak starter seemed over cooked and had a dark purplish tinge on the inside. I’m not sure why this happens or if this is expected but the texture of chicken was not good.

I had high expectations  because of the many positive reviews and high ratings I found on Google maps for this restaurant but the experience was way below average

The service was terribly slow.

Visited this place for lunch on a weekday, and it was pleasantly uncrowded. The restaurant offers both ground-floor and upstairs seating, complemented by a charming Asian-themed ambiance. Their menu features a wide range of Japanese and Asian delicacies, along with cocktails, soju, and Japanese wines, giving it an authentic touch.

We ordered a cranberry iced tea, yaki soba, and tsukemen. The dishes were delicious, made with quality ingredients, and beautifully presented. However, the service was a bit slow.

Went for dinner, 1000₹ per person.

Overall taste of every dish could have been better. They have veg dishes as well.

Ambient music is not that great and feel weird.

Items ordered:
Tofu roll, dragon roll for starters
Chankonabe ramen, mushroom tofu for mains

We visited for a date night, and the ambience was calm and peaceful, which we really enjoyed. The food tasted good, but the portion sizes felt a bit small for the price. Also, unlike most Korean restaurants, they didn’t serve complimentary side dishes, which was a little disappointing.

Excellent sushi and appetisers.
Smoked Guava Mocktail was really nice.
Sushi was fresh and flavourful.
Space is small, we wish they expand to a larger space.
Sushi and Ramen are much much better than Yuki.

name: Shalimar Restaurant And Bar
review_texts:
Had a nice experience,
staff were helpful, polite, and attentive. The bar has a good variety of food and drink options, making it a nice place to relax and enjoy with friends or family.
The highlight for me was the neer dosa, which was outstanding. The ragi manni dessert was also excellent and definitely worth trying.
Overall, a good place with tasty food, helpful service, and a comfortable bar atmosphere. Highly recommended.
Lovely, inexpensive old bar in Indiranagar. Right next to the Metro Station. Excellent service. The beer is nice and reasonably priced. The Neer Dose + Egg Masala is classic!
