Shalimar is one of the best bars and restaurants I have visited. The food is excellent, the atmosphere is pleasant, and the staff are very cooperative and friendly. The prices are reasonable and offer great value for money.

I especially enjoyed the coastal dishes such as fish and prawns, which were fresh, delicious, and perfectly prepared. It is great to see that they use fresh ingredients without artificial colors. Overall, a wonderful dining experience, and I highly recommend Shalimar to anyone looking for tasty food and good hospitality.

Good place if you want to try mangalorean food in Indiranagar. There is alcohol present here for affordable prices but no cocktails are available. The chicken ghee roast and prawn ghee roast are very good here and also make up as good starters or sides for the booze. Service is okay but overall it's a good place to dine at.

This place is a cracker! Excellent food, fast service, fairly clean restrooms, well behaved fellow tipplers, clean premises, fair prices, and great location. One star less for just two reasons - while very efficient, the wait staff aren't particularly friendly or offer useful suggestions, so you're on your own while ordering. Next, while the depot/godown type ambience with the super high ceiling is really cool, the lack of AC or even overhead fans means open season for mosquitoes. The large Almonards stuck to the walls anyways won't be good at throwing air at your feet and are really never switched on, and that's understandable because they can make a real racket. So better wear something that covers your legs and socks for your feet. If you're a teetotaller and also a vegetarian, walk in with a couple of electric mosquito bats and bring some joy to your life.

name: Sugar Factory Reloaded
review_texts:
Had a good experience at Sugar Factory Reloaded, Bangalore. The place has an amazing vibe with vibrant candy-themed decor, stunning lighting, and a high-energy party atmosphere. The interiors are super creative and aesthetic — from the quirky wall art and candy installations to the impressive DJ setup.

One of the most visually unique nightlife spots in Bangalore, perfect for hanging out with friends, enjoying the music, and soaking in the lively ambience. The whole place is very Instagram-worthy and has a fun, energetic vibe throughout.

Definitely a great spot in Bangalore for anyone looking for good music, cool ambience, and a memorable night out. Would love to visit again!

Writing this review for Saturday night, June 6. The place was an absolute mess. They kept letting more people in with zero crowd management. The bouncers constantly pushed people back and barely gave anyone space to dance or even stand properly. You couldn’t even enjoy a drink near the bar without being shoved away every few minutes. The management was terrible and completely ruined the experience. Better to go to other alternatives instead of wasting your night here.

We visited for a friend’s birthday, but unfortunately, the experience didn't live up to expectations. The venue was massively overcrowded, making it difficult to enjoy the night. Additionally, the ambiance and crowd felt a bit off brand it lacked the standard or refined atmosphere we were looking for.better go for other pubs near by

Yesterday, on 25th December, four of us went to this club and paid ₹1000 per person for entry. Before going in, we asked if one person could just check the crowd inside, but the staff didn’t allow that. Instead, they showed us videos and music clips, saying the crowd inside was really good. Based on that, we decided to enter.
But once we were inside, everything was totally different. There was hardly any crowd, and the sound quality was very bad. Since we had already paid the entry fee, we couldn’t leave and had no choice. Honestly, it felt like we wasted our entire Christmas day here.
Then we had to struggle to get a table. After waiting for around 30–35 minutes, we finally got a table in a corner upstairs. We ordered food and beer, vodka’s but the food quality was really poor not even enjoyable.
Later, when we went to the dance floor, we were shocked to see bouncers separating boys and girls. I have never seen this kind of behaviour in any club or pub before. We are from Delhi and know how to party and behave in a crowd, but this place felt more like a school where you’re told not to talk to girls.
It honestly felt like the club thinks it runs only because of girls, which is not true. Clubs run because people pay for entry, especially stag entries.
Overall, a very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this place if you want to enjoy your weekend or celebrate a special day.

To,
The General Manager / Management Team
Sugar Factory Reloaded
93/A, Ground Floor, 4th B Cross Road,
5th Block, Koramangala,
Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560095

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding an issue I experienced during my recent visit to Sugar Factory Reloaded.

After our party had concluded and we were about to leave, we approached the counter and requested regular drinking water. The lady at the counter, who appeared to be from the North-East, informed us that regular drinking water was unavailable and that the only option was to purchase packaged bottled water.

As I understand it, food establishments are expected to provide safe drinking water to customers. If the regular drinking water supply was temporarily unavailable, it was the responsibility of the establishment to arrange a suitable alternative without requiring customers to purchase bottled water.

We genuinely enjoyed the food, ambience, and overall experience at your restaurant. However, this incident was disappointing and affected our final impression of your establishment.

I kindly request that you investigate this matter, ensure your staff are properly trained to handle such situations, and take the necessary steps to maintain the availability of complimentary safe drinking water for all customers.

I hope you will treat this feedback constructively and inform me of the corrective measures taken to prevent similar incidents in the future.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response.

name: 7 Rivers Brewing Company
review_texts:
We were quite excited to visit this place for dinner and drinks on a Tuesday evening, but our experience turned out to be a mixed one.

Pros:

1. The beers were impressive, especially the American Pale Ale and the Pilsner.

2. The staff were courteous, welcoming, and helpful throughout.

3. There is ample seating, making it suitable for groups of all sizes.

4. The place was well-maintained and clean.

Cons:

1. Service was slow; we had to wait over 30 minutes for our food.

2. The menu felt limited, with few continental or international options.

3. The food itself was average in taste.

4. While the ambience has potential, it wasn’t thoughtfully curated and felt a bit dull overall.

Had a great time at 7 Rivers Brewing Company. The ambience by the poolside, live music, and craft beers create a perfect vibe for a relaxed evening. The food was delicious, especially the starters and cocktails, and the service was warm and attentive. A great spot on MG Road for catching up with friends or enjoying a weekend dinner. Would definitely visit again!

7 Rivers is an amazing restobar.
The food here is delicious & the staff are quite polite and friendly.
The ambience is also very good.
Can see myself coming here again.
Nice ambience. Great service. The food and beer was good. The beer cocktails and the desserts can be better.

7 Rivers at Taj is my go-to place! From the moment I stepped inside, be it bag screening area or the securities, I’m greeted with respect and a warm smile. The ambience inside is beautiful, and the staff are always super friendly and polite. Even when I go alone, they make me feel so comfortable that I never actually feel alone there. The food is delicious, the drinks are fantastic, and the pool adds so much fun to the whole experience. I keep going back, not just for the place itself, but because of the wonderful staff who make it so special😊

name: Murphy's Brewhouse
review_texts:
There is a specific kind of magic found in a pub that doesn't try too hard. Murphy’s Brew is exactly that—a masterclass in understated Irish hospitality. While many establishments lean into the loud, caricatured version of Emerald Isle culture, Murphy’s opts for an authentic, grounded atmosphere that feels more like a local haunt in Cork than a tourist trap.
The prose of the evening is written in the pour. Their stout is exceptional, boasting a creamy, persistent head and a flavor profile that hits that perfect, bittersweet equilibrium. It is served with the kind of practiced precision that suggests the staff view bartending as a craft rather than a chore. Speaking of the service, it is attentive without being intrusive, a rare find definitely!

Visiting on a Saturday offers a surprisingly serene experience. Instead of the usual weekend chaos, you’ll find a mellow, conversational hum that allows the character of the wood and the warmth of the lighting to take center stage. The food serves as a reliable, comforting companion to the drink. It was decent, hearty, and honest. If you appreciate a place where the quality of the pint matches the quiet dignity of the surroundings, Murphy’s Brew is your next destination.

I visited on a weekday for a late dinner. The food was delightful 😋, and the ambiance was quite pleasant, no loud music or excessive crowd noise. However, there was a brief power outage 💡, making it hard to see our food in the dark, and some mosquitoes appeared 🦟. The service was good though! 👍

Ambience: Top notch. It is well spaced as compartments with comfortable seating. They even have terrace dining.
Food: Taste was good with variety in menu
Service: Very helpful.
Parking: Available.

What I liked was that they close around Mid night, but on request they allowed us to sit and chat till 2 am (Though the service was closed as per their timings). Thanks for this gesture.

Pretty decent place. Items are limited for the given cost. Buffet is 999+tax but for the given menu it seemed little expensive. Besides that it has a good ambience and pretty good for corporate outings.
Very nice to be there. Enjoyable paintings with a beautiful landscape.  Good service. Clean and impeccable. Piano music kept us enthralled.

name: Ironhill Bengaluru
review_texts:
Ironhill is one of those places that impresses you the moment you walk in. I dropped by on a weekday, and despite it not being the weekend rush, the place had a fantastic buzz. It's incredibly spacious, with a lively yet relaxed atmosphere that makes you want to settle in for a long evening.

I grabbed a beer, and it was spot on. A special mention to the bartender, who was kind enough to cater to my preferences and made sure I had exactly what I was looking for. It's always the little things and genuine hospitality that elevate an experience.

The Buffalo Wings were absolutely delicious...crispy, juicy, and packed with just the right amount of heat. They paired perfectly with the beer and were easily one of the highlights of the evening.

What really stood out was the overall vibe. Great music, attentive service, excellent food and drinks, and plenty of space to unwind. Whether you're catching up with friends, celebrating something special, or simply looking to relax after a long day, Ironhill ticks all the right boxes.

I'm definitely looking forward to coming back with my gang for another round. Cheers to the entire Ironhill team for making it such a memorable experience! 🍻🤘

We loved the food very much. Rapu served us very well. We liked the chilly garlic mushroom and ajwain fish. Chilly egg was also delicious. Overall We liked the place. The ambience is alo very good. Chivken CEASER SALAD was also delicious.

Came here for Lunch with Family and overall it was a wonderful experience.

This was our first time time but had heard about Iron Hill from a lot of friends so it was time to actually experience all the stories I had heard and happy to say my experience was goood too.

Let’s start with the Google Maps location, if you are coming from the Old Airport side the Google Maps might show you the way towards the backside which is the exit gate. Slightly difficult to navigate during peak hours. The main entrance is on the Marathalli main road near the Innovative Multiplex.

They have Vallet parking available so parking the car was easy and trouble free.

Since we had kids in our group the selection for seating was limited. During the weekends kids are allowed inside so the view might not be open. We actually prefer the inner space so it was good for us.

Coming to the food it was easy to order and they have the menu integrated with Swiggy Dining which was something I was seeing for the first time. The software was well integrated.

Coming to the food tried a lot of things, The Mini Burgers Non Veg and fish fingers were definitely a stand out though all the food tasted good. Normally I don’t expect brewery food to taste good but this was a surprise here.

Coming to the drinks we tried the sampler and a few mocktails and it was all good.SincityCider Beer recommended if you want to try a really sweeet beer.

Also thanks to Aryan and all the service people. They were easy to talk to and answered all our doubts and were easily visible on the floor at most times though there were a few instances I did have to search but that’s ok.

The ambiance is good and a lot of places inside to take pictures and a few games too if you want to play mostly good for the kids.

Overall it was a good experience and would recommend people to come here.

One unique think I noticed is looks like they have some tie up with Udrive which was written on the vallet slip so incase you do unplanned drinking I think you would be able to get a driver here soon to drive your car since I had seen reviews where people had told me during nights there are cops close to the entrance so be cautious about that.

One of the best breweries to be visited in and around Marathahalli. Very great ambience. Very spacious to visit with team or family or friends. Best place to hangout and they have wide variety of food options and mocktails too. The service was great and thank you Mohammad khan for the service. Great ambience, good food and well maintained facilities

I recently visited Ironhill in Marathahalli after hearing so much about it, and my first impression was the sheer size of the place—it's absolutely massive. It's an excellent venue for team outings, corporate gatherings, or meeting up with a large group of friends.

The ambiance is undoubtedly one of its biggest strengths. The lighting, spacious layout, and overall atmosphere create a premium and vibrant dining experience. We tried a variety of starters along with their craft beers, and the food was quite enjoyable overall. If you're looking for a lively spot to unwind and socialize, Ironhill certainly delivers.

That said, the place can get extremely crowded, especially during peak hours. The noise levels tend to be quite high, making it less suitable for long or intimate conversations. Weekend visitors should also be prepared for parking challenges, as finding a spot can take some extra time.

Overall, Ironhill offers a great experience for weekend outings, celebrations, and group gatherings. While it may not be the ideal choice for a quiet dinner, it's definitely worth visiting if you're in the area and enjoy a lively atmosphere and get view..

name: Three Monkeys Brewpub
review_texts:
The food was amazing and the mango cider was awesome. The manager took really good care of us. The service was super fast.
We had a good time with office colleagues.
Chicken 65, other Chicken dishes were amazing.
Even the egg chilly was delicious..
Only paneer chilly was a slight letdown maybe cos the paneer was not of good quality...otherwise no complaints

This was our regular spot for hanging out, since it’s very near to our place. The place is even more better after it’s renovation few years ago.

The ambience and vibe of the place is really great, the food is delicious and they often have the offers on beverages every day for the whole year.

The staff is friendly and place is maintained and kept really clean and hygienic. All in all it’ll be a great experience if you visit here for screening or just to chill!

Located inside a mall with convenient basement parking. There are two lifts—one goes directly to the 4th floor, while the other takes you to the 3rd floor, from where you can use the escalator. The brewery is on the 4th floor. As soon as you step in, the place feels quite spacious. The ambience is pleasant, especially the pots placed along the roof, which add a nice touch.

We were a group of 25 and they comfortably accommodated us. Even smaller groups or couples will easily find seating. They offer happy hour deals like 1+1 on drinks or a 15% discount with pre-booking.
Their most popular brew is the Mango Beer. We ordered five pitchers. Honestly, it tastes more like beer mixed with Maaza—very unique and refreshing. Loved it. They also have other craft beer options available.
The crowd felt more suited to boomers; we didn’t really notice a younger crowd. Music is played via USB, and the staff wasn’t flexible about changing it. While we were there, they played slow 90s English tracks. Even though we wanted something upbeat to dance to, the music remained unchanged, which kind of dampened the vibe.
Food was just okay. We tried most of the starters; the mushroom starter stood out and was quite popular. The restroom is located outside the restaurant and felt a bit old.
Overall, it’s a decent place to relax and spend some time.

I have been a 3 monkeys regular since the time they started, i still have their member card where you would get complimentary garlic breads lol. Right now the management has changed along with fresh interiors. The food has improved so much and we as a family really relish it. Craft beers are smooth and ok and though the mango cider is like a mango juice, but other beers are good. Chicken cream cheese pizza is a must try, kids loved it. Moroccan chicken soft and tender with fresh mint chutney.

Good place, a lot of seats and good music.
Menu is average. Most of the items are not available.

name: Toit Mahadevapura
review_texts:
We had a great time with the delicious food. It was pretty quiet as we visited on a Monday afternoon. Their service is pretty good.
Recommendation - Pizza, Avacado smoothie, nachoes(super crisp and fresh), quinoa Salad
Not Recommended - Truffles cheese Popcorn (sogy and moist)

⭐ Review: Toit Mahadevapura – Mahadevapura, Bangalore
If you’re looking for one of the best places to unwind after the office in Mahadevapura, Toit is easily top of the list. This lively brewpub has earned strong praise from locals and visitors alike for its vibrant atmosphere, great craft beers, and solid food options, making it a go-to hangout for colleagues, friends, and anyone who wants a relaxed yet fun night out.
🍺 Vibe & Ambience — The space is spacious and stylish, with a mix of indoor and outdoor seating that’s perfect for winding down after work. The industrial-chic interiors with exposed brick and cozy lighting set a welcoming tone, and many reviewers loved the relaxed, social feel — great for chatting over drinks without blasting music drowning out conversation.
🍻 Drinks & Brews — Toit’s craft beers are a highlight, with a good variety of house brews on tap that pair beautifully with their food. Many patrons specifically recommend trying the Belgian Dark Ale and Red Ale, and the overall beer selection is one of the main reasons people keep coming back.
🍕 Food & Pairings — While the focus is on beer, the food here gets strong marks too. Classic pub fare like pizzas, nachos, ribs, and prawns are frequently mentioned as crowd-pleasers, and desserts like tiramisu or cheesecake earn special shout-outs from diners.
👩‍💼 Service & Crowd — Many reviews mention attentive, friendly staff that elevate the experience. Weeknights are especially enjoyable, with more space and quicker service, though weekends can get busy — reservations are recommended if you’re heading there after work.
💸 Who It’s For — With reasonable prices and a lively yet relaxed environment, Toit is ideal for after-work drinks with colleagues, casual meetups with friends, or even a low-key date night.
Bottom Line: Toit Mahadevapura is one of the places to visit in Mahadevapura after office hours — great beers, good food, and a vibe that hits the sweet spot between laid-back and lively.

Visited TOIT Mahadevapura twice on my last trip to Bangalore. It's a new venue and it's very well done. Hospitality was spot on. We served by Divya who was incredibly hospitable. The beers were on point as always. Definitely coming back for more!🍺🍻

Here's a polished version of your review:

Recently visited this newly opened outlet of Glen's Bakehouse, and the experience was excellent. The ambience was cozy and inviting, making it a great place to relax. The food was served quickly, and the quality of every item we tried was top-notch. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. I’ll definitely be visiting again and would highly recommend it to others.

Make it elaborate

Recently visited this newly opened outlet of Glen's Bakehouse, and I must say it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. The moment I walked in, I was impressed by the warm and cozy ambience. The interiors are thoughtfully designed, creating a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere that makes it a great place to catch up with friends, work for a while, or simply enjoy a quiet meal.

The service was prompt and efficient. Despite the outlet being fairly busy, the staff was attentive and ensured that our order was served quickly without compromising on quality. The overall experience felt smooth and well-organized.

Coming to the food, every item we ordered exceeded expectations. The quality of the ingredients was evident, and each dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Whether it was the baked goods, beverages, or savory items, everything was prepared to perfection and tasted absolutely delicious. It's clear that the team maintains the high standards that Glen's Bakehouse is known for.

What stood out the most was the consistency in quality across all the items we tried. Combined with the pleasant ambience and excellent service, it made for a thoroughly enjoyable dining experience. This new outlet is a fantastic addition to the area, and I can already see myself becoming a regular visitor. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, a relaxing atmosphere, and a delightful café experience. I will definitely be visiting again soon. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a blasting experience at TOIT. The crispy calamari was outstanding. The best I have ever had. Definitely gonna come back to some more calamari. Desserts and the Mushroom Lamb Pasta with White Sauce was pretty good. Fish and chips were average. Mocktails are below average in taste. Overall experience is quite good.

Here's a more elaborate and polished review:

Had an absolutely fantastic experience at Toit. The highlight of the meal was undoubtedly the Crispy Calamari—it was hands down the best calamari I’ve ever had. Perfectly crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and packed with flavor. It's one of those dishes that keeps you thinking about it long after the meal is over, and I’ll definitely be coming back just to have it again.

The Mushroom Lamb Pasta in White Sauce was another standout dish. The pasta was cooked well, the sauce was rich and creamy without being overwhelming, and the combination of mushrooms and lamb worked beautifully together. The desserts were also quite enjoyable and provided a satisfying finish to the meal.

The Fish and Chips, however, were fairly average and didn’t leave a lasting impression compared to some of the other dishes on the menu. Similarly, the mocktails were a bit disappointing. While they looked appealing, the flavors felt underwhelming and lacked the punch one would expect.

That said, the overall experience was very positive. The lively atmosphere, great food options, and excellent signature dishes more than made up for a few misses. If you're visiting TOIT, the Crispy Calamari is an absolute must-try. Looking forward to returning and exploring more of the menu—though another plate of that amazing calamari is definitely going to be my first order! ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

Visited here on a relaxed Sunday evening and the ambience was perfect for it. Toit’s beers have always been good so you can’t go wrong with any of the beers you order.
We tried their okra podi chips which was a 5/5 for me and the Hot n Sour tofu bowl which was also very good. The portion sizes are good and the flavors are great! I have had their pizzas as well and they taste pretty good.
Overall, loved the outdoor seating and ambience and ofcourse their beer! Perfect place for a relaxing evening with pretty decor.

name: BLR Brewing Co - Whitefield
review_texts:
Had an amazing experience at BLR Brewing Co.! The ambience of the place is absolutely fantastic — a perfect mix of vibrant energy and a relaxing atmosphere. The interiors are beautifully designed, the lighting and music create a great vibe, and it’s an ideal place to hang out with friends or family.

The food was equally impressive. Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and well-presented. The quality and taste were top-notch, and the service staff was polite and attentive throughout our visit. The overall experience felt very welcoming and enjoyable.

What I really loved was how lively yet comfortable the place felt. Whether you’re planning a casual outing, dinner, or weekend chill session, this place definitely stands out. The combination of great ambience, delicious food, and excellent service makes it a must-visit spot in Bangalore.

Would definitely love to visit again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good dining and brewery experience!

I dont know how this place has 4.5+ Review.
The food was horrible (bland , cold and clearly not fresh at all )and all the ordered food came in cold. There was no taste. Although the staff listened to our complaints, not once did they defend themselves. They were like we will replace this , we will not add this in the bill. That likely means that there are lot of complaints  and now they dont even defend anymore . We ordered an Orange mocktail named after a city which i dont remember now. This drink tasted worse than Rasna. It would be an isult to Rasna if i compare it to Rasna . After a point of time the essense and the water litrlly separated. We asked the waiter to swich off the fan literally like 10-15 times for which he agreed but the fan never got turned off. He only turned it off when we threatened him that we would write a review ....
Seeing the reivews mentioning the waiter's name it mostly feels like the customers were offered some kind of a compliment dish or a discount for writing a positive review

Here’s a natural, positive review you can post:

Absolutely loved my experience at BLR Brewing Co. Whitefield! The ambience is stunning with beautiful interiors and a lively vibe that’s perfect for both casual outings and celebrations. The food was delicious, the drinks were refreshing, and everything was served fresh. The staff was warm, attentive, and made sure we had a great time throughout. Overall, it’s one of the best places in Whitefield to enjoy good food, craft beers, and a fantastic atmosphere. Can’t wait to visit again! Thank you for your hospitality Shivangi

Amazing ambience! The lush green décor, spacious seating, great music, and lively vibe makes BLR Brewing a perfect spot to relax and spend quality time with friends. Every corner is aesthetically pleasing and adds to the overall experience. Highly recommended for the atmosphere alone! ✨🍻

I dropped by this spot after seeing all the great reviews! 🤩 We tried a bunch of stuff like cocktails, mocktails, and beer samplers. The veg dim sum, noodles, Golconda chicken, veg noodles, and pepper pork were all delicious! 😋 The service and atmosphere were fantastic. It was pretty lively and I'd totally recommend it! ✨🍻  200mts from Metro station.

name: KLING BREWERY
review_texts: While walking in church Street I found this cutest cafe. After I entered I get attracted from the ambience and seating area. Each corner was so photogenic. They have three seating area you can seat as per your preference. We have started with Refreshing drink Cucumber Cooler and this is best mocktail. After that we have tried many dishes and each was top-notch. And In dessert we have tried their Baked Rasgulla and really it was so delicious. So whenever you are visiting Church Street don’t forgot to visit this place.

We stopped by this restaurant yesterday, and it was packed & the environment was pulsating with energy. To ensure a smoother experience, we recommend planning ahead or making a reservation if possible.

This location is ideal for anyone who enjoys craft beer and delicious cuisine.

We tried :

Mocktails
Assorted Fries
Crispy Tender Coconut
Signature Pizza
Lucknow Styled Nawabi Tarkari Biryani
Baked Rasgulla

Our meal was fantastic and we loved every bite. The Kling Brewery's menu impresses with options for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The staff here are super friendly and go out of their way to help.

With its spacious & multiple seating arrangements, the restaurant is an excellent choice to visit with your squad/family. In a nut shell, the experience was outstanding, and we're eager to repeat it.

This place serves really good brews. The place is very good and has different seating sections as per your liking. Food tastes really good but they could just improve in their quantity, because for the price we are paying some items felt like we were getting awfully less and had to order again immediately. Rest its a good place to chill on church street and I would definitely recommend going here.

A nice place located conveniently in Church Street. They have valet parking so taking your vehicle is not an issue. Ambience is great and food is amazing. Their coastal cuisine is delicious. Recommendation is to try Prawn ghee roast with neer dosa, non veg platter, thai curry. In dessert, I had the baked Rasgulla and it was yummy.
Lively ambience, good beer and food. The stout was smooth. The daru chicken was awesome. Dilip who served me was courteous   Good retro music

name: Arbor Brewing Company
review_texts: Went on Friday nite and it was packed, very loud as IPL match was on, plus RCB was playing so extra noise. Had the Stout nice and bitter like Guiness. Ginger beef fry was really tasty priced at 500. Spicy bbq pizza was nice too. Ok some of the food prices are on the higher side. Ambience is nice if you are with a large group.

Visited on 28-Feb-2026

Positives:
* The ambiance is good.
* The restroom is neat and clean.
* The “Smooth Criminal” drink tastes good.

Negatives:
* Drinking water was not provided.
* The food quantity is very less for the price.
* Prices are on the higher side.
* We had to call the attendants multiple times to place our order.
* The attendant-recommended item, “Kalaidoscope,” was too bitter in taste.
* A 10% service charge was levied.
* There are no dry items available, such as chicken kebab. Most dishes are served with sauce or tomato ketchup.
* Mutton chapli kabab charged Rs.450 + Tax for 4 pieces

Am giving full marks because ambience is good ,beers 9 varieties available and 3 are just best taste including Hefe,no parking and easy riders.  Prices are reasonable is their main attraction for frequent visitors. Staff all very friendly and easy guidance. The only thing is they confused regarding snacks who ordered and whom it should be given. Pizzas, chicken chilli lamb all was excellent

I visited Arbor with my office colleagues. The ambience is very good. We ordered a beer sampler and zeroed to three beers. The beers were good. The food as compared to Toit is just ok, nothing great about the food here.

Arbor brewing company is an old brewpub  in Bengaluru,close to CBD but devoid of excess noise, excessive crowd and hustle bustle, having its own relaxed ambience.Not too crowded and a warm English style  ambience.
Located on the 3rd Floor, opp to Garuda Mall, it is well within reach of central Bengaluru.
Craft beer is good ,starters and main course are equally good and tasty.
Old School Chilly chicken ,Salt and pepper prawn,mutton chapli kababs are made really well.
Bangalore bliss is  a smooth and light beer whereas their signature Smooth Criminal is actually a potent and dangerous criminal, smooth to taste but hits all of a sudden.Beware of this.
Courteous service with a foosball table, not too jarring music and a lively vibe.
Valet parking available.
Prices are steep though and the bouncer at the entrance,regularly  moving around the tables in the pub all the while is an unwelcome move.

name: Boche & Shakesbierre - Brewpub & Club
review_texts:
Place is good, picturesque.
They have “Mango Special” in which half of the items are not available.
Service is great.
Desserts were really nice.
Music was great.
Food is pathetic, most of the dishes feel the same, drinks are too sugary, flavors can’t be felt. I went with a group of 10 people, honestly felt like the money was wasted for average food. Please prefer better options nearby if planning for larger groups.

Went here for a team lunch and had a really good time. The ambience is lively and spacious with plenty of seating options, making it perfect for group outings. The Tandoor Platter is a must-try — flavorful and well-prepared. The food overall was enjoyable and fresh.

One thing we noticed was that the mocktails weren’t great and didn’t stand out, so probably best to stick to other drinks. Staff were friendly and service was decent, which added nicely to the experience. Overall, a nice spot for good food and catch-ups with colleagues or friends!

Had a decent family dinner experience at Boche & Shakesbierre - Brewpub & Club with the kids. The place had live music, and the singer added a nice touch to the evening, she even sang a few Hindi songs in her own style, which we really enjoyed.

Food was okay, not exceptional, but good enough for a casual outing. We tried the Alfredo pasta, paneer tikka, and Afghani chicken kebab. The Heart of Gold cocktail stood out more for its presentation than anything else.

The staff was courteous. That said, it’s not a place you’d go out of your way for, but if you’re nearby, it’s a decent option for a relaxed evening.

Visited ShakesBierre Brewpub & Kitchen during their Oktoberfest celebration and honestly, it felt like a mini beer festival right in the middle of Bangalore. The whole place had proper festive vibes — blue-white décor, themed menu, lively music, and that classic clinking-glasses energy you expect from Oktoberfest.

The craft beers were easily the highlight. Fresh brews on tap, smooth lagers, wheat beers, and some really fun seasonal specials that paired beautifully with the food. Loved how the menu actually suggested beer pairings for each dish — made the experience feel curated rather than random ordering.

Food was solid pub-style comfort. The grilled meats and kebabs were juicy, portions were generous, and everything went perfectly with the beers. It’s the kind of place where you come hungry and leave happy. Service was friendly and quick even though it was packed, and the staff helped with recommendations.

Ambience-wise, it’s spacious, energetic, and perfect for groups — rooftop/indoor seating, music, and a proper party atmosphere without feeling chaotic.

If you’re looking for an Oktoberfest-style night out with great brews, good food, and fun vibes, this is definitely one of the best spots in the city. Would happily come back for every beer festival they host. 🍺✨

This place is huge.. they have so many sections.. look terrace,  upper deck roof top, karaoke room, Private Dining.. I visited for Oktoberfest and they served some limited edition food.. it was really nice experience.. also they had happy hours Buy 1 get 1 free beer.. it was nice experience

name: Brooks and Bonds Brewery
review_texts:
Already famous for their Mango Cider, this place definitely needs more noise to be made. First things first, the Mango cider is really light and the flavour is wholesome. I'm not a beer person and I loved it!!
Seating is spread over 2 levels and the place does get full pretty soon, esp on weekends. Best to reserve before you go.
Coming to the food, the Bang Bang Paneer, Pizza and Butter roti with Paneer were really good. Wish I could try more but was truly stuffed. Mr Sriji, the manager is pretty attentive to all guests and service by the staff was quite commendable too.

Visited Brooks and Bond recently and had a good overall experience. The highlight of the evening was definitely the mango beer—refreshing, flavourful, and something I'd happily order again.

The service was prompt and the staff were courteous throughout, which made the visit pleasant. The ambience was nice and comfortable, though nothing particularly exceptional. The food was decent and well-prepared, but it didn't quite stand out compared to the drinks.

Overall, it's a good place to unwind with friends, especially if you're looking to try their excellent mango beer. I'd happily visit again.

Finally made my way to Brooks & Bonds to try their famous Mango Beer… and now I totally get why they’re still one of the best. 🍺

Everything from the drinks to the food was an absolute hit. Perfect vibes, amazing flavours, and a place I’d keep going back to.

On my table:
🍤 Prawn Tempura
Kiwi Mocktail
🥭 Mango Beer
🦐 Seafood Salad
🍝 Pasta
Tiramisu

If you’re a mango lover, their Mango Beer is a must-try!

Tried the famous Mango Beer at Brooks & Bonds and it absolutely lived up to the hype
The beer was refreshing and unique, while the food was equally delicious with great flavors and generous portions. Loved the vibrant ambience and attentive service. Definitely a spot worth visiting for a fun weekend outing .

Tried Brooks and Bonds for their famous mango cider, and it absolutely lived up to the hype - super refreshing with balanced flavours. We also ordered the mango chicken wings, which unfortunately felt a bit too sour and overly saucy. It would’ve worked much better if the flavours were more balanced overall.
The deviled eggs, corn with mango salsa and peri peri fries were decent, though they felt slightly overpriced for what they offered.
The real standout of the meal was the Pizza Verde - perfectly done and absolutely delicious.
Would definitely go back just for the pizza and the mango cider.

name: ABV - Artisanal Bier Village
review_texts:
Good place for Team Dinners!
Drinks:
Tried Ruby Nebula (Hibiscus cooler - non alcoholic) was a good one
Virgin Pinacoloda - Creamy coconut and pineapple drink was tasty
Non-alcoholic whisky hisky and Gin were also on the menu
Starters:
Mongolian Prawns (Spicy and sweet) and Prawns ghee roast we're really well cooked my liking.
Butter Garlic prawns served with short bread was ok (Sauce was good but the cooking was not to my taste)
There was a brocolli starter which was a lucky draw! It was really good
Crispy corn is a familiar but good choice in veg as well
Veg and chicken momos were also decent
Nachos was also good
Alfredo Pasta was great and cheesy
Chicken starters we're also nice
Desserts:
The Mango cheese cake was the best in the menu and we ended up ordering it multiple times!! It was flavoured and not the real mango but it was really good!
Japanese Triple Layer was the second runner up! Every scoop was yum
Coconut cheese cake was also okay
There was chocolate brownie with icecream which was good to have
Tres Leches was pink in colour and not good. It tasted like drinking rose flavored whipping cream
Tiramasu was a disaster. Full of cream and tasted like mousse
The washrooms were clean
The ambience is a bit dark but the water areas with the lamp lighting created a good mood.
Being open air, there were lot of flies and mosquitoes which was a bit disturbing

Great place to have your food and mocktails. I didn't tried the achohol so I am not sure about it. But the starter, main course, desert everything was bang on. Price wise starters were about costly but the main course, desert and mocktail were extremely cheap. The ambience was always great. The only concern was the service. That was a bit delayed though it was not bad. I would have given 4.5 overall.

Visited ABV recently and had a fantastic experience. Live music.Good for a perfect date.Budget friendly.The ambiance is lively yet comfortable, making it a great place to hang out with friends or unwind after work. The food was equally impressive. The staff were courteous, attentive, and quick with their service despite the crowd. Overall, ABV offers a great delicious food, and a vibrant atmosphere. Definitely one of the better brewery experiences in Bangalore! As I don't drink, I haven't tried any breweries...

Just had an amazing meal with such a lovely atmosphere! 🍽️ The food options were incredible, and they had a fantastic selection of cocktails and mocktails to choose from. 🍹 I was seriously impressed by the huge lunch spread they offered. It was perfect for a relaxed afternoon outing. Definitely a spot I'd recommend for a great dining experience! 👌 #Foodie #GoodTimes #CocktailHour #LunchGoals

A Fantastic Hangout Spot!
If you are looking for a great place to spend some quality time, this spot is definitely worth a visit. Here is a breakdown of the experience:
• Ambiance & Vibes: The atmosphere is excellent, struck by a perfect balance of energy and comfort. It has those "nice vibes" that make it ideal for catching up with friends or just relaxing after a long day.
• Food & Drink: The menu doesn't disappoint. Everything served was enjoyable, contributing to the overall positive experience of the outing. Must try Beer mohito
• Service Spotlight: What truly set the visit apart was the exceptional service. Atish was incredibly helpful throughout the stay; his attentive nature and professionalism ensured that everything went smoothly. It’s rare to find service that is both quick and genuinely hospitable.

name: STORIES BREWERY & KITCHEN
review_texts:
Tried out Stories Brewery & Kitchen in JP Nagar recently, and it turned out to be a really good experience. The place may not be very popular yet in the area, but it’s definitely worth visiting. Located on the 4th floor, the ambience is one of the best parts about this place. The seating arrangement is comfortable, the vibe is cozy, and the whole place is maintained really well.

The food was genuinely good, and even the drink menu had some great options. If you’re visiting during mango season, definitely try their mango-flavored items, whether it’s the drinks, desserts, or food items. Really loved that part.

Overall, a great spot to chill with friends, enjoy good food, and spend a relaxed evening. Definitely recommended!

I recently visited this place and had an amazing experience. The ambience is beautiful and very lively, making it a perfect spot to hang out with friends or celebrate special occasions. The brewery has a spacious setup with both indoor and outdoor seating, and the greenery and lighting create a really relaxing vibe in the evening.
The food menu has a lot of variety with Indian, continental, and Asian dishes, so there is something for everyone. Everything we ordered tasted fresh and well prepared, and the presentation was great. The craft beers and cocktails were also very good and added to the overall experience.
The staff were friendly and attentive, and the service was quick even though the place was quite busy. I also liked how the atmosphere had good music and a nice crowd, which made the evening even more enjoyable. Overall, it’s a fantastic place in Bengaluru to enjoy good food, drinks, and a great vibe with friends. Highly recommended! 🍻

Had such a lovely evening at Stories. The place has a beautiful vibe, very aesthetic and relaxing, perfect for a slow dinner or catching up with friends.

The food really stood out. The lotus stem crisp and charcoal dim sum were packed with flavour, and the Alfredo pasta was just right. But the real showstopper was the frushi - beetroot, sticky rice, cream cheese, and exotic fruits. Such a fun mix of textures and flavours, honestly unforgettable. Big kudos to the chefs for that one.

We also tried the mango cider at the end and it completely stole the moment. Easily a must-try.

Special mention to Ajmal for the warm and attentive service, always smiling and making sure everything was perfect.

Since we were revisiting, we were treated to a complimentary tres leches, and that was just the sweetest ending to the meal.

Also it’s pet friendly and i saw pet food in menu!!! We witnessed some cute moments as well :)

Overall, a wonderful experience. Definitely going back again 🤍

The food is tasty, and the service is excellent. The interior ambience is stylish. Entry can be tricky due to a narrow access road, but valet parking is a plus. The lift is unreliable, and the iron staircase might feel intimidating. Beer was awesome. The space is mostly filled with young crowds.

Stories used to be one of those well-known Bangalore brewery spots that people genuinely recommended, especially for its pizzas and garlic cheese breads. But now, the place feels a bit under-maintained and inconsistent, and a lot of that old charm seems missing.

The ambience is still decent, but since much of the seating is open-air, it can get quite sunny and windy during summer afternoons, which affects the overall comfort.

Coming to the food

* The pizzas and sourdough-based dishes were disappointing, with the dough itself tasting pretty average and poorly done compared to how the place used to be.
* The garlic cheese bread, which was once a highlight, now also feels just okay.
* Other dishes like pastas and starters are very inconsistent—some are decent while others completely miss the mark.
* The mango sticky rice dessert didn’t work at all personally and felt underwhelming.

The drinks are probably the strongest part of the experience now. The piña colada, refreshers, and milkshakes were all pretty decent, but not enough to compensate for the disappointing food.

Portion sizes also feel slightly small for the pricing, making the place feel expensive for what it currently offers.

name: ICB INDIAN CRAFT BREWERY
review_texts:
We had the chance to visit Indian Craft Brewery (ICB) this past Saturday for an event, and it completely blew us away. The location right near Manyata Tech Park in Nagavara is super strategic and convenient, but the real highlight is the inside. The ambiance feels incredibly premium—it’s got this grand, culture-rich atmosphere with stunning high-arched interiors that look amazing.

The hospitality was also top-notch. Our table service was exceptionally good, with polite, fast, and very attentive servers who made sure we were well taken care of throughout the evening. To top it all off, they had live music performances that brought such a great energy to the entire space.

It definitely gets busy, so I would highly advise reserving a table in advance if you're planning a visit, especially on weekends and holidays. Can't wait to head back here again soon!

Had a fantastic time here! The craft beers are top-notch with plenty of variety, and the food menu has something for everyone – from Indian starters to continental dishes. The ambience is lively yet comfortable, perfect for hanging out with friends or colleagues after work.

Service was excellent – the staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure we had a great experience. Prices are reasonable for the quality, and the spacious seating makes it easy to relax even when it’s busy. We had some starters like chicken pakoras, noodles, fish tikka, soupy noodles, neer dosa, tody drinks, black prawns dimsums etc. and everything was delicious.

Definitely one of the best breweries in North Bangalore. Highly recommend if you’re near Manyata Tech Park and looking for good beer, great food, and a fun vibe!

ICB, located near Manyata Tech Park, is an amazing place to visit and spend quality time with friends, family, or colleagues. The venue offers ample parking space, making it very convenient for visitors. The ambience is excellent, with a spacious and well-maintained setup that creates a pleasant and relaxing experience.

One of the biggest advantages of the place is its large seating and event area, which makes it ideal for hosting birthday celebrations, team outings, family gatherings, and other special occasions. The overall atmosphere is vibrant, welcoming, and perfect for both casual meetups and celebrations.

The food is another highlight of ICB. The dishes are delicious, well-prepared, and offer a great variety of options to suit different tastes. Combined with the excellent service and lively environment, it makes for a memorable dining experience.

Overall, ICB near Manyata Tech Park is a fantastic destination for good food, great ambience, and memorable celebrations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a spacious venue with excellent hospitality and a wonderful dining experience.

Had a great time at ICB Brewery! Absolutely loved the huge ambiance — both indoor and outdoor spaces are beautifully done. Perfect spot to catch an IPL match with friends.

We tried the avocado sushi and prawns tempura — the sushi stood out more for us, while the tempura was decent. The chicken crystal dumpling was good too. Only wish the butter garlic prawns had a bit more garlic punch.

Ended the meal with their cheesecake, and it was honestly the best way to wrap it up!

Overall, great vibe, good food, and a solid place for a chill outing.

Visited this place for lunch with my colleagues on a weekday, and it turned out to be a really pleasant experience. The ambiance immediately stands out, it has a calm, laid-back vibe that makes it perfect for unwinding or having relaxed conversations. The interiors are thoughtfully designed, giving it a cozy yet modern feel, and the overall theme adds to the charm of the place.

Coming to the food, everything we ordered was well-prepared and flavorful. The quality of ingredients was evident, and the dishes were served fresh, which enhanced the overall dining experience. The menu offers a good variety, catering to different preferences, and the taste definitely lives up to expectations.
One thing worth mentioning is the service, since we visited on a weekday, the place wasn’t overly crowded, and the wait time for our order was quite reasonable. The staff was attentive and ensured a smooth experience throughout.

In terms of pricing, it is fairly aligned with other restobars in the same category. You get good value considering the ambiance, quality, and service. Overall, it’s a great spot for a casual lunch or a relaxed outing with friends or colleagues.

name: Biergarten Brewery & Kitchen
review_texts: Jaydeep provided excellent service during my visit. I couldn’t decide what to order and asked him to surprise me, and he thoughtfully suggested a dish and explained it in detail. He was courteous, friendly, and very patient throughout. He kept checking in to ensure I was comfortable and made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. I had a wonderful experience, thank you Jaydeep. :)

A great place to relax and spend quality time with friends. I went there with my office staff and had a great time together there. The ambience strikes a perfect balance between lively and laid-back, with ample open seating that makes it ideal for evening gatherings.

We ordered almost everything from the menu. The food was impressive, fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, with generous portion sizes. The service was equally commendable, with attentive staff who checked in regularly without being intrusive. Value for money experience.

Overall, it’s an excellent spot for good food, great vibes, and a seamless dining experience. Highly recommended for casual outings and get-togethers.

Fabulous beer and ambience.
Food was okay but the service made up for it.

The absolute best thing about the place (especially since I’m from Delhi) the fact that they didn’t raise the music volume beyond a certain level after 9pm. People could easily talk and enjoy the drinks.

Highly recommend.

Had a great dinner at Biergarten.  We really enjoyed our time there. Nice ambience, music , food. It was totally fun. Went for a b'day celebration and it was worth it. We were 5 people and spend around 11k including food and drinks. Totally recommending this place.

Great place to unwind with friends. The ambience is vibrant yet relaxed, with plenty of open seating that makes it perfect for evening hangouts. The food quality was impressive, fresh, flavorful, and well-presented, with good portion sizes. Service was attentive and prompt, with staff regularly checking in without being intrusive. Overall, a solid spot for good food, good vibes, and a smooth dining experience.

name: Float Brewery
review_texts:
The drinks were excellent, and the ambiance was very pleasant and enjoyable. The vegetarian dishes were well-prepared and tasted great. However, some of the non-vegetarian items had a raw smell and appeared to be undercooked. We shared this feedback with the restaurant staff during our visit.

On a positive note, the desserts were outstanding and one of the highlights of the meal. Overall, it was a good dining experience with great drinks, a nice atmosphere, and delicious desserts, though there is room for improvement in the preparation of the non-vegetarian dishes.

One of the best brewery that I have visited. The atmosphere is very good with a pool table available for the guests to relax.

The crew Bikram was very helpful in hearing out our requirement and made sure we get exactly what was asked.

Their Falafel Chaat and masala omelette were too good and presented the best way.

Fried rice was good and filled with veggies and eggs. Tasted the best.

Not a bad place. The food has good quantity, and you actually start to feel full after just a few bites. The mocktails are great but sadly they didn't have a pina colada when I visited :(
The food is great too. Not anything outstanding but they're definitely on the good side.
The people are sweet and the ambience is great. The place is actually humungous on the inside... about 4 floors in total with tons of seating.

Maybe we visited Float Brewery on the wrong day, but I'm not sure that should be an excuse. From the moment we arrived, things felt off—no valet parking, no Hefeweizen, no squid, no prawns. There were simply too many "No, sorry, not available" responses throughout the afternoon. Super loud music to make things worse!

Ironically, the food we eventually ordered was actually quite good, which is the only reason this review gets an extra star. Otherwise, based on the overall experience, it would have been a 1-star rating from us.

A brewery should be judged by what it consistently offers, not by what it doesn't have on a particular day. If key menu items and popular beer options are unavailable, it significantly impacts the experience.

Perhaps it was just an unfortunate day to visit. But as a customer, that's not really my problem. Unfortunately, the overall experience wasn't compelling enough to make us want to return, and it's not a place we'd consider for a second visit.

Float Brewery is a spacious spot with plenty of seating, making it a good choice for outings with friends or groups. The ambiance is lively, and the addition of live music really enhances the overall vibe, making it an enjoyable place to unwind.

However, the seating experience could be improved. The staff wasn’t very helpful in guiding us to a table, which left us waiting and eventually searching for one on our own. Even after settling, we were asked to move due to seating arrangements, which meant switching tables a couple of times—slightly inconvenient.

On the brighter side, the food was genuinely good and made up for the initial hassle. Service, once settled, was decent, especially when it came to food. Overall, Float Brewery offers a fun atmosphere and good food, but smoother coordination from the staff would make the experience much better.

name: Wanderers Craft Brewery
review_texts: Wanderers Craft Brewery is a must-visit spot in Bengaluru, offering an extraordinary experience with its spacious rooftop and fantastic selection of craft beers. The diverse menu complements the drinks perfectly - their barbecue chicken Bao, curry leaves chicken tikka and papper chicken are must-tries! 👌 The staff are attentive, friendly, and make sure you have a great time, whether you're there for a birthday bash, anniversary celebration, or just a chill evening with friends. The brewery's atmosphere is fantastic, with an open rooftop offering a perfect spot to chill and enjoy the evening breeze. With its unique blend of food and drinks, Wanderers Craft Brewery is a hidden gem that's definitely worth checking out.

An excellent place to spend time with friends — the ambience is vibrant right from the entrance up to the terrace. The food was fantastic; we tried the mushroom, paneer tikka rolls, and nachos, and each dish impressed us with both presentation and portion size.

The beers were equally impressive. The Hefeweizen and Lager were great, but the IPA stood out as my personal favourite. The mocktails were also well crafted and refreshing.

The hostesses were attentive, courteous, and guided us around the space. Special mention to our server, Sadik, for his exceptional hospitality.

Pricing is reasonable and pocket-friendly, making it even more appealing.

Overall, a must-visit spot when you are in Kalyan Nagar.
Flavors were on point and the food felt light yet filling. Service was smooth and the overall experience was pleasant. Would recommend trying it once.

Service was not good. Minimum staff, 10 min waiting for drinking water and final bill.
Order swapping happening. No brewery at all. Only bottle beers 🍻. No valet parking. Beers maintaining room temperature Only 🌡.
For every food order we are hearing  sorry. Prawns not available. Order is not app based. You need to call waiter. Same waiter handling entire 10 table .
Funny thing,  waiter and manager arguing themselves. Whose order is this!!!
Extremely happy with staff behavior and politeness.
Even after full confusion, with a smile they will serve food. Handwash is inside toilet, which is very small. But its neat clean 👌 😌

We were seated at a corner table on the rooftop. It's very chilly and windy up there. Nice ambience. Rooftop seating appears to be a fairly popular choice among patrons.

The tables and bar chairs are quite dusty due to the wind, traffic and air which should be fine except that the staff do not clean the tables before diners are seated.

They have different types of seating available high, low,  indoor, outdoor, etc.
They have put in  quite a bit of effort into keeping the ambience of the pub relaxing as well as comfortably bright with their decorative lights and interior decoration.

The menu contains a fairly large number of dishes and drinks to pick from.

The Calcutta chicken cutlets were
not awful however they were definitely
drier than raw rice.

The pork coorgi was very flavourful. It had less fat which is great and a good serving of meat.

The curry leaf prawns we had were amazing as  they were large pieces for one and additionally because the presentation was unique.  The prawns were juicy, fresh and the taste was delish.

We also had beer battered onion rings and apple pie with ice cream amongst more.

The sizzling brownie is awesome you may  burn your teeth and tongue even .... despite the  biting cold weather. It was gooey, had a well sized scoop of ice cream and was definitely the highlight of my dinner.

For desserts I would give them an overall 4.8 out of 5.
As for food I will probably give a 4 out of 5.

Staff are polite and friendly but service is very slow. The staff attending on us forgot one of our orders and double billed us on another item.  When pointed out the staff were quick to rectify the error. The restaurant has several staff but they seem to be quite busy for the most part.

name: MisoSexy Bangalore
review_texts:
Absolutely loved the place! We visited on a rainy Saturday afternoon and took the outdoor seating. It was initially noisy with the car honks but the experience was so immersive that we absolutely loved it!

We ordered the salmon sushi, fish in black bean sauce, tofu based bao, black rice and tofu based gravy. Every item served was top notch. The flavors packed the punch and the black rice was a totally new kind of rice we tasted.

Recommend this place to everyone!

Visited Misosexy recently and had a good experience overall. The ambiance is stylish and enjoyable, though the music was a bit too loud and the AC felt quite strong.

Food-wise, there were some real highlights. The Shanghai soup dumplings had a delicious, flavorful broth inside, although the dumpling wrapper was slightly thicker than I prefer. The smoked sauce chicken dumplings were excellent and definitely a must-try. I also loved the Prawn Tempura Uramaki Sushi—fresh, well-balanced, and very tasty.

The ramen was average compared to the other dishes, but the appetizers and sushi made up for it. Worth visiting for the vibe and some standout dishes! 🍜🥟🍣

I recently visited Misosexy in Bangalore and had a really enjoyable dining experience. The ambience is stylish yet relaxed, with a modern, slightly playful vibe that lives up to the restaurant’s name. The lighting, music, and seating all make it a great spot for a casual dinner or a fun night out with friends.
We started with a few dumplings, which were delicate, well‑wrapped, and packed with flavour—the filling was juicy and properly seasoned, and the outer wrappers were soft with just the right bite. The pork spare ribs were a highlight: tender on the inside, slightly caramelised on the outside, and glazed with a balanced sweet‑and‑savory sauce that wasn’t too heavy.
The prawn tempura uramaki sushi was fresh and satisfying; the prawns were crisp from the tempura coating, and the rice and nori wrapped everything together nicely. The roll was neither too dry nor too oily, and it felt like a good fusion of Japanese technique and contemporary plating.
We also ordered a couple of mocktails, both of which were refreshing, well‑balanced, and visually appealing. The bartender clearly paid attention to presentation and flavour, avoiding overly sugary or artificial tastes.
Overall, Misosexy Bangalore impressed me with its creative menu, consistent execution, and cool atmosphere. If you’re in the mood for Asian‑inspired small plates, good sushi, and stylish drinks, I’d definitely recommend trying it.

A great lunch spot with attentive service!
Had a really enjoyable lunch at MisoSexy. The balcony open air space was really awesome. Service was excellent. Food was also tasty. I personally recommend Wontons and baos as must try. Cocktails also were perfect. Over all experience was really nice and refreshing.

Visited Miso Sexy for dinner and loved the vibe and ambience, exactly what we came for. The music was a bit loud for the evening, but the food more than made up for it. The dumplings and sushi were outstanding, and the gin-based cocktails were one of the best I’ve had. The staff was very kind and courteous as well. Great food, great ambience, and a place that keeps bringing me back (especially for the sushi 🍣 ). Highly recommend!✨🍾

name: Oasis Brewery
review_texts: Having passed by this place numerous times, finally got the chance of visiting the place. This place didn't disappoint and might be the best brewery in Whitefield. The ambiance is really great with great interiors and a huge seating capacity. Its outside seating is different from the inner seating area and is just as good. The service is pretty good as well. Items came fairly quickly and the staff was attentive and friendly. Coming to the food, the presentation and preparation was on point with all the dishes looking and tasting great. Prices are comparable to other breweries so that way I felt this was more value for money than others. Their beers were also good and they have a good variety in tap. Ample parking space and a good place to hangout with friends and family. Definitely worth recommending and revisiting again👌

Its a nice cozy space tucked in a corner of a hustle bustle place. I went for a lunch & how I wish to go for a dinner for the ambience. A nice B'lore weather & cozy ambiance tags along beautifully. Next time for sure.
Food is decent. I have had better. But I loved the desserts & mocktails. So yes, great place to chill. Not recommending anything as most of the dishes were good. Nothing bad. Decent enough. But definately try desserts here.

I Had a wonderful experience at Oasis Brewery! The service was exceptional—friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome from start to finish. The staff Subrata Halder was prompt, courteous, and ensured everything was perfect. Great atmosphere, delicious food and drinks, and outstanding hospitality. I'll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great dining experience!

Visited Oasis Brewery, Whitefield recently for their Summer Collective, and it turned out to be a refreshing experience beyond just food and drinks.

The space has a great balance of lively brewery vibes and a relaxed atmosphere, making it ideal for catching up with friends or planning a unique date. What stood out was how thoughtfully the Summer Collective activities were curated — from interactive experiences to entertainment that kept the evening engaging without feeling overwhelming.

The food paired well with their drinks, and the ambience transitions beautifully from a laid-back afternoon setting to a vibrant evening scene. If you're someone who enjoys places that offer more than just dining, Oasis is definitely worth exploring.

A great spot in Whitefield for good conversations, drinks, and memorable experiences.

No doubt, one of the largest microbreweries in Bangalore! The ambiance is fantastic, the food is delicious, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. It's a perfect place to relax and spend quality time with family or friends.

They have a splendid selection of starters, and the overall dining experience is enjoyable. The brewery also has a large open area for kids(look like open area for functions, making it an excellent choice for families.

The only downside is that the food portions feel a bit small for the price. Apart from that, it's definitely a place worth visiting and one I'd recommend for a great evening out.

name: BLR Brewing Co - Electronic City
review_texts:
I recently visited a beautiful pet-friendly restaurant and had such an amazing experience that I couldn’t wait to share it. The food was absolutely awesome, and every dish we ordered was full of flavor and perfectly prepared. If you ever visit this place, Pizza and Nachos are a must-try. The pizza was cheesy, fresh, and loaded with toppings, while the nachos were crispy and served with delicious dips that made them even better.
One of the best things about this restaurant is its peaceful and refreshing ambience. The place is surrounded by lots of greenery, which creates a calm and relaxing atmosphere. There is also a lovely fountain that adds to the beauty of the space and makes it perfect for spending quality time with friends and family. Another highlight is that it is a pet-friendly restaurant, so you can happily take your furry friend along and enjoy the outing together. Watching pets enjoy the open space made the experience even more cheerful.
The mocktails were equally impressive and very refreshing. They were beautifully presented and tasted amazing. Overall, this restaurant offers great food, a wonderful ambience, and a memorable dining experience that I would definitely recommend to everyone.

Decent brewery in Bangalore and one of the best in Electronic City. Not much big but got its flavour and ambience. Taste wise quite decent. Thin crust pizza for Veg people is must to have. Even panner tikka and corn&green pea kababs also good. Beer is as usual a good one and chilli guava is must for non alcoholic people.

Great food, brilliant band and to top it all of with a breezy ambiance, what a great night to spend!!. Nachos and craft beer was such an addictive combo. The cocktails were perfect along with the cute dimsums and pizza. Mr. Prashanth was a great host, took care of the night and made sure everything was on point. It's my third visit and it has become my regular spot already. Highly recommend!!

We had been there to watch the RCB match 2026. The atmosphere was good. Even though we had booked tickets, we had to wait for them to arrange the seats. There is an open space, and since it was raining, we had to adjust a little. The projector was switching on and off initially, but later on, it was all fine

Decent food with a great overall experience. The place stands out for its nice vibes and relaxing atmosphere. The open terrace garden setup adds a refreshing touch, making it a good spot to unwind, especially in the evenings. Parking space is available, which makes it convenient to visit. Overall, a good place to hang out with friends or for a casual outing.l
